title: Jr. Clinical Research Coord
description:
Company Intro

At American Vision Partners (AVP), we partner with the most respected ophthalmology practices in the country and integrate best-in-class management systems, operational infrastructure, and advanced technology to provide the highest quality patient care possible. Our practices include Barnet Dulaney Perkins Eye Center, Southwestern Eye Center, Retinal Consultants of Arizona, M&M Eye Institute, Abrams Eye Institute, Southwest Eye Institute, Aiello Eye Institute, Moretsky Cassidy Vision Correction, Wellish Vision Institute, West Texas Eye Associates and Vantage Eye Center. We are focused on building the nation’s largest and most comprehensive eye care practices and currently operate more than 100 eye care centers in Arizona, New Mexico, Nevada, California and Texas – including 25 ambulatory surgical centers. At AVP we value teamwork, providing exceptional experiences, continuous improvement, financial strength, and hard work. We are committed to providing best-in-class patient care, pioneering research and technology, and most importantly, rewarding and recognizing our employees!

Overview

As a Junior Clinical Research Coordinator, you are responsible for assisting with the management and coordination of all aspects of conducting clinical trials within s RII, surgery centers, both clinically and administrative/regulatory.

Responsibilities

  • Acts as a representative of clinical research and as liaison between investigators, other study staff, primary care providers, IRB and sponsor.
  • Screens, consents, enrolls and follows study subjects ensuring protocol compliance and close monitoring while subjects are on study utilizing Research Nurses’ oversight for help with clinical decision making.
  • Responsible for all data and source documentation, and adverse experience reporting
  • Responsible for following departmental policies
  • Responsible and for assuring proper billing for research subjects. Assures that charges for tests and treatments are appropriately communicated and processed.
  • Assists as needed in preparing study for submission to IRB and ensures all regulatory documents are completed.
  • Attends study-related meetings as appropriate.
  • Travels between RCA research offices as needed for patient and business needs.
  • Develops screening/enrollment/follow up mechanisms.
  • Ensure adherence to protocol requirements.
  • Schedules and performs patient procedures, assessments, evaluations and testing as required by the protocol, including but not limited to blood sample collection, processing and shipping, ECG, vital signs, etc., as applicable.
  • Organizational maintenance of all aspects of the trial, including but not limited to timeliness in completing CRFs, reporting adverse events, managing caseload and study files.
  • Responsible for quality data entry into sponsor’s database (electronic data capture systems or paper CRFs) and query resolution.
  • Ensures proper study drug administration, compliance and accountability, including receipt and , storage and dispensing.
  • Ensures patient safety and ensures coordination of patient care as needed.
  • Assists with maintenance of regulatory documents, IRB reporting and submissions of amendments, renewals, etc.
  • Assists with study initiation visits, monitoring visits, closeout visits and audit visit, ensuring all study documentation and study issues are addressed.
  • Communicates regularly with the Manager of Clinical Research at RII and Principal Investigators about study related issues.
  • Ensures compliance with department standards and all federal regulations and international guidelines of good clinical practice.
  • Maintain job related certifications (IATA, Human subjects, subjects’ protection training, GCP, and protocol specific required training).
  • Active in acquiring professional growth by obtaining CRC certification when eligible and joining a professional association such as SOCRA or ACRP.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Promotes a positive work environment and works to be an integral member of the team
  • Encourage a team-oriented environment supporting the AVP Mission, Vision and Core Values.
  • Participate in on-going training and continuing education.
  • Show respect and deal appropriately with co-workers, patients, and visitors.
  • Perform any and all duties assigned.

Qualifications

  • Associate or Bachelor’s Degree or working toward one
  • Clinical experience in Retina or other optical care
  • Prior research experience
  • Current IATA, Human Subjects’ protection training or GCP training highly desirable
    • Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:
  • Specialty certification such as CCRC preferred

Benefits & Perks

Your health, happiness and your future matters! At AVP, we offer everything from medical and dental insurance, significant eye care discounts, child care assistance, pet insurance, continuing education funds, 401(k), paid holidays, PTO, Sick Time, opportunity for growth, and much more!

title: Hospital Registration Specialist
description:
About Us

HIGHLIGHTS

JOB TYPE: PRN Days (7am-7pm)

FACILITY TYPE: 20 bed Small-Format Hospital (10 ER, 10 Inpatient)

PERKS: Flexible Schedule, 401K match (fully vested day 1 of eligibility!!), paid referrals

We are Emerus, the leader in small-format hospitals. We partner with respected and like-minded health systems who share our mission: To provide the care patients need, in the neighborhoods they live, by teams they trust. Our growing number of amazing partners includes Allegheny Health Network, Ascension, Baptist Health System, Baylor Scott & White Health, ChristianaCare, Dignity Health St. Rose Dominican, The Hospitals of Providence, INTEGRIS Health, MultiCare and WellSpan. Our innovative hospitals are fully accredited and provide highly individualized care. Emerus' commitment to patient care extends far beyond the confines of societal norms. We believe that every individual who walks through our doors deserves compassionate, comprehensive care, regardless of their background, identity, or circumstances. We are committed to fostering a work environment focused on teamwork that celebrates diversity, promotes equity and ensures equal access to information, development and opportunity for all of our Healthcare Pros.

Position Overview

The purpose of this position is to serve as a liaison between patient/family, payers, Patient Financial Services, and other health care team members. You'll be asked to facilitate patient tracking and billing by obtaining/verifying accurate and complete demographic information, financially securing, and collecting out-of-pocket responsibility from guarantors to maximize hospital reimbursement.

Essential Job Functions

  • Maintain compliance with EMTALA, DNV, HIPAA and all other hospital and government regulations applicable to the Admissions settings and in handling of Medical Records
  • Provide excellent customer service at all times by effectively meeting customer needs, understanding who the customers are, and building quality relationships

  • The Patient Access Specialist plays a role in protecting patient safety by ensuring each patient is properly identified and triaged when they arrive to the hospital

  • Answer telephone in a professional and courteous manner, record messages and communicate to appropriate medical staff
  • Provide and obtain signatures on required forms and consents
  • Obtain, verify, and enter complete and accurate demographic information on all accounts to facilitate smooth processing through the revenue cycle
  • Verify insurance benefits for all plans associated with patient, confirming the correct payor and plan is entered into the patient accounting system
  • Obtain insurance authorizations as required by individual insurance plans where applicable
  • Maximize the efficiency and accuracy of the collection process by pursuing collections at the time of service in a customer service-oriented fashion
  • Scan all registration and clinical documentation into the system and maintain all medical records
  • Assist with coordinating the transfer of patients to other hospitals when necessary
  • Respond to medical record requests from patients, physicians and hospitals
  • Maintain cash drawer according to policies
  • Maintain log of all patients, payments received, transfers and hospital admissions
  • Maintain visitor/vendor log

Other Job Functions

  • Maintain a clean working environment for the facility. This includes the front desk, restroom, waiting room, break area and patient rooms when assistance is needed by medical staff
  • Receive deliveries including mail from various carriers and forward to appropriate departments as needed
  • Notify appropriate contact of any malfunctioning equipment or maintenance needs
  • Attend staff meetings or other company sponsored or mandated meetings as required
  • Assist medical staff as needed
  • Perform additional duties as assigned

Basic Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED, required
  • 2 years of patient registration and insurance verification experience in a health care setting, preferred
  • Emergency Department registration experience, strongly preferred
  • Knowledge of various insurance plans (HMO, PPO, POS, Medicare, Medicaid) and payors, required.
  • Basic understanding of medical terminology
  • Excellent customer service
  • Working knowledge of MS Office (MS Word, Excel and Outlook), strongly preferred.
  • Position requires fluency in English; written and oral communication
    • Fluency in both English & Spanish is a requirement in the El Paso Market
  • Pennsylvania Candidates: Act 33 (Child Abuse History Clearance), & Act 73 (FBI Fingerprint Criminal History Clearance) completed within the last 5 years, or must be obtained prior to start date.

title: RevTech Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a RevTech Senior Salesforce Developer based in India.

This role serves as the embedded technical partner for a go-to-market business function, owning solutions from discovery and design through development, testing, and production deployment. You will translate complex and sometimes ambiguous business needs into scalable technical solutions while working closely with non-technical stakeholders. The position combines deep Salesforce engineering with broader ownership of the GTM technology ecosystem, including integrations, custom applications, and automation. You will contribute to a modern Revenue Lifecycle Management environment covering CPQ, entitlements, renewals, commissions, billing, and connected platforms. The role also partners closely with Engineering on React and NestJS-based internal applications that expose and work with Salesforce data. With significant autonomy and visibility, you will help shape technical direction while using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and maintain high engineering standards.

Accountabilities:

  • Act as the primary technical partner for an assigned GTM squad, developing strong relationships with business stakeholders and gaining a deep understanding of their workflows and technical needs.
  • Lead the full solution lifecycle, from discovery and requirements clarification through solution design, documentation, development, testing, iteration, and production deployment.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into clear, maintainable technical solutions while balancing declarative Salesforce capabilities with custom development.
  • Partner with Engineering on internal GTM applications built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, Apollo Client, NestJS, and GraphQL, securely exposing and synchronizing Salesforce data through APIs and services.
  • Collaborate with AI Automation Engineers to support Salesforce-connected workflows and integrations built using automation platforms such as n8n.
  • Contribute hands-on to Revenue Lifecycle Management solutions covering data modeling, custom CPQ capabilities, entitlements, renewal management, commissions, billing, and connected business platforms.
  • Design, implement, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and third-party GTM systems, including customer engagement, sales, communication, document, billing, and collaboration platforms.
  • Develop and maintain secure Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, queueable and scheduled processes, and other asynchronous workflows with meaningful automated test coverage.
  • Build Lightning Web Components where native Salesforce UI extensions are appropriate while also supporting external applications that consume Salesforce data.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintain technical documentation, and follow structured release processes from sandbox environments through production.
  • Apply AI-powered development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, test validation, metadata management, and Salesforce configuration while critically reviewing generated output.
  • Contribute to shared engineering standards and collaborate across RevTech, Engineering, automation, and business teams rather than operating in isolation.

    • Requirements

    • Demonstrated ability to independently conduct discovery with non-technical stakeholders, clarify business requirements, develop solution designs, and document technical approaches.
    • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous business processes into practical, scalable technical solutions.
    • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining integrations between Salesforce and external systems, including experience exposing Salesforce data securely through APIs or services.
    • Comfortable working across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, as well as broader GTM technologies beyond Salesforce.
    • Experience with Salesforce DevOps workflows, GitHub, Gearset, code reviews, branching strategies, testing, and structured deployment processes.
    • Practical experience using AI coding assistants as part of daily development, including the ability to prompt effectively, validate generated code critically, and safely incorporate useful output into production solutions.
    • Familiarity with B2B SaaS Revenue Lifecycle Management, CPQ, Salesforce Flow at scale, and Omni-Channel is valuable.

    • Exposure to modern web technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, React Router, Apollo Client, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis is beneficial.

title: Applied ML Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in Spain.

As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering.
You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products.
The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences.
You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate.
You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users.
The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack.
It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust.

Accountabilities

  • Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models.
  • Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses.
  • Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required.
  • Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility.
  • Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows.
  • Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion.
  • Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations.
  • Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses.
  • Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve.
  • During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface.
  • Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
    • Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility.
    • Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages.
    • Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation.
    • Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate.
    • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users.
    • Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests.
    • High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently.
    • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions.
    • Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus.
    • Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous.

As our People Experience Administrator, you'll be the first point of contact for iwocans and the person who keeps the employee journey running smoothly, from someone's first day to their last.

Supporting payroll across our UK and German teams is a key part of the role, so you'll play a direct part in making sure every iwocan gets paid correctly and on time.

These are full-time salaries that we'll pro-rate for the hours you work. We expect to pay from £32,000 - £36,000 for this role in London but, we’re open-minded and want to find the right person for this role, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

title: Data Engineering Intern
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE – EXPLORE, LEARN, AND MAKE AN IMPACT

We’re looking for a driven and curious Data Engineering Intern to help power our data ecosystem. In this role, you won’t just be “moving data” - you’ll be building the backbone of our data infrastructure. From designing robust data pipelines to ensuring high standards of data quality and reliability, you’ll play a key role in making data usable, scalable, and impactful.

If you’re a passionate coder who loves working with data and solving complex problems, this internship will accelerate your growth in the right direction.

WHY JOIN US?

By working closely with our AI/ML team, you’ll gain firsthand insight into how well‑engineered data fuels intelligent systems. This is a rare opportunity to bridge the gap between Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence - gaining real-world, practical exposure to how clean, structured data evolves into powerful machine learning models.

You will learn:

  • How to implement a Lakehouse architecture from scratch

  • Orchestration patterns

  • The importance of Data Governance in a professional AI environment

Supported by mentorship from senior engineers and data experts.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Data Engineering (Core Focus)

  • Assist in building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data into our data warehouse/lake.

  • Manage and organize data in Object Storage, ensuring ACID compliance and scalable metadata handling.

  • Develop Python scripts to clean, validate, and transform raw data.

  • Maintain data governance practices, including dataset registration and lineage documentation.

  • Document data schemas, dictionaries, and pipeline architecture clearly.

2. AI & Machine Learning Support (Growth Focus)

  • Prepare high-quality datasets for model training and vector databases.

  • Support deployment and monitoring of basic ML models or LLM applications.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate has the following qualities:

  • Currently pursuing or recently graduated from a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, or related field.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, efficient, and well-structured code.

  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and the Data Lakehouse concept.

  • Familiarity with Git and version control best practices.

  • A curious and growth-oriented mindset, with a strong desire to understand how data engineering powers scalable AI and machine learning solutions.

While not required, the below will offer an additional advantage:

  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker).

  • Familiarity with Modern Data Stack tools (such as Dagster, Airflow, Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg).

  • Basic understanding of Machine Learning workflows or LLMs (OpenAI, Ollama, HuggingFace).

title: Stevens Institute - CAREER FAIR FULL-TIME ENTRY LEVEL OPPORTUNITIES
description:
If you are a team player and ready to kick start your career in a multi-disciplined Architecture/Engineering firm, Popli Design Group (PDG) is the place for you! PDG is seeking Junior Engineers, Architectural Designers, Survey Technicians, and Construction Inspectors to add to our growing and talented teams. With offices in Buffalo, Rochester, Binghamton, Albany, and NYC/NJ, our teams will match you to the best opportunity to set you up for a successful career journey.


Bridge Inspection, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will assist the Bridge Inspection Team Leaders in conducting inspections in the field. You will actively contribute to the inspection process, helping gather data and performing necessary tasks under the guidance of experienced professionals. Additionally, you will be responsible for conducting structural analyses of bridges to determine their capacity, utilizing your engineering knowledge and analytical skills.


Transportation Construction Inspectors

In this role, you will be responsible for inspecting the progress of basic construction operations (Earthwork, Pavement, Structural Components, Scaffolding…); Verify conformance of material with Standard Specifications by carrying out field tests (Concrete, Compaction…); Interpret documented characteristics of objects and materials used in construction; Recognize unsafe construction procedures and site conditions; Inspect erosion control and protection of environmental features and utilities; and identify measured and/or tested properties and provide appropriate notification(s) and Report(s).


Civil, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will assist in the areas of development of hydraulic or water distribution models, design calculations, etc. in support of comprehensive civil/site design projects under the guidance and support of licensed Engineers; Assist in the preparation of technical engineering documents, design plans, specifications, reports, and cost estimates; and assist in the preparation of comprehensive drawing packages using Civil 3D, Microstation, etc.


Structural, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will work on assignments that include design and analysis, modelling/drafting, preparing plans and specifications, technical report writing, cost estimating, and construction observation. Projects are typically in the municipal and academic/institutional sectors and range from new construction and large additions to structural investigations, condition assessments, capacity analysis, renovation, rehabilitation and strengthening of existing structures.


Electrical, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will apply your working knowledge of electrical circuit theory and design, power distribution, signs/controls to create plans using AutoCAD and/or REVIT under the close supervision of Senior Electrical staff. Additionally, you will design sections of building’s electrical systems, for both new and renovated buildings including power and lighting.


Mechanical, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will assist in the design of HVAC, plumbing and/or fire protection systems for building facilities. Additionally, you will perform engineering evaluations and analyses, field inspections, design drawings, technical specifications and cost estimation under direct supervision of senior engineers.



About Popli Design Group (PDG)

PDG is a well-established multi-disciplinary architecture and engineering firm that has been serving clients since 1982. Our extensive portfolio of successful projects has earned us a trusted reputation among our clients.


Popli Design Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetics, disability or protected veteran status, and any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal law or Executive Orders.


Good faith salary range is provided, and salary package will be commensurate with experience, location, and area of study.

title: HFN: Associate Fabricator
description:
Why Us?

With a mantra of Empowering Human Potential, Hanger, Inc. is the world's premier provider of orthotic and prosthetic (O&P) services and products, offering the most advanced O&P solutions, clinically differentiated programs and unsurpassed customer service. Hanger's Patient Care segment is the largest owner and operator of O&P patient care clinics nationwide. Through its Products & Services segment, Hanger distributes branded and private label O&P devices, products and components, and provides rehabilitative solutions to the broader market. With 160 years of clinical excellence and innovation, Hanger's vision is to lead the orthotic and prosthetic markets by providing superior patient care, outcomes, services and value. Collectively, Hanger employees touch thousands of lives each day, helping people achieve new levels of mobility and freedom.

Could This Be For You?

The Associate Fabricator fabricates the orthoses and prostheses to provide maximum fit, function, cosmetics and workmanship. The Associate Fabricator will have on the job training as well as formal O&P Training i.e., LMS and other training provided by leadership. Through this training you will be expected to maintain tools, equipment, materials, and following work instructions per device in your work area.

Your Impact

  • Perform fabrication of orthotic and/or prosthetic devices, according to Company quality and quantity standards.
  • May assist or perform in ordering and receiving and other inventory tasks as assigned.
  • Maintain 5s to ensure for a safe, clean and orderly work environment.
  • Adhere to all safety regulations and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) requirements.
  • Adhere to all HIPPA and other regulatory compliance training issued by Hanger, Inc.

Minimum Qualifications

Experience and Education:

  • High School Diploma or GED; no experience required.
  • Preferred: less than 1 year of related experience working within environments that include: machinery, tools, wood working, design, fabrication, componentry, etc. –OR-
  • Without diploma/GED, 1 year of related experience working within O&P environments that include: machinery, tools, design, fabrication, componentry, etc.

Additional Success Factors

  • Knowledge and hand skills needed to fabricate and repair prostheses (artificial limbs) and orthoses (orthopedic braces) according to specifications.
  • Mechanical ability and hand-eye coordination to use laboratory tools safely and effectively.
  • Effective organizational, time management and planning skills.
  • Good interpersonal and verbal skills for communicating with others.

  • Continuously innovate new solutions, influencing and responding to change.
  • Focus on superior outcomes, and calibrate work processes for outstanding results.

Our Investment in You

  • PTO that includes Vacation and Sick time
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • 401k Savings and Retirement Plan

title: Warranty & Closeout Coordinator
description:
About Us

A proud member of the Quanta Services family of companies, Ampacity, LLC (Ampacity) delivers a forward-thinking approach to structural and electrical solutions for clean energy transition projects. From design, kitting, and installation to comprehensive electrical procurement, Ampacity specializes in expert-engineered, field-ready solutions that accelerate project timelines and maximize impact. Made up of more than 350 passionate professionals committed to simplifying complexity across the energy value chain, Ampacity empowers customers to build smarter, faster, and more efficiently­—with the most reliable technology in the industry. Headquartered in California, Ampacity maintains facilities in Mississippi, Kentucky, and Iowa, with offices in Florida, Georgia, and Vermont. Since 2014, Ampacity has delivered nearly eight gigawatts of fully engineered clean energy systems across North America.

About this Role

The Warranty & Closeout Coordinator serves at Ampacity, serves as the primary point of contact for projects that experience issues after commissioning. This role coordinates the people, materials, schedules, and information needed to move post-commissioning issues from intake through resolution and documented closeout. Working closely with warranty, supply chain, field operations, scheduling, technical support, and other internal resources, the coordinator keeps stakeholders informed, removes roadblocks, and helps ensure each project receives timely, organized support. As a secondary responsibility, this position supports the technical troubleshooting team by helping respond to customer calls that require immediate field assistance.

Salary Range: $80,000 - $90,000

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the main point of contact for post-commissioning project issues, coordinating each request from initial intake through remediation and final closeout.
  • Maintain a clear, current tracker of open issues, priorities, owners, parts, crew assignments, customer commitments, and next steps.
  • Coordinate with warranty, supply chain, scheduling, field crews, operations, engineering, and other internal resources to build and execute practical remediation plans.
  • Confirm that required materials, documentation, technical information, and qualified field resources are available before work is scheduled.
  • Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and expected next steps to customers and internal stakeholders throughout the closeout process.
  • Follow up on delayed parts, unresolved technical questions, scheduling conflicts, and other roadblocks, escalating issues when additional support or decisions are needed.
  • Verify that remediation work is completed, supporting documentation is collected, and outstanding items are formally closed.
  • Identify recurring post-commissioning issues and share trends with warranty, quality, engineering, supply chain, and operations teams to support continuous improvement.
  • Provide secondary support to the technical troubleshooting team by helping respond to customer calls requiring immediate field assistance, gathering issue details, connecting the appropriate technical resources, and coordinating follow-up actions.
  • This role will evolve over time with the needs of the business.

What You'll Bring

  • Ability to manage multiple open project issues, competing priorities, and cross-functional action items without losing visibility or momentum.
  • Working knowledge of the solar tracking systems Ampacity supports, including commissioning, operations, common field issues, and service requirements.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with customers, understand the urgency of field issues, and provide clear, consistent updates.
  • Comfort working across warranty, supply chain, scheduling, field operations, engineering, and technical support to move issues to resolution.
  • Ability to gather accurate information, organize symptoms and site conditions, and connect customers or field teams with the right technical resources.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for customer calls, internal handoffs, status updates, escalation, and closeout documentation.
  • Comfort using Excel, Procore, or similar systems to track project status, parts, assignments, documentation, and completion.

Typical Work Environment

  • Primarily office-based work with frequent coordination by phone, email, video conference, and project-management systems.
  • Periodic visits to active solar project sites may be required to support issue assessment, remediation planning, or closeout verification.
  • Project site visits may involve exposure to outdoor weather, construction equipment, noise, dust, and uneven terrain.
  • Occasional travel (~10%) and schedule flexibility may be required to support urgent customer or field needs.

Physical Expectations

  • Ability to work at a computer and communicate by phone, email, and virtual meeting for extended periods.
  • Ability to safely walk active project sites and use required personal protective equipment when visiting the field.
  • Ability to participate in required safety, product, and technical training.

What You'll Get

  • Competitive pay and 401k — because your work should be rewarded fairly
  • Time off you'll actually use: vacation, sick days, holidays, parental, and bereavement leave
  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus extra support when you need it
  • Wellness resources to help you show up as your best self, at work and at home
  • Real room to grow — we promote from within and invest in your development

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. For additional information or if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview, or hiring processes or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact us the Company’s Human Resources department.

title: Applied ML Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in Ireland.

As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering.
You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products.
The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences.
You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate.
You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users.
The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack.
It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust.

Accountabilities

  • Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models.
  • Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses.
  • Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required.
  • Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility.
  • Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows.
  • Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion.
  • Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations.
  • Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses.
  • Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve.
  • During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface.
  • Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
    • Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility.
    • Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages.
    • Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation.
    • Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate.
    • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users.
    • Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests.
    • High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently.
    • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions.
    • Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus.
    • Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial.
    • Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus.
    • Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable.
    • Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage.
    • A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on applied machine learning at the intersection of research, experimentation, engineering, and product.
      • End-to-end ownership across model evaluation, model internals, infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing experiences.
      • Exposure to modern open-weight models, LLM inference systems, and emerging ML verification techniques.
      • A role with significant technical autonomy and the opportunity to shape both experiments and production systems.
      • Fast-moving startup environment with evolving priorities and cross-functional collaboration.
      • Opportunity to translate cutting-edge research into practical, measurable, and user-accessible products.
      • The opportunity to build systems and evaluation methodologies designed to produce evidence that users can understand and trust.
      • Location: Romania.
      • Additional compensation, flexibility, healthcare, and other benefits may be provided according to the partner company's employment package and local arrangements.

title: Senior GenAI Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer to join our team. The project involves the development of a sophisticated user interface utilizing the Saffron UI framework, aimed at enhancing user experience through seamless integration with backend services and APIs. The goal is to meet ambitious targets while adapting to evolving project requirements and deadlines.

The role will focus on building and evolving GenAI-powered application capabilities, including LLM integrations, MCP-based tooling, and agentic workflows. The engineer will contribute across the full application stack, developing AI-enabled backend services and user experiences that support streaming interactions, tool execution, structured outputs, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Take part in the full lifecycle of feature development, from initial concept through deployment and ongoing support
  • Translate business and product requirements into well-structured technical solutions
  • Build and maintain intuitive, responsive user interfaces that deliver a smooth end-user experience
  • Develop and maintain backend services that power core application functionality
  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to shape product direction
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues affecting application performance, stability, and usability
  • Take part in code reviews to maintain high standards of quality and consistency across the codebase
  • Document technical decisions, workflows, and system behavior to support team knowledge sharing
  • Estimate effort and timelines for assigned tasks and communicate progress to stakeholders
  • Stay current with emerging tools and approaches, recommending improvements to existing practices

Requirements

  • A minimum of three years of hands-on, relevant professional experience
  • Practical experience building applications powered by LLM providers such as Claude, OpenAI, or similar platforms
  • Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), including designing tool schemas and building or modifying MCP servers
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows, encompassing tool use, orchestration logic, and safety guardrails
  • Strong full-stack development background, combining React and TypeScript on the frontend with Python/FastAPI or Node.js on the backend
  • Experience integrating LLM provider APIs, including handling streaming responses, function/tool calling, and structured output formats
  • Solid communication skills with working English fluency at B2 level or above, enabling clear understanding of business requirements and their translation into agentic architectures

Nice to have

  • Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including retrieval methods and chunking strategies
  • Familiarity with vector database technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector for storing and retrieving embeddings

- **Part Time Fixed Term | 16 hours per week**

If you are heading into the final year of your engineering degree, our 2027 Undergraduate Academy gives you the opportunity to gain practical industry experience while completing your studies.

Over 12 months, you will work alongside experienced engineers on real projects that help shape, build and connect the Gold Coast, developing practical skills, building industry connections and exploring where a career with the City could take you.

**Start your career at the City**

Starting February 2027, the Undergraduate Academy is designed specifically for students entering their final year of university. You will work 16 hours per week during university study periods, giving you the flexibility to balance your studies with meaningful professional experience, with opportunities to increase your working hours during university breaks.

This is an opportunity to take what you are learning in the classroom and see how it is applied in the real world, contributing to projects, working with experienced professionals and developing practical engineering capability before you graduate.

**What’s on offer**

As an Undergraduate Engineer, you will complete a planned 12-month rotational pathway across the engineering asset lifecycle, gaining experience across Planning, Design, Delivery, Maintenance and Operations.

Through a combination of Core and Micro Rotations, you will experience different stages of the asset lifecycle, work across a variety of engineering teams and projects and build a broader understanding of engineering at the City. Your rotational pathway will consider your engineering discipline, individual interests and the opportunities available across the City, giving you broad and purposeful experience across the lifecycle.

Throughout the program, you will be supported by a dedicated Mentor, providing guidance and continuity across your 12 months and a Rotation Leader within each placement to support your day-to-day work and development.

**Who can apply?**

Our Undergraduate Engineer opportunity welcomes students completing a Bachelor of Engineering in Civil, Structural, Environmental, Electrical, Mechanical or Process Engineering. To be considered for this opportunity you must:

- be enrolled in and entering the final year of a relevant undergraduate Bachelor of Engineering degree at a recognised Australian university when the program commences, with approximately 12 months of study remaining
- have Australian citizenship, permanent residency or a visa with appropriate working rights for the required hours and duration of the program
- be available to work 16 hours per week during university study periods
- be available to work in person at City of Gold Coast workplaces and locations
- be able to obtain a Construction White Card and meet relevant WHS requirements

Submit your academic transcript, CV and cover letter. In your cover letter, tell us about your engineering studies, career interests, work experience, volunteering or extracurricular activities and the areas of engineering you are most interested in exploring. Most importantly, tell us what you hope to learn by putting your university studies into practice with the City.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities, and encourage candidates to discuss any support or adjustments they may need throughout the recruitment process._

We are seeking a Lead Data DevOps Engineer to join a team that implements and supports essential components of an Azure data platform. This includes infrastructure changes, monitoring, end-to-end tracking, automation and self-healing, anomaly detection, event correlation and analysis, performance analysis, and access permissions management.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain advanced Terraform configurations and Azure DevOps pipelines spanning multiple subscriptions and environments
  • Engage with various stakeholders to ensure technical solutions meet business requirements
  • Enhance performance while monitoring, troubleshooting, and preventing issues across data workloads
  • Work alongside Architecture teams to confirm that platform architecture and design standards align with the support model
  • Pinpoint ways to optimize data platform activities, support processes, and operational workflows
  • Streamline and automate administrative tasks, infrastructure, and application deployments
  • Team up with the SRE group to maintain platform reliability and stability

Requirements

  • 5+ years working with Azure Cloud services, Azure DevOps, Azure PowerShell, and Terraform
  • 1+ years of relevant leadership experience
  • Hands-on expertise in infrastructure automation using Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines across multiple subscriptions and environments
  • Strong communication skills for engaging with technical and business stakeholders alike
  • Solid grasp of platform architecture and design standards to enable effective collaboration with Architecture teams
  • Ability to spot and execute automation opportunities across administrative, infrastructure, and deployment tasks
  • English proficiency at a B2+ level

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure Databricks
  • Working knowledge of Azure Monitor and Azure SQL Database
  • Experience with Azure Storage and Azure Synapse Analytics

Benefits

With us you can:

  • Work on a flexible schedule remotely or from any of our comfortable offices or coworking spaces in Ukraine
  • Receive the necessary equipment to perform your work tasks
  • Change projects and technology stacks within EPAM
  • Gain experience in various business domains (Insurance, E-commerce, Healthcare, Finance, Travelling, Media, Artificial Intelligence, and more)
  • Relocation opportunities may be available for eligible candidates, depending on the role and openings at other EPAM locations
  • Participate in volunteer, charity programs and communities (both technical and interest-based)

We focus on your professional growth:

  • You can plan your individual career path together with your manager
  • Receive regular feedback from colleagues
  • Improve your English for free with certified teachers (Speaking Clubs, client interview preparation courses, etc.)
  • Get the opportunity to undergo free training and certification in AWS, GCP, or Azure Clouds
  • Use the internal E-learn training program (18,200+ specialized training and mentoring programs)
  • Access corporate accounts on LinkedIn Learning, Get Abstract and other partner resources
  • Study at EPAM Solution Architecture School with the instructors who are practicing architects
  • Develop as a leader, join Delivery Management, Resource Management, Leadership Essentials school and more
  • Participate in internal communities (500+ meetups, technical discussions, brainstorming sessions, online events and conferences annually)

What we offer:

  • Vacation and sick leave (including a sick leave without a medical certificate)
  • A wide range of Voluntary Medical Insurance programs providing both medical treatment and various preventive options (including sports activities)
  • Medical insurance for family members at corporate rates
  • Company support during significant life events (childbirth or adoption, marriage, etc.)

title: Technical Business Analyst - Data & Reporting
description:
Your new role:
As a Technical Business Analyst within the Data and Reporting workstream, you’ll help shape how core systems data is migrated, transformed, validated and used for analytics and reporting. You’ll work across technology, operations and business teams to translate complex requirements into practical technical solutions.

This is a hands on BA role suited to someone who enjoys getting into the detail of data while still being able to understand the bigger picture.

Responsibilities:
  • Gather, analyse and document detailed technical and data requirements
  • Understand how customer, product and operational data flows between systems
  • Define current and target state data requirements
  • Develop data mappings and transformation rules for the new core banking platform
  • Interrogate existing core data using SQL
  • Develop robust data validation and reconciliation rules
  • Support data migration, data shipping, analytics and reporting activities
  • Identify data quality and consistency issues and help determine appropriate solutions
  • Work closely with data engineers, data analysts, developers and business SMEs
  • Facilitate conversations between business and technical stakeholders
  • Document solution designs, requirements, processes and data flows
  • Manage ambiguity and evolving requirements as understanding develops across the programme
  • Support testing and ensure solutions are thoroughly documented, reviewed and validated
Requirements:
  • 5+ years’ experience in technical or business analysis roles
  • Strong Technical Business Analysis experience
  • Excellent data analysis and interrogation skills
  • Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to run and adapt queries
  • Experience with data and process modelling
  • Strong requirements gathering and documentation capability
  • Ability to understand complex data structures, mappings and system flows
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across technical and business teams
  • Excellent analytical, logical and problem solving capability
  • Ability to work autonomously and manage competing priorities
  • Data migration experience would be highly advantageous
  • Banking, financial services or insurance experience would be advantageous
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence would be beneficial
Perks and benefits:
  • Fixed term opportunity through to March 2028
  • Work on a large scale, business critical transformation programme
  • Collaborate with experienced technology, data and business specialists
  • Opportunity to influence the future state of a major organisation’s data and analytics capability
  • Complex, challenging work with significant organisational impact
If this sounds like you then HIT APPLY NOW! You must have a valid working visa for NZ.

title: Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D based in Switzerland.

As a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D, you’ll help evolve a live mobile game by building new gameplay systems, LiveOps features, and scalable technical solutions.
You’ll work across the full development lifecycle, from implementing new mechanics to improving architecture, performance, stability, and maintainability.
A strong focus of the role is on modern AI-assisted development, with opportunities to integrate AI agents into real production workflows and automate recurring engineering tasks.
You’ll investigate real-world production issues using telemetry and profiling data, ensuring a smooth experience across a wide range of mobile devices.
The role also offers significant technical ownership, including participation in architectural decisions, code reviews, optimization initiatives, and development practices.
You’ll collaborate closely with other technical and product-focused team members while contributing ideas that can improve both engineering efficiency and the game itself.
This is an R&D-oriented opportunity for a developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, experimenting with new tools, and seeing their work make a measurable product impact.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain gameplay systems and features using Unity and C# within a released mobile game, while evolving architecture and reducing technical debt.
  • Implement and maintain LiveOps functionality, including events, promotions, seasonal content, and A/B testing.
  • Work with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, and Remote Configs to enable content and feature updates without requiring a full application release.
  • Actively use AI agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent tools in day-to-day development on a real production codebase.
  • Create and maintain internal AI skills, rules, and agent instructions that automate recurring team workflows while taking responsibility for the quality of generated results.
  • Investigate and resolve ANRs, crashes, freezes, OOM issues, and other production problems using real telemetry and diagnostic data.
  • Optimize CPU usage, memory consumption, startup time, application size, and downloadable content for different classes of Android devices.
  • Integrate and maintain advertising, analytics, monetization, and third-party SDKs while ensuring tracking and event implementation remain accurate.
  • Conduct code reviews and contribute to important technical and architectural decisions.
  • Share effective AI-assisted development practices and help improve the team's engineering workflows.
  • Profile and optimize Android and iOS applications using tools such as Unity Profiler, Crashlytics, and Android Vitals.
  • Investigate performance regressions and follow complex technical issues from symptoms through root-cause analysis, implementation, and validation of results.
  • Consider product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV when evaluating technical and gameplay decisions.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of commercial experience with Unity and C#, including experience working on released mobile games and supporting projects through LiveOps rather than only developing them prior to launch.
    • Strong understanding of Unity project architecture, including design patterns, dependency injection with tools such as Zenject or VContainer, asynchronous programming with UniTask, Unity lifecycle, memory management, and garbage collection.
    • Practical experience with AI development agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, including the ability to decompose tasks, provide appropriate context from large codebases, and validate generated code.
    • Experience with MCP, including Unity MCP or similar approaches, as well as skills, rules, and agent-instruction workflows.
    • Ability to document team development practices in a way that allows AI agents to reproduce them consistently.
    • Hands-on experience with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, Remote Configs, versioning, caching, and fallback scenarios.
    • Strong profiling and optimization experience across Android and/or iOS, including investigation of ANRs, crashes, OOM issues, and production performance regressions.
    • Understanding of low-end Android devices, device fragmentation, and mobile build-size optimization.
    • Experience integrating third-party SDKs for advertising, analytics, and in-app purchases.
    • Familiarity with Git workflows, code review practices, and CI/CD.
    • Ability to take a complex technical problem from symptom identification through root-cause analysis, solution implementation, and verification of the outcome.
    • Understanding of product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to technical challenges.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions, and communicate complex engineering topics clearly.
    • Experience in an R&D-oriented environment is advantageous.
    • Professional Ukrainian language proficiency is expected.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work within Europe, with remote-first flexibility.
      • Personal benefit budget that can be allocated toward insurance, education, fitness, or other areas supporting personal wellbeing.
      • Performance-based bonuses recognizing meaningful results, initiative, and contribution to team success.
      • High level of autonomy with minimal bureaucracy and the opportunity to influence technical and product decisions.
      • Professional development through learning opportunities, internal training, and strategic sessions.
      • Opportunity to work with modern AI-assisted development tools and contribute to innovative engineering practices.
      • Collaborative team environment focused on shared ownership and collective results.
      • Direct opportunity to contribute to the evolution of a live mobile game and its underlying technology.
      • Full-time position within a Gameplay Development environment.
      • Interview process consisting of a recruiter interview, test assignment, technical interview, reference collection, and offer stage.

title: Advogado(a) Contencioso Trabalhista
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Advogado(a) Contencioso Trabalhista based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to work with high-volume labor litigation within a multidisciplinary and technology-enabled legal environment.
You will manage cases across the full litigation lifecycle, from the knowledge phase through appeals, liquidation, and enforcement.
The position combines legal drafting, hearing preparation, procedural strategy, technical evidence, and direct coordination with clients.
You will prepare defenses and appeals, analyze expert reports, and develop strategies for complex employment-law disputes.
Strong organization is essential to keep deadlines, tasks, provisions, and case documentation accurately managed.
The role is suited to a detail-oriented legal professional who can handle a substantial caseload while maintaining quality, consistency, and procedural rigor.

Accountabilities:

  • Draft defenses, procedural submissions, challenges, and appeals across all applicable instances of labor litigation.
  • Prepare detailed hearing scripts for correspondents, including legal arguments, mandatory objections, witness questions, and limits for settlement proposals.
  • Review hearing minutes, identify decisions and procedural points that were lost or omitted, and ensure relevant objections are reiterated in final arguments.
  • Act in liquidation and enforcement proceedings, including challenging calculations, preparing objections, and defending against asset blocking measures.
  • Prepare technical questions, analyze expert reports, and coordinate with technical assistants when required, particularly in matters involving unhealthy or hazardous working conditions.
  • Request, organize, and validate supporting information and documentation from clients to strengthen case strategy and procedural submissions.
  • Keep case-management records accurate and up to date, including tasks, deadlines, provisions, and relevant procedural information.
  • Manage a high-volume portfolio while prioritizing deadlines and maintaining consistency and quality across cases.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Law and active registration with the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB).
    • Professional experience in labor litigation, particularly representing defendants/respondents in high-volume portfolios.
    • Strong knowledge of the different stages of labor proceedings, including the knowledge, appeals, liquidation, and enforcement phases.
    • Experience with outsourcing and subsidiary or joint liability matters, including Súmula 331 of the TST, ADC 16, and Tema 246 of the STF.
    • Knowledge of culpa in vigilando and the specific legal considerations applicable to public-sector contracting parties.
    • Familiarity with evidentiary hearings and the preparation and execution of hearing strategies.
    • Experience handling technical evidence, including preparing expert questions, reviewing expert reports, and working with technical assistants in cases involving unhealthy or hazardous working conditions.
    • Experience operating legal case-management platforms with task, deadline, and case-control functionality.
    • Strong organization and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple cases and procedural deadlines.

      • Benefits

      • Remote work model.
      • Meal/food allowance (VR).
      • Remote work allowance.
      • Coparticipative medical insurance.
      • Childcare assistance.
      • OAB fee support/payment.
      • Opportunity to work with high-volume labor litigation and complex procedural matters.
      • Exposure to technology-enabled legal management and structured case workflows.
      • Collaborative and multidisciplinary professional environment.
      • Opportunity to develop expertise across the full lifecycle of labor litigation.

title: Product Owner (Remote)
description:
Who We Are - Motivated by Purpose. Powered by Clinical Expertise.


Founded in 1983, we’re a clinically-driven, tech-enabled utilization management company offering expert clinical reviews, regulatory guidance, and actionable insights to healthcare organizations.


Excellence starts with our people.


WE OFFER

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Benefits include healthcare, vision and dental insurance, a generous 401k match, paid vacation, personal time, and holidays.
  • Growth and training opportunities.
  • An award-winning remote work environment


﻿POSITION OVERVIEW

The Product Owner sits within the Product Organization and is accountable for product strategy, business requirements, roadmap planning, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, business readiness, and value delivery throughout the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC). This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders and the Engineering, Architecture, and QA organizations, ensuring solutions are clearly defined, aligned to business objectives, and deliver measurable value. The Product Owner owns the requirements and prioritization decisions within their portfolio while collaborating closely with Architecture on technical feasibility, Engineering on delivery, and QA on release readiness.


Roles:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap, requirements, UI design direction, business process definition, reporting and data requirements, and prioritization for an assigned portfolio of operations and utilization review tools
  • Serve as the accountable business owner for user acceptance testing, business readiness, and adoption of delivered solutions
  • Act as the primary point of consultation with the Architecture, Engineering, and QA organizations throughout the PDLC, per MRIoA's defined RACI operating model


Major Responsibilities or Assigned Duties:

  • Monitor progress against roadmap commitments and adjust priorities as business needs change

Demand Intake and Portfolio Management:

  • Manage the intake process for new requests and enhancements, assessing business value, complexity, urgency, and dependencies
  • Facilitate prioritization discussions with stakeholders and document decisions regarding scope, priorities, and funding
  • Maintain visibility into active, pending, and future initiatives, and ensure alignment between business demand and available delivery capacity

Business Requirements Management:

  • Lead requirements gathering sessions, discovery workshops, and business process reviews with stakeholders • Document current-state and future-state business processes, and define functional, UI, data, reporting, integration, and non-functional requirements in sufficient detail for development to begin without ambiguity
  • Ensure requirements are complete, testable, and approved prior to development, and maintain traceability between requirements, user stories, testing, and delivered functionality
  • Manage changes to requirements throughout the project lifecycle

Backlog and User Story Management:

  • Create and maintain product backlogs, and define epics, features, and user stories that meet MRIoA's user story standards (business objective, user role, functional description, acceptance criteria, UI and data requirements, dependencies, assumptions, and success criteria)
  • Prioritize backlog items based on business value, and participate in backlog grooming and sprint planning sessions with Engineering
  • Clarify requirements throughout development and testing activities

Timeline and Release Planning:

  • Define business priorities and delivery expectations, and collaborate with Engineering and QA on estimates and delivery plans
  • Establish milestone and release targets, monitor roadmap execution and timeline adherence, and communicate schedule changes and impacts to stakeholders
  • Coordinate business readiness activities for releases

Risk and Change Management:

  • Identify business, operational, compliance, and stakeholder risks; assess impacts of delays, scope changes, and resource constraints; and develop mitigation plans for critical initiatives
  • Assess business impacts of proposed changes, manage stakeholder communication plans, and support organizational readiness and training/adoption activities
  • Escalate risks affecting delivery or business outcomes

User Acceptance Testing (UAT):

  • Coordinate business participation in UAT and validate solutions against business requirements and acceptance criteria
  • Document business approvals and signoffs, facilitate defect review and prioritization with QA, and ensure business readiness prior to deployment

Release Readiness and Business Adoption:

  • Define release objectives and success measures, and coordinate stakeholder communication activities
  • Ensure training materials and job aids are available, validate operational readiness, and support production deployment activities
  • Measure adoption and business outcomes following release

Product Performance and Continuous Improvement:

  • Monitor product adoption and utilization, against business objectives
  • Gather stakeholder and user feedback, identify enhancement opportunities, and continuously improve products, processes, and user experience
  • Maintain long-term product strategy and roadmap for the assigned portfolio

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Consult with the Architecture organization on solution feasibility, technical standards, and nonfunctional requirements during discovery and design
  • Consult with the Engineering organization, including offshore development resources, during sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release planning; remain informed on vendor and offshore delivery governance, which is owned by Engineering
  • Consult with the QA organization on test strategy, acceptance criteria, and release readiness, and support QA-led production validation

Regulatory Compliance and Knowledge:

  • Possess a working knowledge of HIPAA, utilization review processes, and relevant healthcare regulatory requirements, ensuring compliance is reflected in business requirements

Requirements


﻿Skills:

  • Comfortable operating within a defined RACI model, collaborating with Architecture, Engineering, and QA organizations without owning their respective accountabilities
  • Working knowledge of Jira or similar tools for backlog management, sprint planning, and requirements traceability
  • Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting and dashboarding tools is preferred
  • Strong working knowledge of utilization review operations, healthcare regulatory requirements, and the Company's clients, products, and workflows


Experience:

  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Product Analyst
  • Experience in health insurance, healthcare, or managed care environments preferred; utilization management experience is a plus
  • Demonstrated ownership of a product backlog or roadmap and making prioritization decisions based on business value, risk, and cost
  • Strong experience writing detailed, testable business requirements (functional, UI, data, reporting, integration, and non-functional) and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Effectively coordinate UAT and business readiness activities, including stakeholder communication and training/adoption planning

﻿

﻿Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Product management or business analysis certification (such as CSPO, ECBA, or CCBA) is preferred but not required



Work Environment:

Ability to sit at a desk, utilize a computer, telephone, and other basic office equipment is required. This role is designed to be a remote position (work-from-home).

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Employees are required to adhere to all applicable HIPAA regulations and company policies and procedures regarding the confidentiality, privacy, and security of sensitive health information.

title: RPI - CAREER FAIR FULL-TIME ENTRY LEVEL OPPORTUNITIES
description:
If you are a team player and ready to kick start your career in a multi-disciplined Architecture/Engineering firm, Popli Design Group (PDG) is the place for you! PDG is seeking Junior Engineers, Architectural Designers, Survey Technicians, and Construction Inspectors to add to our growing and talented teams. With offices in Buffalo, Rochester, Binghamton, Albany, and NYC/NJ, our teams will match you to the best opportunity to set you up for a successful career journey.


Bridge Inspection, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will assist the Bridge Inspection Team Leaders in conducting inspections in the field. You will actively contribute to the inspection process, helping gather data and performing necessary tasks under the guidance of experienced professionals. Additionally, you will be responsible for conducting structural analyses of bridges to determine their capacity, utilizing your engineering knowledge and analytical skills.


Transportation Construction Inspectors

In this role, you will be responsible for inspecting the progress of basic construction operations (Earthwork, Pavement, Structural Components, Scaffolding…); Verify conformance of material with Standard Specifications by carrying out field tests (Concrete, Compaction…); Interpret documented characteristics of objects and materials used in construction; Recognize unsafe construction procedures and site conditions; Inspect erosion control and protection of environmental features and utilities; and identify measured and/or tested properties and provide appropriate notification(s) and Report(s).


Civil, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will assist in the areas of development of hydraulic or water distribution models, design calculations, etc. in support of comprehensive civil/site design projects under the guidance and support of licensed Engineers; Assist in the preparation of technical engineering documents, design plans, specifications, reports, and cost estimates; and assist in the preparation of comprehensive drawing packages using Civil 3D, Microstation, etc.


Structural, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will work on assignments that include design and analysis, modelling/drafting, preparing plans and specifications, technical report writing, cost estimating, and construction observation. Projects are typically in the municipal and academic/institutional sectors and range from new construction and large additions to structural investigations, condition assessments, capacity analysis, renovation, rehabilitation and strengthening of existing structures.

title: Sr. Technical Project Manager
description:
CourtAvenue is a company of industry experts accelerating digital transformation for the world’s most ambitious companies.
At CourtAvenue, you will be a part of a culture powered by entrepreneurs, technologists, data scientists and the habitually restless dedicated and energized to design products and services that transform businesses while optimizing them for growth. This Sr. Project Manager runs agile ceremonies — sprint planning, daily scrums, backlog refinement, retrospectives — across a co-delivery model that embeds client developers and designers directly on the team, and holds the program to its scope, budget, and gate-review schedule. Comfort with technical concepts (headless/composable CMS, API-driven integrations, data layer and analytics implementation) and confidence managing scope through formal change-request processes are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Own day-to-day delivery of a multi-workstream digital transformation program — platform/CMS build, design system, content, and phased migration — from mobilization through launch and stabilization

  • Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily scrums, backlog refinement, retrospectives) across a co-delivery model that embeds client developers and designers directly on the team
