title: Senior Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting Analyst
description:
Reports to: Senior Manager, Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting

Location: Remote Australia

Compensation Range: $150,000 to $170,000 AUD base plus bonus and equity

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M+ endpoints and 15M+ identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

What You’ll Do:

Members of the Huntress DE&TH team wake up every morning with the honor of impeding threat actors through a combination of detection engineering and threat hunting. This team sits alongside our 24x7 Security Operations Center, and our Adversary Tactics & Tactical Response function, and plays a pivotal role in detecting threats actors before they get a chance to impact our partner environments.

As a Senior Detection Engineering and Threat Hunting (DE&TH) Analyst you should be drawn to the hard problems: detecting stealthy intrusions, managing false positives and false negatives at scale, and uncovering clues that may expose an evolving campaign across Huntress partners. In this role you will turn threat intelligence, or a hypothesis, into detections that help the SOC find real intrusions faster. While the SOC is responding to alerts within minutes, this team is developing detections and reviewing more ambiguous signs of attacker activity on a daily & weekly basis.

On the Detection Engineering side of the role, you will play a part in designing, building, and maintaining a resilient, scalable, and high-fidelity detection portfolio that enables the SOC to rapidly identify and respond to adversary activity. This will involve working with engineering and other adjacent teams to achieve a shared goal across multiple domains which includes identities and endpoints.

On the Threat Hunting side of the role, you will get to research new attacker tradecraft, test new theories, and review hunting data at scale for millions of endpoints to proactively hunt for, and disrupt, stealthy threat actor techniques that evade initial defenses.

If you love Detection Engineering and Threat Hunting at scale, whilst in the environment and energy of a SOC, this is the role for you!

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to all parts of the detection lifecycle by creating new rules, testing them before deployment, monitoring efficacy, and tuning, promoting, or retiring rules based on their performance.
  • Develop rules across a variety of Huntress products and operating systems such as: Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Windows, Linux, and MacOS.
  • Manage any DE&TH requests raised internally or escalated from our partners.
  • Undertake hypothesis-driven hunts across Huntress telemetry, prioritising techniques and tradecraft that may evade high-fidelity detections and initial SOC review.
  • Consume threat intelligence and translate IOCs, TTPs, and internal findings into new or refined detections through Git-based workflows.
  • Build and refine hunting dashboards or queries required to surface potential intrusions.
  • Review ambiguous signs of attacker activity across Huntress products, and surface likely intrusions that require deeper investigation.
  • Investigate or escalate likely intrusions identified to ensure partners receive clear incident reports with accurate advice.
  • Contribute findings to community-driven projects and create Huntress content such as blogs, social posts, videos, podcasts, and webinars.
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to prototype queries, enrich analysis, and develop a scaffolding for detection rules, ensuring you apply sound judgment to validate the AI output. We expect everyone at Huntress to be able to use AI as a real part of how they work, not occasionally, but genuinely embedded in core workflows.

What You Bring To The Team:

  • 2+ years of experience in detection engineering, threat hunting, SOC, MDR, or incident response.
  • Intermediate knowledge of Windows internals.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, macOS, Microsoft 365, Azure, and Google Workspace.
  • Experience developing, testing, tuning, and documenting detections or analytics from threat intelligence, IOCs, hypotheses, or real-world investigations.
  • Ability to communicate findings through clear written reports.
  • Strong familiarity with detection languages such as Sigma, Suricata, Snort, or YARA, and query languages such as KQL, EQL, ES|QL, or Splunk SPL.
  • A sound understanding of adversary tradecraft, including techniques used for persistence, privilege escalation, defense impairment, lateral movement, discovery, and collection on a system.
  • A sound understanding of the roles different threat actors play and their associated goals, such as: initial access brokers, ransomware affiliates, and state-sponsored entities.
  • Ability to orchestrate reusable AI workflows that improve threat hunting, detection development, or analysis, and can verify AI-generated outputs before they reach production environments.

Bonus points for:

  • Intermediate knowledge of Linux and MacOS internals.
  • Hands-on experience using tools to remotely discover evidence of compromise such as OSquery, Velociraptor, and EDR/MDR/XDR platforms.
  • Previous use of forensic tooling such as Eric Zimmerman's EZ Tools, RegRipper, Hayabusa, or Chainsaw to analyze endpoint artifacts.
  • Intermediate malware analysis skills.

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote work
  • At least one annual trip to the US for Summer Summit, with additional local events in Australia!
  • New starter home office set up reimbursement ($800 AUD)
  • 12 weeks paid parental leave for both primary and secondary carers
  • Monthly digital allowance for personal phone and internet costs ($185 AUD)
  • Monthly home office tech stipend to upgrade or replace equipment ($40 AUD)
  • Subsidised private health insurance through our preferred provider
  • Stock options for all full-time employees
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

People from all culturally diverse backgrounds, including Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander Peoples, are encouraged to apply.

We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.

title: Airstream Attendant
description:
Why us?

Sage Hospitality Group is set to hire a Airstream Attendant to join us at the upcoming Indigo Raleigh in North Carolina!

As part of Sage Hospitality Group, we passionately strive to be the best and create excellence in everything we do. We believe in enriching lives one experience at a time. More than a slogan, we empower our employees to make positive impacts on the communities in which we live and work. By providing genuine service we build relationships with our guests and value for our shareholders, and we create unforgettable experiences.

We are looking for independent thinkers. Those who harness their entrepreneurial spirit so that it breaks preconceived notions. We’re not afraid to forge our own path. After all, it’s what industry leaders do. That’s why we welcome risk takers and creative spirits alike. No matter your daily role, Sage recognizes that your success is about more than the work you do—it’s really about who you are, which is why we invest in your personal and professional growth. We hope you consider joining us!

Job Overview

Run the Airstream through each daily service window, pouring coffee, pre-batched beverages, beer, and wine with accuracy, care, and genuine hospitality. The Airstream Attendant is a hands-on service role responsible for beverage execution, guest transactions, and the stocking and cleanliness of a standalone courtyard outlet. This associate works independently for most of the shift and is often the only Sage presence guests encounter in the courtyard. They are an ambassador of happiness and hospitality for all guests and associates.

Responsibilities

· Showcase an inherent desire to take care of others.

· Open, operate, and close the Airstream for each service window, including setup, stocking, breakdown, and securing product, cash, and equipment.

· Prepare and serve coffee, espresso, and tea beverages accurately, consistently, and in accordance with recipes and service standards.

· Pour pre-batched beverages, beer, and wine to spec, and verify identification on every alcohol sale in accordance with North Carolina ABC regulations.

· Engage guests warmly, guiding them through beverage and food offerings and providing thoughtful recommendations.

· Accurately enter orders, process payments, and follow all cash-handling and POS procedures, including drawer reconciliation at the close of each service window.

· Follow all safety, sanitation, and food handling guidelines in compliance with company standards and local regulations.

· Stock the outlet from the hotel kitchen and storeroom ahead of each service window, including product, ice, cups, and dry goods, rotating to par to limit waste.

· Follow batch labeling, dating, and rotation procedures, and remove any product that has passed its shelf life.

· Maintain cleanliness and organization of the trailer, service window, and surrounding courtyard, and return smallwares and batch containers to the hotel for washing.

· Communicate low par levels, equipment issues, and product needs to management before they affect service.

· Maintains a friendly, cheerful, and courteous demeanor at all times.

· Exhibits a kind, welcoming, detail-oriented approach with a strong sense of urgency.

Qualifications

Education/Formal Training

· High school diploma or equivalent.

Qualifications

· Must be at least 21 years of age in accordance with North Carolina ABC requirements. Entry-level role; previous cash handling, coffee, or hospitality experience preferred.

· Food handler certification and responsible alcohol seller/server training where required by state or local regulation.

Knowledge/Skills

· Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while holding service, cash-handling, and alcohol service standards.

· Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with guests and associates.

· Ability to read and follow recipes, tickets, and service instructions, and to learn coffee, beer, and wine product basics.

· Manual coordination to operate coffee and dispensing equipment, handle hot liquids and glassware, and prepare beverages efficiently.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

· Ability to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 50 lbs.

· Frequent bending, reaching, and repetitive hand and wrist motion throughout service, including pouring, stocking, and lifting cases and kegs.

· Continuous standing and movement within a confined trailer footprint, including repeated trips between the hotel and courtyard while carrying product.

· Ability to hear and respond effectively in a fast-paced, busy environment.

· Ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously with attention to detail.

Environment

· Physically demanding role performed in an outdoor courtyard setting and confined trailer workspace, with exposure to heat, cold, humidity, and precipitation. Split-shift availability required seven days per week, including weekends and holidays.

title: Solutions Architect, Commercial Midmarket
description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and committed support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated Solutions Architect to help accelerate customer adoption. This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the best and brightest engineers, architects and technical managers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies anywhere.

As a Solutions Architect in the AWS Commercial Midmarket group you will work directly with Small and Medium Business customers. We are looking for individuals who are motivated by the opportunity to work backwards from these customers' needs and help them gain competitive edge using AWS. As an experienced technologist and key member of the Account team you will help influence customers' architectural choices across broad use cases involving security, compute, storage networking as well as advanced scenarios involving serverless, analytics, and AI/ML.

As a part of the role, you will provide exceptional technical design guidance and thought leadership. You will lead efforts to capture and share best-practice knowledge with the AWS solution architect community. You will also gain the opportunity to learn from, collaborate with, and educate some of the brightest technical minds in the industry today across the breadth of enterprise architecture.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as a key member of the Solutions Architecture team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform.
- Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well-defined objectives and success criteria.
- Own each engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value.
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
- Understand the AWS market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.
- Understand and use of salesforce.com and other internal Amazon systems.


A day in the life
A typical day as an AWS Solutions Architect blends strategic customer engagements with technical deep-dives. You might start with a workshop helping a customer architect their generative AI solution, followed by collaborating with account teams to develop approaches for an upcoming migration project. After lunch, you'll lead a technical discovery session with a customer exploring analytics solutions, then spend time reviewing architectural designs and providing best practice guidance. The day might end with contributing to internal knowledge-sharing sessions or preparing for upcoming customer presentations. Each day brings unique challenges and opportunities to help customers innovate on AWS.



About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Director, IT & Enterprise
description:
Home Chef’s IT team is responsible for maintaining technology and enterprise systems that support our company goals and continued growth. The team supports our Chicago-based corporate office in addition to 4 national production facilities. Ideal candidates embody our tech team values: serving as proactive thought-partners to business stakeholders, encouraging their team to think bigger, taking full ownership of outcomes, and maintaining a fun, collaborative environment.

Detailed Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning:

  • Establish and execute the multi-year IT strategy and enterprise roadmap aligned with Home Chef’s growth objectives
  • Lead enterprise AI, automation, and data governance strategies, establishing guidelines that encourage practical AI adoption while protecting corporate data
  • Continually evaluate technical infrastructure, decommission redundant tools, and drive modern efficiency across systems
  • Maintain clear communication channels to provide leadership visibility into project roadmaps, resource allocation, and initiative progress

Operations & Support:

  • Maintain resilient networking infrastructure, targeting high uptime and proactively eliminating single points of failure across corporate and manufacturing locations
  • Oversee plant-floor technology systems across 4 facilities, including custom pick-to-light platforms, WMS, timekeeping systems, and access controls
  • Manage end-to-end hardware lifecycles for corporate laptops, plant-floor kiosks, scanning equipment, and network hardware from procurement through retirement
  • Implement robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions for both corporate staff and plant-floor teams
  • Oversee responsive helpdesk services, including structured on-call and off-hours support
  • Partner with operational teams to plan, install, and validate technology for facility expansions and new site launches

Enterprise System Management:

  • Maintain, integrate, and optimize key enterprise platforms (e.g., NetSuite, Google Workspace, Kronos, ADP, Concur, Greenhouse)
  • Act as a technical advisor to cross-functional leaders during the evaluation, selection, and rollout of new software applications
  • Oversee IT-specific spend within the enterprise software budget and negotiate vendor contracts
  • Drive SaaS governance to eliminate license sprawl and optimize software spend
  • Expand cross-platform automations and workflow optimizations (experience with Workato is a plus)

Security & Privacy:

  • Develop, maintain, and enforce cybersecurity policies, Zero Trust controls, Incident Response (IR) protocols, and Disaster Recovery (DR) plans
  • Collaborate with Kroger’s corporate IT security team to ensure Home Chef systems adhere to enterprise security and compliance standards
  • Conduct periodic vulnerability assessments, system audits, and penetration testing across corporate and plant environments
  • Monitor changing data privacy regulations and partner with legal to maintain operational compliance

Team Management:

  • Mentor, coach, and support professional growth for a team of IT administrators and support staff
  • Establish clear performance metrics, operational SLAs, and professional standards for the IT department
  • Build strong collaborative relationships across all departments, positioning IT as a consultative problem-solver
  • Continuously evaluate organizational structure to ensure proper coverage across corporate offices and distributed production facilities

Key Traits and Behaviors

  • Taking Ownership: We do whatever is necessary to get the job done - no job is too big or too small. We are willing to do any task at any level - and get our hands dirty (at a meal solutions company, sometimes we all have to do the dishes!). We work with speed, setting realistic but aggressive timelines. We do not allow lack of perfect to get in the way of progress.
  • Pragmatic, Next-level Thinker: We explore new methodologies and strategies and are not constrained by conventional thinking or ‘the way we have always done it’. We take calculated risks in order to learn and innovate with speed, or ‘test and learn’. We pride ourselves on using data and insights to drive practical decisions in our fast-paced environment.
  • Humble Team Player: We work collaboratively and effectively with colleagues, always putting company and team needs ahead of personal achievement. We are open to different points of view when weighing a decision, pulling in different people to provide fresh and unique perspectives.

Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability needed for this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities.

  • 3+ years experience running an IT team (10+ team members; manufacturing/operations/food environment a plus)
  • Experience managing $1M+ software budgets
  • Experience evaluating, negotiating, and implementing enterprise software contracts
  • Flexibility to travel up to 20% of the time
  • Flexibility to be on-call to support plant technology & employee needs
  • Up to one year of post-high school training such as in a business school, community college or vocational training

More About Us

Perks and benefits

  • Candidates can experience Home Chef as a customer - enter promo code PEOPLE30 for $30 off your first order!
  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance available
  • Paid holidays, sick time and vacation time
  • 401k program
  • Flexible spending accounts for qualified medical, dependent care, parking, or transit expenses

How We Work Together

We are humble team players.
We are warm and gracious with team members and customers. We seek feedback to improve ourselves - and respectfully listen to and accept input.

We are pragmatic next-level thinkers.
We come up with novel and unique ideas. We explore new strategies to avoid being constrained by conventional thinking.

We take ownership.
We approach ambiguous problems, prepared to dive in, get curious, and learn more. We are results-driven, always challenging ourselves to exceed goals.

Be at Home at Home Chef

We all show up authentically at Home Chef. Our team includes individuals with a variety of identities, backgrounds, and perspectives. You can trust that you’ll be able to bring your whole self to an inclusive and enjoyable workplace.

We welcome people of all races, colors, religions, national origin or ancestry, sex (including sexual identity), age, physical or mental disabilities, pregnancy, veteran or military status, unfavorable discharge from military service, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, arrest record or expunged/sealed convictions, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

Home Chef is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Home Chef will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact our People team at hr@homechef.com.

Home Chef offers the base salary range as posted below, with the exact offer depending on factors such as geographic location, experience, skills, and internal equity. title: MOBILE TECHNICIAN
description:
Nextran Truck Centers

MOBILE TECHNICIAN, Peoria, IL

Are you looking to further develop your profession into a career? Are you driven by opportunity?

Nextran Truck Centers is hiring!

Our Employees Benefit from:

Career Paths || Network of 30 Dealerships || Disability Insurance || Paid Time Off || Nextran Paid Life Insurance

Family Centered Values || Medical and Dependent Care FSA || 401(k) Retirement Plan with Match || Company-Paid Holidays || EAP

Great Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits || Social Responsibility Opportunities || 28+ Years of Industry Experience || Professional Growth

Mobile Service Technician

Bring your skills to the road and keep our customers moving! As a Mobile Service Technician with Nextran Truck Centers, you’ll take your expertise directly to the customer, providing hands-on service and repairs where they are needed most. You’ll diagnose problems, perform preventative maintenance, complete repairs, and get medium- and heavy-duty trucks back on the road safely and efficiently.

This is a great opportunity for a skilled technician who enjoys working independently, solving problems in the field, and interacting directly with customers. Every service call brings a new challenge, and your knowledge and experience will make a direct impact on our customers and their businesses.

If you’re an experienced technician who takes pride in quality workmanship, enjoys being on the move, and wants to be the person customers can count on when they need help, we want to hear from you!

Hourly Pay: $26–$40/hr., compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, certifications, education, and demonstrated skills.

Hours of Work: MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY – DAY SHIFT

Mobile Technician must be available to work Saturdays and Sundays as required to support business and operational needs.

CDL & DOT MEDICAL CARD REQUIRED: This position requires a valid Class A or Class B Commercial Driver’s License (CDL), as appropriate for the mobile service vehicle, and a current DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate (Medical Card). Candidates must also meet Nextran Corporation’s driver qualification and insurability requirements.

Apply Before: October 31, 2026

Candidates must successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening, background investigation, physical abilities assessment, and motor vehicle record (MVR) check.

What You’ll Do

  • Take your expertise on the road by traveling to customer locations and getting medium- and heavy-duty trucks back to work.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and solve problems using your technical knowledge and hands-on skills to identify the root cause and make the right repair.
  • Keep trucks performing at their best by completing preventative maintenance, inspections, and recommended service.
  • Tackle repairs from start to finish, including disassembly, repair, and reassembly of major truck components.
  • Work closely with our Parts Department to quickly identify and obtain the parts needed to keep repairs moving.
  • Build customer confidence through professional, knowledgeable, and courteous interactions at every service call.
  • Keep the team informed by communicating repair updates, additional service needs, and potential delays with the Service Advisor/Dispatcher.
  • Document your work with pride by providing accurate, detailed repair notes and recommendations.
  • Look beyond the immediate repair by identifying safety concerns, additional service needs, and opportunities to help customers avoid future downtime.
  • Support quality warranty repairs by properly saving and tagging parts when required.
  • Help develop the next generation of technicians by providing guidance and direction to Apprentice Technicians when assigned.
  • Take ownership of your tools and equipment by keeping company-owned tools, equipment, and technical manuals secure, organized, and in good condition.
  • Work safely and responsibly by following all safety procedures and immediately reporting equipment or safety concerns.
  • Stay ahead of the industry by keeping up with manufacturer technical bulletins, repair procedures, and evolving service requirements.
  • Protect our customers, our team, and the environment by following all applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including OSHA and hazardous waste requirements.
  • Jump in where needed and take on other responsibilities that help our customers and team succeed.

What We’re Looking For

  • Mack Master Technician certification and 4+ years of related experience and/or training preferred, but not required.
  • Hands-on experience working on diesel engines and medium- and heavy-duty commercial trucks.
  • Strong diagnostic, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to safety and quality.
  • Ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Valid Class A or Class B CDL REQUIRED.
  • Current DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate (Medical Card) REQUIRED.
  • Must maintain a satisfactory driving record and meet Nextran Corporation’s driver qualification and insurability requirements.
  • Ability to use computer systems and electronic applications for recordkeeping, communication, scheduling, diagnostics, and other job-related functions.
  • ASE and Cummins certifications are a plus.

Why Join Nextran?

At Nextran Truck Centers, you're not just repairing trucks—you're helping keep businesses moving. You'll have the opportunity to work directly with customers, tackle challenging repairs in the field, and use your skills where they make an immediate difference.

Ready to take your career on the road?

Apply today and join the Nextran team!

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies:

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Notice Regarding Job Posting Scams

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

We are a network of commercial truck dealerships committed to providing the best products and services through highly skilled associates who are focused on delivering the lowest life-cycle cost to our customers. Spanning the Southeast and Midwest United States, we provide sales, parts, and service for several leading brands, including Mack, Volvo, Isuzu, GMC, Ford, Hino, and Kalmar Ottawa. EEO Employer

title: CT Technologist - Per Diem
description:
Overview

Our team members are the heart of what makes us better. At Hackensack Meridian Health we help our patients live better, healthier lives — and we help one another to succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, our employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. It’s also about how we support one another and how we show up for our community. Together, we keep getting better - advancing our mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.

The CT Technologist performs computed tomography procedures and related techniques, producing sectional and three-dimensional images for the interpretation and assists with interventional and therapeutic procedures.

Responsibilities

A day in the life of a CT Technologist at Hackensack Meridian Health includes:

  • Performs complex CT procedures.
  • Evaluates radiographs to ensure that radiographs contain proper identification and are of diagnostic value.
  • Uses consistent and appropriate techniques to gather relevant information from the medical record, health care proxy and health care providers to prepare protocols for scanning and patient safety. The collection of information is determined by the patient's needs or condition.
  • Determines whether the patient has been appropriately prepared for the procedure.
  • Preps patient for scanning: (i.e. shielding, immobilization devices).
  • Assist providers with CT guided Interventional procedures as required.
  • Perform CT examination and administer contrast following established departmental protocols.
  • Provides accurate explanations and instructions at any appropriate time and at a level the patient can understand. Addresses and documents patient questions and concerns regarding the procedure when appropriate.
  • Performs venipuncture, IV patency, and maintenance procedures according to established guidelines.
  • Monitors the patient's physical condition during the procedure.
  • Reviews images to determine if additional scans will enhance the diagnostic value of the procedure.
  • Performs retrospective reconstruction on raw data.
  • Provides technical assistance and instruction to students, employees, and medical residents.
  • Adheres to the principals of image gently & image wisely.
  • Follow & adheres to infection control guidelines and sterile techniques.
  • Revises scanning parameters to better visualize the pathology in accordance with established protocol.
  • Reviews all diagnostic or therapeutic data for completeness and accuracy.
  • Documents diagnostic, treatment, and patient data in the appropriate record.
  • Archives images to data storage devices according to established guidelines.
  • Assesses equipment to determine acceptable performance based on established guidelines.
  • Performs daily clerical duties, which includes the use of EPIC, PACS, Teletracking System, computer system, patient scheduling, and other computer systems as added by hospital.
  • Greets all patients when they arrive for their exam utilizing AIDET standards.
  • Administers emergency care including performing CPR, if necessary.
  • Responsible for scheduled shifts including holidays and weekends.
  • Overtime as needed to provide continual quality patient care.
  • On call assignments as needed per Department of Radiology policy.
  • Adheres to the policy of Employee ID, Standards of Behavior, Attendance, and Punctuality.
  • Identifies the needs of the patient population served and modifies and delivers care that is specific to those needs (i.e., age, culture, language, hearing and /or visually impaired, etc.). This process includes communicating with the patient, parent, and/or primary caregiver(s) at their level (developmental/age, educational, literacy, etc.).
  • Adheres to the standards identified in the Medical Center's Organizational Competencies.
  • Performs modality specific daily and monthly QA.
  • Other duties and/or projects as assigned.
  • Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.
  • Lifts a minimum of 25 lbs., pushes and pulls a minimum of 50 lbs. and stands a minimum of 6 hours a day.

Qualifications

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • High School diploma, general equivalency diploma (GED), and/or GED equivalent programs.
  • Completion of an AMA approved school of Radiologic Technology.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient computer skills that may include but are not limited to Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite platforms.

Licenses and Certifications Required:

  • American Registry of Radiologic Technology (ARRT, CT) within 9 months of entering position
  • NJ state license for Diagnostic Radiology (D.R.)
  • AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification within 60 days of entering position

If you feel the above description speaks directly to your strengths and capabilities, then please apply today!

Minimum rate of $44.30 Hourly

  • Monitor emerging threats and security developments, assess their relevance to the company’s environment and recommend improvements to security tools, controls and procedures.

Qualifications

Experience / Education

  • 4 years of relevant experience in cyber security roles
  • Bachelor’s or equivalent work experience as a Security Engineer
  • Certification(s) such as CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+ or CompTIA CySA+ are preferred.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:

  • Working knowledge of network, server and mobile security, with hands-on experience configuring, maintaining and troubleshooting security technologies such as SIEM, firewalls, access control lists (ACLs), IDS/IPS, data loss prevention and mobile device management tools.
  • Practical experience administering and configuring endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools, maintaining endpoint protection policies and performing approved host isolation and remediation actions.

  • Practical experience configuring and maintaining security controls in cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure or AWS, including secure cloud configurations, logging and security monitoring.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access management, including multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, privileged access, account lifecycle management and access reviews.
  • Knowledge of system hardening and secure configuration baselines for endpoints, servers and network devices, including the ability to identify configuration drift and implement and test corrective changes using established procedures.
  • Knowledge of controls used to protect sensitive company information, including encryption, data masking and secure data handling, in accordance with established security policies and standards.
  • Ability to develop and maintain scripts using PowerShell, Python or similar tools to automate security tasks, support investigations and improve reporting.
  • Familiarity with security policies, standards and frameworks such as NIST, CIS or ISO 27001, including the ability to validate technical controls and gather evidence for audits.

This opportunity is well suited for a surgeon who values high-quality patient care, clinical autonomy, long-term practice development, and the opportunity to build a strong breast-focused surgical practice within an established private group.

The incoming surgeon will join an established surgical practice with experienced clinical and administrative infrastructure, strong referral relationships, and a collaborative physician environment.

The position offers the opportunity to develop a practice centered on breast surgery, while also maintaining a general surgery component based on the surgeon’s interests and the needs of the practice.

  • Existing breast surgery patient base
  • Experienced clinical and administrative support

  • Ability to maintain a general surgery component
  • Attractive South Florida market with continued population growth

  • Experience with Azure PaaS and integration services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Event Grid, Service Bus, Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and related services
  • Experience implementing observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Container Insights, dashboards, alerting, and operational runbooks

title: Principal Application Modernisation Architect
description:
An opportunity has become available for a senior technology specialist to play a leading role in the transformation of a large, business-critical application environment.
Working across architecture, engineering and business teams, you’ll help determine how a deeply established legacy platform can be progressively modernised without introducing unnecessary operational risk.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role rather than a purely advisory architecture position. You’ll be expected to understand how the existing application works, identify sensible boundaries for change, define modern service and API patterns, and help delivery teams move from architectural intent into working solutions.

What you’ll be responsible for

Shaping the modernisation approach
Take ownership of the technical approach for progressively transforming a large enterprise application environment.
You’ll assess how existing functionality, business processes, data dependencies and integrations are connected, then determine how the platform can be broken down and modernised in manageable stages.

Breaking down a complex legacy platform
Work through a highly interconnected Oracle-based application containing significant embedded business logic and long-standing dependencies.
Rather than attempting a wholesale replacement, you’ll help identify logical areas of functionality that can be separated, redesigned and progressively transitioned into a more modular architecture.

Designing the future application interfaces
Define how new services will interact with existing and future applications.
You’ll play a key role in API and interface design, including contracts, integration patterns, versioning and compatibility considerations, ensuring new capabilities can be introduced without unnecessarily disrupting existing consumers.

Creating a practical transition roadmap
Help determine what should change, when it should change and how individual pieces of the environment should move towards the desired architecture.
This will involve understanding technical dependencies, identifying delivery risks and helping teams sequence work in a way that supports continued operation of the existing platform throughout the transformation.

Turning architecture into deliverable solutions
Work beyond conceptual architecture and help translate the target state into designs that engineering teams can actually implement.
You’ll contribute to solution designs, technical reviews, implementation decisions, integration approaches and transition planning across multiple streams of work.

Managing legacy dependencies
Identify areas where applications, interfaces, data and business processes are tightly connected to the existing platform.
You’ll work with engineering teams to determine whether those dependencies should be retained temporarily, redesigned, isolated or removed as different parts of the environment are modernised.

Working across technical disciplines
Partner with software engineers, architects, data specialists, business SMEs and other technical leaders across the wider transformation.
You’ll often be the person joining the dots between different areas of the program and identifying technical consequences that may not be obvious within an individual workstream.

Using modern tooling to accelerate discovery
The program is also exploring the use of AI-assisted techniques to better understand and analyse complex legacy environments.
You’ll help determine how these capabilities can complement traditional application discovery and architecture activities while ensuring important design decisions remain grounded in business and technical context.

Providing technical direction
Act as a senior point of technical guidance when difficult modernisation decisions arise.
You’ll help stakeholders understand architectural options, dependencies and trade-offs and provide clear recommendations on approaches that are achievable within the realities of a complex production environment.

Establishing consistency across delivery
Help define the technical principles and review practices used across the transformation.
This could include architecture reviews, API and integration standards, solution-design guidance and assessing the wider impact of proposed changes before they move into delivery.
What we’re looking for We’re particularly interested in people who have worked on complex application transformation programs where modernisation has involved considerably more than simply moving infrastructure or upgrading technology.

What you’ll bring to this role
  • Strong experience modernising large, business-critical enterprise applications.
  • Previous exposure to complex Oracle-based application environments.
  • Experience breaking large or tightly coupled applications into more manageable services or components.
  • Strong application and solution architecture capability.
  • Practical experience designing enterprise APIs and integration patterns.
  • An understanding of domain-driven design, service-oriented architecture or similar application decomposition approaches.
  • Experience navigating complex dependencies between applications, data, integrations and business processes.
  • The ability to define a future-state architecture while recognising when an incremental or transitional design is the more practical option.
  • Experience guiding technical delivery across multiple teams or workstreams.
  • Strong software engineering and application-development knowledge.
  • The ability to communicate complex architectural decisions clearly to both technical and senior business stakeholders.
  • Experience providing design assurance, technical governance or architecture review across major technology programs.
  • A willingness to remain technically involved rather than operating solely at an enterprise strategy level.
Exposure to distributed cloud architectures, enterprise integration and large-scale transformation programs would also be valuable.

Why this opportunity?

The attraction of this role is the complexity of the problem.

You’ll be working with a platform that has evolved over many years and sits at the centre of important business processes. The challenge is not simply replacing technology; it is understanding where functionality belongs, how systems should interact and how a large organisation can progressively move towards a more modern architecture without destabilising critical operations.
For someone who enjoys solving difficult legacy-modernisation problems, influencing architecture and remaining close enough to the technology to see those decisions implemented, this provides considerable scope to make an impact.

title: Configuration Management Site Lead
location: San Luis Obispo, California, United States
description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology - solving complex challenges that matter.

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

Position Overview

The Configuration Management Site Lead/Supervisor reports to the Senior Configuration Manager and serves as the local extension of enterprise CM leadership at an assigned operating site. This position leads and governs Configuration Management activities throughout the product lifecycle, supervises CM personnel, coordinates site workload, and ensures site execution aligns with enterprise policies, program objectives, contractual requirements, and industry standards.

Operating with minimal supervision, the Site Lead/Supervisor partners with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Operations, Software, and Program Management to maintain configuration integrity from concept and development through production, delivery, and sustainment. This position also represents the CDM function to leadership, customers, government representatives, suppliers, and auditors.

The Day-to-Day

  • Supervise site CM personnel by assigning work, setting priorities, monitoring performance, providing technical direction, and supporting employee development.
  • Serve as the primary site authority for hardware, software, firmware, documentation, and product-data configuration management while representing enterprise CM direction at the local level.
  • Provide recurring site and program status to the Senior Configuration Manager, including baseline health, change activity, implementation progress, audit readiness, data integrity, staffing and workload, performance metrics, risks, and decisions requiring escalation.
  • Lead configuration identification, baseline management, change control, configuration status accounting, data management, implementation verification, product release, and configuration audits.
  • Participate in enterprise CM reviews, planning, process standardization, and continuous-improvement activities; implement enterprise direction at the site and elevate local issues for resolution.
  • Coordinate site CM staffing, schedules, resources, and deliverables while escalating risks, constraints, and compliance concerns to leadership.
  • Lead CM support for proposals and program planning by reviewing Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Statements of Work (SOWs), contracts, specifications, and technical requirements.
  • Define CM scope, deliverables, staffing, schedules, risks, and defensible Bases of Estimate (BOEs) for hardware, software, firmware, and data-management activities.
  • Evaluate prime and subcontract documentation to identify CM responsibilities, risks, dependencies, and required flow-downs-even when CM is not explicitly identified.
  • Ensure alignment and traceability among requirements, drawings, specifications, engineering and manufacturing bills of material, software baselines, work instructions, manufacturing records, and delivered configurations.
  • Lead or support Configuration Control Boards (CCBs) and Software Configuration Control Boards (SCCBs), ensuring changes are evaluated, approved, implemented, verified, and incorporated into affected baselines and records.
  • Oversee the effective use of PLM, PDM, ERP, MES, QMS, requirements-management, and software-development systems to strengthen data governance and digital-thread continuity.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, systems engineering, business, information management, or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum of seven years of progressive experience in configuration management, engineering, product data management, or manufacturing within aerospace, defense, or another regulated industry.
  • Minimum of two years of leadership or supervisory experience, including assigning work, establishing priorities, mentoring personnel, and managing performance.
  • Experience applying configuration management principles across hardware, software, firmware, documentation, and integrated systems.
  • Ability to interpret contracts, RFPs, SOWs, specifications, technical requirements, and supplier flow-down requirements.
  • Working knowledge of applicable standards and regulations, including EIA-649, AS9100, ISO 9001, MIL-HDBK-61, ITAR, and EAR.
  • Strong leadership, communication, organization, decision-making, and cross-functional problem-solving skills.
  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supervising CM personnel in a multi-program or multi-site organization.
  • Systems-thinking skills and experience supporting integrated hardware, software, firmware, requirements, and manufacturing data.
  • Knowledge of systems engineering processes, technical reviews, product-development lifecycles, production readiness, and sustainment.
  • Experience developing proposal inputs, staffing plans, schedules, work breakdown structures, and BOEs.
  • Experience supporting government contracts, customer audits, and contractual data deliveries.
  • Experience with SolidWorks PDM or comparable PLM/PDM platforms.
  • Experience implementing CM metrics, process automation, or digital-thread improvements.
  • Professional certification or formal training in Configuration Management, Systems Engineering, quality management, or project management is preferred.
Pay range for this role
$125,000—$148,000 USD

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.
  • 401k with company-match
  • 3 weeks of paid time off each year

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

  • Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!

title: Billing & Collections Specialist
description:

You will work closely with finance, billing, operations, and customer-facing teams to ensure accurate and timely customer billing.
The role combines customer communication, payment processing, account monitoring, credit risk assessment, and collections management.
You will help maintain strong customer relationships while supporting the organization’s financial health through proactive collections efforts.
The position also offers opportunities to improve processes, document workflows, and introduce automation to increase operational efficiency.
You will use modern billing platforms, data analysis tools, credit reporting resources, and AI technologies to streamline day-to-day activities.
This is a 100% remote opportunity suited to someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, and growth-oriented environment.

  • Take on additional responsibilities and projects as needed to support team and organizational objectives.

    • Requirements

    • Experience working for a telecommunications or IT services organization is preferred.
    • Experience processing circuit and service disconnect requests is preferred.
    • Experience using billing systems such as NetSuite or similar platforms.
    • Familiarity with credit reporting and risk management tools such as Creditsafe or Dun & Bradstreet is preferred.
    • Experience using AI tools such as Claude or similar platforms to improve workflow efficiency is preferred.
    • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to manipulate, analyze, and interpret datasets.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

    • Strong time-management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize competing tasks and multitask effectively.
    • Collaborative, team-oriented approach with respect for colleagues and customers.
    • Willingness to support additional projects and responsibilities as business needs evolve.
    • Proactive mindset with the ability to embrace change, identify improvements, and contribute new ideas.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, rapidly growing, startup-style environment.

title: Field Organizer
description:

The Massachusetts Voter Table (MVT), a fiscally sponsored project of Third Sector New England, Inc (TSNE) (www.tsne.org). Everyone deserves a voice in our democracy. The Massachusetts Voter Table (MVT) integrates nonpartisan voter engagement with grassroots organizing to build long-term community power. Together with our coalition of more than 40 member organizations, we work to ensure that communities of color, working-class people, new citizens, young people, and other historically underrepresented communities have the resources, representation, and power to shape the future of Massachusetts.

Responsibilities

The Field Organizer will be responsible for various tasks focused on engaging with field staff at partner organizations to support their community engagement and capacity building. The Field Organizer should be eager, flexible, and passionate about civic engagement.

Essential Functions

  • Maintain regular contact with partner organizations by phone and email about upcoming events and deadlines.
  • Plan and manage voter contact events, such as phone banks and canvasses, with local organizers and leaders.

  • Communicate progress of goals to partner organizations for accountability to collective goals.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to partner organizations’ usage of data, tools, and resources, such as the Voter Activation Network, Action Network, predictive dialers, and peer-to-peer texting.
  • Train and manage partner organizational leaders and volunteers.
  • Knock on doors and make phone calls.
  • Represent MVT in selected coalitions and working groups, as assigned by the Field Director.
  • Assist in organizing major projects and events, including those focused on voter equity, voter registration, and voter rights, as well as rallies, field visits, and other events, as needed.
  • Provide guidance and support to MVT organizing fellows and interns, answering questions and connecting them to resources as needed.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned by the Field Director.

Qualifications

We will consider exceptional candidates who demonstrate a strong combination of the specific qualifications and skills described below.

  • Experience working for or volunteering with a campaign or grassroots non-profit
  • Experience volunteering or working for a democracy organization or activist group is valued, but not required
  • Great time management and organization skills
  • Ability to manage and juggle competing priorities
  • Excellent listening skills and ability to communicate effectively both in writing and verbally
  • Background in managing volunteer teams, holding individuals accountable to goals, and coordinating between multiple stakeholders
  • Ability to adapt in a changing and metrics-driven work environment
  • Enthusiasm for community-based outreach
  • A positive, solutions-oriented attitude
  • Foreign language skills are highly desired, especially Spanish

  • Job is not subject to significant occupational or environmental hazards;
  • Likelihood of personal injury would be relatively slight;
  • Environmental and work hazards are not present to a measurable degree.

Compensation and Benefits

Location: Work will be primarily performed HYBRID.

Compensation: The starting salary for this position is $58,000- $60,000 and is commensurate with experience.

Benefits: This position is eligible for a full benefits package including:

  • Generous Paid-Time-Off (PTO): twelve paid holidays, three weeks of vacation, one week of personal holiday, and ability to accrue up to 487.5 hours of health leave time for benefited staff.
  • 80% Employer-paid, offering some $0 deductible Health Insurance through Harvard Pilgrim along with several low-deductible plans;

title: Network Specialist, Senior
description:
Overview

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and implement robust network systems, including LAN, MAN, and WAN infrastructures.
  • Direct the compilation, analysis, and management of records and reports related to network operation and maintenance activities.

    • Cisco Certified Security Professional (CCSP)

Minimum Skills:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

title: Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D based in Spain.

As a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D, you’ll help evolve a live mobile game by building new gameplay systems, LiveOps features, and scalable technical solutions.
You’ll work across the full development lifecycle, from implementing new mechanics to improving architecture, performance, stability, and maintainability.
A strong focus of the role is on modern AI-assisted development, with opportunities to integrate AI agents into real production workflows and automate recurring engineering tasks.
You’ll investigate real-world production issues using telemetry and profiling data, ensuring a smooth experience across a wide range of mobile devices.
The role also offers significant technical ownership, including participation in architectural decisions, code reviews, optimization initiatives, and development practices.
You’ll collaborate closely with other technical and product-focused team members while contributing ideas that can improve both engineering efficiency and the game itself.
This is an R&D-oriented opportunity for a developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, experimenting with new tools, and seeing their work make a measurable product impact.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain gameplay systems and features using Unity and C# within a released mobile game, while evolving architecture and reducing technical debt.
  • Implement and maintain LiveOps functionality, including events, promotions, seasonal content, and A/B testing.
  • Work with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, and Remote Configs to enable content and feature updates without requiring a full application release.
  • Actively use AI agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent tools in day-to-day development on a real production codebase.
  • Create and maintain internal AI skills, rules, and agent instructions that automate recurring team workflows while taking responsibility for the quality of generated results.
  • Investigate and resolve ANRs, crashes, freezes, OOM issues, and other production problems using real telemetry and diagnostic data.
  • Optimize CPU usage, memory consumption, startup time, application size, and downloadable content for different classes of Android devices.
  • Integrate and maintain advertising, analytics, monetization, and third-party SDKs while ensuring tracking and event implementation remain accurate.
  • Conduct code reviews and contribute to important technical and architectural decisions.
  • Share effective AI-assisted development practices and help improve the team's engineering workflows.
  • Profile and optimize Android and iOS applications using tools such as Unity Profiler, Crashlytics, and Android Vitals.
  • Investigate performance regressions and follow complex technical issues from symptoms through root-cause analysis, implementation, and validation of results.
  • Consider product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV when evaluating technical and gameplay decisions.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of commercial experience with Unity and C#, including experience working on released mobile games and supporting projects through LiveOps rather than only developing them prior to launch.
    • Strong understanding of Unity project architecture, including design patterns, dependency injection with tools such as Zenject or VContainer, asynchronous programming with UniTask, Unity lifecycle, memory management, and garbage collection.
    • Practical experience with AI development agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, including the ability to decompose tasks, provide appropriate context from large codebases, and validate generated code.
    • Experience with MCP, including Unity MCP or similar approaches, as well as skills, rules, and agent-instruction workflows.
    • Ability to document team development practices in a way that allows AI agents to reproduce them consistently.
    • Hands-on experience with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, Remote Configs, versioning, caching, and fallback scenarios.
    • Strong profiling and optimization experience across Android and/or iOS, including investigation of ANRs, crashes, OOM issues, and production performance regressions.
    • Understanding of low-end Android devices, device fragmentation, and mobile build-size optimization.
    • Experience integrating third-party SDKs for advertising, analytics, and in-app purchases.
    • Familiarity with Git workflows, code review practices, and CI/CD.
    • Ability to take a complex technical problem from symptom identification through root-cause analysis, solution implementation, and verification of the outcome.
    • Understanding of product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to technical challenges.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions, and communicate complex engineering topics clearly.
    • Experience in an R&D-oriented environment is advantageous.
    • Professional Ukrainian language proficiency is expected.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work within Europe, with remote-first flexibility.
      • Personal benefit budget that can be allocated toward insurance, education, fitness, or other areas supporting personal wellbeing.
      • Performance-based bonuses recognizing meaningful results, initiative, and contribution to team success.
      • High level of autonomy with minimal bureaucracy and the opportunity to influence technical and product decisions.
      • Professional development through learning opportunities, internal training, and strategic sessions.
      • Opportunity to work with modern AI-assisted development tools and contribute to innovative engineering practices.
      • Collaborative team environment focused on shared ownership and collective results.
      • Direct opportunity to contribute to the evolution of a live mobile game and its underlying technology.
      • Full-time position within a Gameplay Development environment.

title: Interim Assistant Controller (Commercial Real Estate)
description:
Remote Employee BPO has an outstanding opportunity for you!

Role: Interim Assistant Controller (Commercial Real Estate)
Compensation: Competitive Basic Salary
Work Schedule: 5-day work week, 12:00 a.m. 9:00 a.m. Philippine time
Target Start Date: October 12, 2026﻿
Work Setup: WFH﻿
Important Notes: 4 months initial assignment and may extend up to 6 months.
﻿
﻿﻿
Responsibilities:
﻿﻿﻿﻿

Monthly Reporting and Financial Review

  • Review property-level financials prepared by third party operators for accuracy, completeness, and proper coding before release
  • Deliver monthly operating reports (MORs) to capital partners on a fixed schedule, with due dates ranging from the 10th of the month through the 25th across six deals and four institutional partners
  • Prepare quarterly reporting packages on an accelerated 5th business day timeline for two of those deals
  • Provide GL coding guidance to third party operators on expense classification as questions arise
  • Place assets in service quarterly, calculate depreciation, and provide entries to third party operators for recording
  • Produce supporting schedules and maintain organized close support files and MOR archives
  • Distribute loan statements to the property management partner on the applicable deal


Capital Calls, Draws, and Treasury

  • Prepare capital calls as needed to fund construction draws and other operating expenses
  • Push down funding from the fund entity to JV accounts, and from JV accounts to property operating accounts
  • Route draw packages to third party operators for payment, track payment status, and chase down delays
  • Initiate ACH and wire transfers as needed


Distributions and Fees

  • Produce cash analyses supporting distribution decisions
  • Prepare distribution memos and supporting schedules
  • Issue distribution packages to third party operators for payment
  • Prepare quarterly incentive fee invoices as needed


Accounts Payable and Corporate Card

  • Route property expense invoices to the correct 3rd party operator for payment, with coding guidance as needed
  • Route corporate invoices to the outsourced bill pay provider
  • Route tax and insurance invoices to the lender for payment where applicable
  • Circulate monthly AMEX statements and QBO reports for payment; prepare the quarterly AMEX chargeback allocation to properties
  • Pay annual registered agent and entity maintenance fees (CT Corp, CSC, Vcorp)


Audit and Tax Support

  • Compile and coordinate audit support for four separate audits, including three property or JV level audits and the fund entity, working with third party operators and delivering to the external audit firm
  • Provide requested tax return support to the external tax firm
  • Prepare and transmit quarterly tax projection reporting for JV partners, including partner-specific projection packages


Investor, Lender, and Partner Reporting

  • Produce and distribute quarterly JV reporting
  • Produce and distribute quarterly lender reporting
  • Produce and distribute quarterly non-profit partner reporting
  • Tie-out sources and uses worksheets at the JV level on a quarterly basis


Administrative

  • Monitor incoming mail, scan and distribute to the appropriate parties
  • Coordinate physical delivery of checks for deposit as needed

﻿Qualifications:﻿

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. CPA, or the Philippine CPA equivalent, strongly preferred
  • Minimum 7 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 4 years in commercial real estate. Experience gained supporting US-based real estate owners, operators, or funds is required
  • Demonstrated ownership of a monthly close cycle end to end, including review of work prepared by others rather than only preparing entries
  • Hands-on experience with joint venture and fund structures: capital calls, capital contributions and distributions, waterfall and promote mechanics at a working level, and push-down funding between fund, JV, and property entities
  • Experience reviewing property-level financials prepared by third party property managers, including the ability to spot miscoded expenses, missing accruals, and variances worth questioning
  • Working knowledge of fixed assets and CAPEX: placed-in-service determinations, depreciation schedules, and construction draw processes
  • Experience preparing or coordinating audit support packages for external auditors, and supporting external tax preparers with return workpapers and quarterly projections
  • Familiarity with lender reporting requirements and loan covenant or draw compliance reporting
  • Track record of meeting recurring, externally imposed deadlines across multiple entities simultaneously

﻿

Communication, Client Service, and Working Style:﻿

  • Native or near-native written English. Correspondence goes directly to institutional investors, lenders, auditors, and property operators. Emails must be concise, correctly formatted, and free of errors
  • Proactive follow-up. A large share of the workload is chasing: draw payments that have not cleared, audit items outstanding with an operator, coding questions unanswered. The person in this seat must track open items and pursue them without being reminded
  • Comfortable directing people who do not report to them. Third party operators and outside firms must be guided, sequenced, and held to deadlines through influence rather than authority
  • Escalates early and accurately. Knows the difference between a problem to solve and a problem to raise, and raises it with a recommendation attached
  • Multitasking under fixed deadlines. Six reporting deadlines land between the 10th and the 25th of each month, overlapping with quarterly close, audit cycles, and ad hoc capital activity. The ability to sequence work and protect the deadlines is essential
  • Discretion. Handles partner-level financial information, distribution data, and compensation-adjacent detail; strict confidentiality is expected
  • Adaptable to a fast pace. Capital calls, draws, and wires arrive with short notice and must be turned around same day or next day

Preferred, Not Required:

  • Big 4 or large regional firm background, particularly in real estate assurance or tax
  • Prior experience supporting a US real estate sponsor from an offshore or shared services team
  • Experience with affordable housing, LIHTC, or public agency and non-profit partner reporting
  • Familiarity with Juniper Square or a comparable investor portal
  • Prior work in an interim or leave-coverage capacity, with a demonstrated ability to absorb a workload quickly and hand it back cleanly

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:

The CSFC Systems Engineer would assist and support with the development, configuration, testing, and evaluation of Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC) solutions used to secure government customers' classified data and networks. The Engineer will work individually and as a member of a team to configure network, software, and hardware networking components and security appliances and applications to meet DoD requirements and support their installation and initialization onsite in the customers' environments.

  • Architecting Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC) compliant solutions that meet NSA, DoD, and customer requirements.

  • Be able to develop and modify system scripts.
