title: Senior Director - IT Infrastructure and Cybersecurity
description:
The Senior Director, IT Infrastructure and Cybersecurity, is a senior technology leader accountable for the strategy, architecture, management and continuous improvement of Codexis Infrastructure services and Cybersecurity operations. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical judgment and people leadership, translating business priorities into secure, reliable and scalable capabilities across networks, cloud, servers, storage, endpoints and application infrastructure.


The successful candidate will partner across the business, guide infrastructure investment and work allocation, and ensure services are operated with appropriate resilience, security and accountability. The role also provides infrastructure leadership for enterprise Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities and partners with IT and Business stakeholders to govern AI data access, AI architecture and tool deployment, AI agents and associated risks.

  • Set infrastructure strategy and architecture: Define and maintain a forward-looking roadmap for network, cloud, server, storage, endpoint and application infrastructure aligned with Codexis IT and Business priorities.
  • Lead reliable infrastructure and end user services operations: Oversee service expectations, operating practices and accountability for the availability, performance, capacity, and lifecycle of infrastructure services.
  • Develop the team and operating model: Set priorities and work allocation; coach employees and partners; contribute to performance discussions; clarify roles; and build the skills needed for current and future IT demands.
  • Manage partners, investments and risk: Oversee infrastructure vendors and service providers, contribute to contract and budget decisions, communicate risk and performance, and recommend investments based on business value and lifecycle needs.
  • Direct network and perimeter capabilities: Oversee network architecture and management, including connectivity, segmentation, remote access, perimeter services and protection of critical environments.
  • Advance cloud and Microsoft platforms: Lead cloud architecture and management, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 infrastructure, identity, endpoint and security dependencies.
  • Lead AI infrastructure and platform governance: Establish the infrastructure architecture, approved platform patterns, environment controls, integration standards, capacity planning, observability and support model for enterprise AI services and agent platforms.
  • Govern AI agents and lifecycle: Maintain visibility of AI agents and their owners; define intake, risk-tiering, development, testing, approval, publishing, change, monitoring, reassignment and retirement expectations; and ensure production agents have accountable ownership and support.
  • Strengthen AI data governance and security: Partner with Business and Information Technology team to develop and enforce data classification, least-privileged access, approved data-source and connector controls, retention, privacy, intellectual-property, auditability and data-loss-prevention requirements to AI solutions.
  • Oversee AI security and operational risk: Coordinate threat modeling, security review, identity and secrets management, vulnerability management, logging, incident response and business continuity for AI services and agents, including risks arising from excessive permissions, unsafe actions, unapproved integrations and sensitive-data exposure.
  • Govern endpoint, server and storage platforms: Guide architecture, standards, lifecycle planning and operational performance for endpoints, servers and storage.
  • Enable application infrastructure: Partner with application owners and business teams to deliver secure, supportable and scalable infrastructure for enterprise and scientific applications.
  • Embed security and resilience: Provide cybersecurity leadership, oversee existing Managed Security Service Provider services, and incorporate network, endpoint, server, identity, data protection, vulnerability management, incident response and recovery requirements into infrastructure design and operations.
  • Lead incident and problem management: Provide executive-level direction during significant infrastructure or security events, drive investigation and restoration, and ensure corrective actions reduce recurrence.
  • Establish governance and metrics: Maintain architecture standards, service documentation, asset visibility, technology roadmaps and meaningful measures for reliability, security, delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate with senior stakeholders: Translate technical options, constraints and risks into clear business recommendations for executives and cross-functional leaders.

  • Experience leading infrastructure strategy and operations across multiple domains such as networks, cloud, servers, storage, endpoints and application infrastructure.
  • Experience translating business requirements into infrastructure architecture, roadmaps, standards and prioritized investments.
  • Experience leading teams and external service providers, including work allocation, coaching, performance input and capability development.
  • Experience managing Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 infrastructure or comparable enterprise cloud and productivity platforms.
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Purview, identity protection, AI security controls or adjacent Microsoft security capabilities.
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, agent administration, Power Platform governance, AI risk-management frameworks or comparable enterprise AI platforms and controls.
  • Experience directing major incidents, technical investigations, service restoration and durable corrective actions.
  • Experience defining and integrating cybersecurity, identity, vulnerability management, data protection, business continuity and disaster recovery requirements into infrastructure decisions.
  • Experience communicating technical risk, service performance and investment recommendations to senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • A combination of education and experience appropriate to the role, such as a bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 15+ years of related experience.

Additional experience that would be valuable for this role includes:

  • Experience supporting infrastructure in a biotechnology, life sciences, laboratory, manufacturing or other regulated environment.
  • Experience with formal architecture, service management, risk or cybersecurity frameworks and controls.
  • Experience modernizing hybrid infrastructure, increasing automation, improving observability or advancing cloud operating models.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud, networking, infrastructure, service management, cybersecurity or enterprise architecture.
  • Experience with vendor negotiations, financial planning and lifecycle-based technology investment.
  • Experience governing enterprise AI platforms or automation solutions, including data access, identity, connectors, lifecycle controls, monitoring, security review and cross-functional risk decisions.

title: ANALISTA DE CRM JR
description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de CRM Jr. altamente detalhista, orientado(a) a processos e com forte senso de responsabilidade operacional. Sua principal missão será garantir a execução impecável, a mensuração e a higiene de fluxos e campanhas de régua de relacionamento (e-mail, SMS e multicanal), operando plataformas de automação (foco em Marketo Engage) com foco total na qualidade das entregas.

Se você é uma pessoa curiosa, que ama processos bem estruturados, tem extrema atenção aos detalhes e entende a importância de cada elo na cadeia de comunicação com o cliente, esta vaga é para você.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Configurar, testar e agendar campanhas de e-mail, SMS e comunicações multicanal na plataforma Marketo Engage (ou equivalentes), seguindo rigorosamente o briefing aprovado.
  • Criar e manter Smart Campaigns, Smart Lists e Programs utilizando a lógica de filtros e triggers definida pelo time de estratégia.
  • Apoiar a configuração de landing pages e formulários de captura vinculados aos fluxos de automação.
  • Executar rigorosamente o checklist de QA pré-disparo: validação de links, parametrização de UTMs, personalização de campos com fallback, segmentação, definição de remetente, botões de opt-out, textos legais e verificação de blacklists.
  • Monitorar o desempenho e a entregabilidade das campanhas nas janelas de 1 hora e 24 horas após o disparo, reportando qualquer anomalia imediatamente ao Analista Pleno/Liderança.
  • Executar a manutenção e higiene contínua da base de contatos: tratamento de bounces, sincronização de opt-outs e atualização de campos de perfil.
  • Apoiar a parametrização de Lead Scoring com base nos critérios definidos pelo Estrategista Sênior.
  • Documentar detalhadamente as configurações, fluxos e o histórico de alterações realizadas nas plataformas.
  • Atualizar o status de todas as tarefas nas ferramentas de gestão de atividades ao final de cada dia, garantindo visibilidade total do pipeline para o time.

Requisitos

  • Plataformas de Automação: Experiência prévia na operação de plataformas de automação de marketing (Marketo Engage é um grande diferencial; aceitamos experiência em SFMC, RD Station, HubSpot, Insider ou similares).
  • Gestão de Campanhas: Vivência na configuração de fluxos de e-mail (criação de templates, personalização dinâmica de campos, remetente e agendamento).
  • Lógica de Segmentação: Domínio de filtros de listas por comportamento, dados demográficos e histórico de interação.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Conhecimento em estruturação de UTMs e leitura analítica de relatórios de campanha (Taxa de Abertura, CTOR, Bounce Rate, Opt-out Rate).
  • HTML Básico: Conhecimento técnico básico em HTML para identificação e correção de pequenos erros de renderização em templates de e-mail.
  • Gestão de Tarefas: Domínio no uso e atualização diária de ferramentas como Asana, Corework, Trello, Jira ou equivalentes.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação oficial em plataformas de automação de marketing (ex: Adobe Certified Professional - Marketo Engage).
  • Noções de entregabilidade de e-mail (IP warming, SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

Na VML, estamos comprometidos em promover um ambiente de trabalho totalmente inclusivo que seja gratificante e que impulsione a carreira. Acreditamos na criação de um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico que valorize a diversidade e a inclusão e nos esforçamos para recrutar uma lista diversificada de candidatos para nos ajudar a atingir esse objetivo. Teremos o prazer de fornecer adaptações razoáveis a pessoas com deficiência que precisem de uma adaptação para usar ou acessar o site de carreiras da VML ou para participar plenamente do processo de candidatura. Caso necessite de uma adaptação para concluir a sua candidatura ou outro aspeto do nosso processo de recrutamento devido a uma deficiência, entre em contato com o nosso departamento de Recursos Humanos ou envie um e-mail para (contato de RH) para solicitar uma adaptação.

Nestes documentos, explicamos como tratamos os seus dados pessoais no âmbito do processo de candidatura, bem como a forma como poderá atualizar ou remover as informações que nos forneceu.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. title: CA Datacom/DB DBA - Mainframe | Remote
description:

  • Assist with mainframe database migration activities
  • Troubleshoot complex database, application and performance issues

title: Senior Systems Engineer - Tomahawk Weapons System
description:
Overview

SimVentions is 100% employee-owned and has consistently been voted one of Virginia's Best Places to Work! We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to serve alongside a high-functioning team of engineers supporting the design of TTWCS software (e.g., requirements, capabilities, enhancements, interface documents, architecture).

Travel

none anticipated

Clearance

An ACTIVE Secret Clearance is required for this position. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. US Citizenship is required to obtain a clearance.

Requirements

  • 10 years of systems engineering experience (20 years if no degree) focused on requirements development and management of software systems. This includes experience related to the identification, analysis, and documentation of complex systems involving DoD weapon and/or fire control systems.
  • Two (2) years of concurrent experience with Navy surface or submarine shipboard weapons and/or fire control systems to include current Navy programs such as Tomahawk or other related missile and weapon control systems.
  • Experience in requirements definition as well as initial and detailed system design activities
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office.

Responsibilities

  • Review, analyze, and provide inputs for external interface documents. Serve as document custodian of external interface documents by making document updates, adjudicating comments against the document, and maintaining Configuration Management (CM)

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Logistics Specialists play a vital role in the success of Amazon Web Services by providing the right part, in the right place at the right time. Your contribution to this success would be maintaining the onsite parts room in AWS Data Centers, by managing the custody of computer hardware through their entire lifecycle. This involves receiving parts, safely storing parts, picking and delivering parts to hardware technicians, cycle counts, and shipping faulty hardware back to the vendor.

You will work closely with Data Centre Operations and Engineering teams to ensure reliable functioning and repair activities to support our customers, while adhering to our operational tenants of safety, security and availability.

Key job responsibilities
- Maintaining inventory to ensure that proper stock levels are managed to support build and repair activities.
- Physically receiving and issuing out of parts as needed for internal customers.
- Loading, unloading and transporting parts between different sites.
- Keeping accurate stock records for all items within our care through physical cycle counts.
- Maintaining the safety, organization, and cleanliness of all workspaces using Amazon 7S principles

Travel:

The role may require the successful candidate to travel to other sites in the in the Melbourne metro area to assist in conducting cycle counts, receiving stock into the inventory control system, replenishing stock and returning defective stock. Travel between sites will require own transport, all travel related costs will be reimbursed.


Physical / Environmental Demands:

Amazon Operates with a principle of safety first. With this principle, we take significant care to ensure all employees operate in a safe manner and have appropriate tools to support them in undertaking their roles safely. The activities below are required with the safety principle applied.
- Loading and unloading shipments.
- Standing, sitting, and walking (including stairs) for prolonged periods of time.
- Willing and able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend and kneel.
- Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance.
- Push or pull heavy objects of up to 16kg into position and participate in group lifts of 20kg or more.
- Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment.
- Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts.
- Work in an office and warehouse environment where the noise level is low to moderate.



A day in the life
The MEL Data Center Logistics team, supports infrastructure deployment across Melbourne's data center cluster. We manage the end-to-end logistics lifecycle — receiving, ingesting, inventory management, and cycle count accuracy — ensuring critical components are available to keep builds on track. Our culture is built on ownership, continuous learning, and bias for action. We've developed a structured training program that accelerates on boarding and equips new members to contribute quickly. Operating across multiple MEL sites, we embrace start-up challenges as opportunities to build scalable processes. Our work directly enables AWS to serve millions of customers worldwide.

Your day will be spent carrying out Logistical support functions for our Data Centers. This will involve physical control and processing of spare parts transactions, consumables stock replenishment, and cycle counting of stock.

About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Humanitarian Health Advisor, Ebola Response Consultants(1099) Position
description:
Overview

Join a team where innovation meets mission. Our AI, cloud, cyber, and modernization solutions save agencies thousands of hours, safeguard national security, and strengthen health and humanitarian missions worldwide. With 1,700+ team members, 1,500+ AI/data experts, and 100+ prime contracts, we deliver at scale and with purpose.

We’ve been recognized as a Top Workplace by the Washington Post for six straight years and named to the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies 13 of the past 14 years. Credence is a welcoming home for those looking to grow and contribute to positive change. We encourage all employees to expand beyond their boundaries, dive into important world-changing Federal challenges.

Position Summary

The Humanitarian Assistance Support Contract (HASC) brings together exceptional institutional support experience, technical leadership, and an unmatched commitment to US missions. HASC supports the U.S. Department of State’s (DOS) humanitarian assistance, disaster response, and foreign assistance across multiple bureaus. Team Credence, through the HASC, delivers operational and administrative support to provide and coordinate humanitarian assistance and maintain 24/7 response capability.

Credence has an immediate need for the Humanitarian Health Advisor, Ebola Response Consultant who will serve as part of the Disaster Humanitarian and Response (DHR) Bureau’s Technical Quality and Assurance (TQA) Office, within the Health Unit. They will be responsible for working on DHR’s response to the current Ebola disease outbreak in West/Central Africa.

The Consultant will also work with other sectors of the office including protection; water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH); nutrition; natural hazards and shelter and settlements, to provide a multidisciplinary approach to providing life-saving program to disaster affected populations. S/he will support DHR’s approach to emergency health activities within the team and assist in developing response strategies and provide technical support to humanitarian health programming in the Department of State. The Advisor will receive day-to-day guidance from the Senior Health Advisor. S/he will work in close coordination with other Health Advisors.

Scope:

The Consultant will provide technical advisory services to the TQA Office in support of the Department of State’s humanitarian health programming. In addition, the consultant will support DHR’s coordination with the Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy and other bureaus at State and the interagency, including HHS/ASPR, OGA, and CDC.

Overall, the Consultant is expected to show strong independent initiative and work with minimal supervision and engage with stakeholders in close collaboration with and under the direction of the Senior Health Advisor and Ebola Response Leads. Day-to-day oversight of the position will be provided by the Senior Health Advisor, with formal supervisory and evaluation functions performed by a Credence contract supervisor.

The main roles and responsibilities of the Consultant will be:

  • Advise the Response Lead on appropriate strategies on humanitarian response modalities that best enable Ebola outbreak response activities considering lessons learned from past Ebola outbreaks. Identify critical gaps that facilitate the pillars of response and advise the DHR leadership on these strategies.
  • Liaise directly with technical lead and pillar leads of the response at post, and in DC.
  • Advise the DHR Programs Lead on programming. And advise on when other technical sectors need to provide analysis and technical assistance for the response.
  • Engage with the national health cluster and sub-clusters to understand humanitarian gaps, challenges and response plans; attend regular cluster meetings.
  • Evaluate and document health programming gaps and assess the performance of current DHR awards in responding to these gaps.
  • Coordinate with humanitarian partners to understand humanitarian gaps and challenges in light of the Ebola response and understand the integration of health humanitarian actions and Ebola response actions.
  • Attend pillar meetings to understand technical gaps and how they are exacerbated by humanitarian needs or could be better supported through humanitarian enablers.
  • Serve as a USG humanitarian health sector resource person, assist in strategy development and provide expert technical and organizational leadership in sectoral activity as part of Ebola Response.
  • Advise and support technical and strategic thinking for health activities, interventions, and recommendation discussions. Develop sector strategies, guidance, and recommendations (in coordination with other sectors when required) for disaster and humanitarian response; and provide technical support for DHR staff at Post, and other offices within State.
  • Advise and support discussions on emergency health activities with NGO partners and other Department of State staff working in humanitarian health.
  • Provide technical review of proposals submitted by NGO and UN partners for humanitarian health programs. Apply new developments in the emergency health sector to humanitarian programming.
  • Advise on the coordination, implementation and prioritization of emergency health activities to ensure that efforts in assigned program areas are meeting the needs of affected populations and satisfy the goals and objectives of the response program.
  • As needed, provide technical support to State’s humanitarian nutrition and WASH Teams related to the complementary nature of these interventions to improve health outcomes in humanitarian settings.
  • As needed, serve on DARTs and serve on Washington-based Response Management Teams (RMTs), which provides services and support to DARTs deployed in response to disasters. The duties on RMTs will vary. (DARTs may require immediate (within 24 hours) deployment overseas for an extended period of time.)

Requirements

  • Post Graduate Studies (Master’s degree) plus seven (7) years of experience working in emergency relief and humanitarian assistance, and infectious disease outbreaks. A minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience must be obtained overseas.
  • Recent experience working in a technical capacity for an international nongovernmental organization, public international organization, or USG agency working in humanitarian relief and/or response in health and infectious disease outbreaks.
  • Fluency in critical concepts of emergency/ humanitarian health interventions in humanitarian contexts and ability to develop and guide programming to reflect those standards.
  • Understanding of key health issues related to displaced populations, refugees and other vulnerable populations and ability to represent the humanitarian perspective.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret strategy; to analyze, develop and present work results; and to monitor and evaluate implementation of programs.
  • Demonstrated flexibility and openness in responding to changing work priorities and environments.
  • Fluency in French and experience in the Democratic Republic of Congo strongly preferred.
  • US citizenship with an Active Secret Clearance required.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • This position requires the ability to deploy for international travel assignments for at least one month at a time, as well as occasional domestic travel to Washington, DC.
  • When not travelling, this is a fully remote position within the United States and its territories.
  • Consultant may be requested for additional domestic or international travel up to 21 days.

title: Applied ML Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in United Kingdom.

As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering.
You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products.
The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences.
You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate.
You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users.
The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack.
It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust.

Accountabilities

  • Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models.
  • Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses.
  • Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required.
  • Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility.
  • Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows.
  • Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion.
  • Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations.
  • Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses.
  • Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve.
  • During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface.
  • Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
    • Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility.
    • Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages.
    • Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation.
    • Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate.
    • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users.
    • Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests.
    • High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently.
    • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions.
    • Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus.
    • Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial.
    • Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus.
    • Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable.
    • Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage.
    • A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on applied machine learning at the intersection of research, experimentation, engineering, and product.
      • End-to-end ownership across model evaluation, model internals, infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing experiences.
      • Exposure to modern open-weight models, LLM inference systems, and emerging ML verification techniques.
      • A role with significant technical autonomy and the opportunity to shape both experiments and production systems.
      • Fast-moving startup environment with evolving priorities and cross-functional collaboration.
      • Opportunity to translate cutting-edge research into practical, measurable, and user-accessible products.
      • The opportunity to build systems and evaluation methodologies designed to produce evidence that users can understand and trust.
      • Location: Romania.
      • Additional compensation, flexibility, healthcare, and other benefits may be provided according to the partner company's employment package and local arrangements.

title: BSA Analyst
description:
Job purpose:

At First Electronic Bank (FEB), we are driven by the purpose to make credit accessible to everyday Americans, and their businesses. Partnering with some of the most innovative FinTech companies in the nation, we offer a wide range of consumer and commercial credit products on a national basis.   • Assist in monitoring and oversight of strategic partners to identify and mitigate financial crime risks.
  • Contribute to special projects and initiatives that enhance the Bank’s AML/CFT program.
  • Stay current on AML/CFT regulatory developments and apply emerging best practices to daily work.

title: Transportation Safety Planner or Engineer
description:
Overview

ABOUT THE POSITION

Transportation Safety Planner or Engineer | Washington D.C. | Hybrid

Together, we work to improve mobility, enhance communities and economic vitality, and balance development and infrastructure needs with environmental stewardship. The right candidate would be joining a tight-knit team of transportation planners and traffic safety engineers who value technical excellence, career development, pride in our work, a collaborative team environment, and a passion for finding the right solutions that enhance mobility and safety.

At VHB, we’re invested in what we do, compelled by intellectual curiosity, and driven to work collectively to best serve our clients and help shape the future of our communities in a meaningful way. We’re proud, yet humbled, to have been doing this for over 40 years. We are dedicated to making a positive impact and providing opportunities to grow personally and professionally.

This position is for a Transportation Safety Planner/Engineer. In this role, you will be part of the Metro DC team and, more specifically, reporting to the VHB office in Washington, DC. The selected candidate will support our clients’ efforts to plan, design, and analyze new and improved transportation facilities that support and enhance mobility for all transportation modes while reducing crashes, saving lives, and preventing injuries.

Responsibilities

  • Work within a team of professionals in developing transportation engineering, safety, and planning solutions for multimodal transportation projects
  • Develop creative solutions to address challenging safety and mobility problems in urban, suburban, and rural environments
  • Conduct multimodal safety transportation analyses, including both network -wide and individual corridor or intersection safety and improvement studies
  • Conduct research, prepare reports, and present findings and results to clients, including both taking on a leadership role and also supporting other team members in the development
  • Be able to lead and interpret data analysis and perform national-level state-of-the-practice and literature reviews
  • Assist in the development of proposals and scopes of work, track project budgets, and manage tasks
  • Work within a team of professionals to develop transportation planning and engineering solutions for a multitude of multimodal transportation projects, including the development of conceptual designs
  • Participate in and lead field data collection and other on-site project support activities
  • Facilitate meetings and prepare detailed meeting notes
  • Monitor and update client facing project coordination sites
  • Prepare technical presentations and materials to support public, stakeholder, or client meetings (in-person and virtual)
  • Conduct transportation planning and scoping analyses
  • Work with Federal, state, and local clients on identifying and applying best practices and the development of guidance documents and other publications
  • Maintain a client-service approach to deliver projects that exceed client expectations
  • Provide mentorship to junior staff
  • Be able to lead client and stakeholder meetings, client workshops, and public meetings
  • Prepare written documents, summarize data, and assemble technical reports
  • Work within a team of professionals in developing transportation engineering, safety, and planning solutions for multimodal transportation projects

Skills and Attributes

  • Ability to work well in a collaborative and integrated team environment
  • Excellent technical writing skills
  • Excellent verbal and interpersonal communication skills
  • Is self-motivated and has excellent organization and attention to detail
  • Ability to think critically and solve problems
  • Has an enthusiasm to learn and innovate
  • Ability to take initiative on tasks while still collaborating across the team
  • Ability to take on leadership of junior staff including providing positive direction, review, and delegation
  • Ability to work effectively in both in-office and virtual environments
  • Ability to balance concurrent projects and priorities
  • Understanding of highway safety fundamentals
  • Ability to read and interpret federal and state terminology
  • Understanding of highway safety fundamentals, including behavioral safety factors, and safety treatments
  • Ability to understand and interpret traffic engineering analysis
  • Has Road Safety Audit (RSA) experience
  • Experience with state DOT planning, design, and/or safety work

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional transportation engineering and/or planning experience, preferably in a consulting environment, required
  • Strong interest and foundation in safety and multimodal transportation
  • BS or MS in Civil Engineering, Planning, or related field
  • PE or AICP expected
  • Experience with MicroStation/AutoCAD, Word, Excel, PowerPoint
  • Experience with multimodal analysis
  • Familiarity with national and/or local transportation engineering standards, including VDOT, AASHTO, MUTCD, Highway Capacity Manual, Highway Safety Manual and/or ITE guidance documents

The full-time annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $135,000 if located in the DC Metro area. The base salary offered will be determined based on job-related factors, including geographic location, internal equity, experience, credentials, skills, education, work schedule, and other factors permitted by law. The posted salary range reflects base pay only. Additional compensation and benefits available to eligible employees are outlined in our Total Rewards Program.

Annual base salary is one component of VHB’s Total Rewards package. In addition to base pay, eligible employees may receive annual incentive compensation bonuses, spot bonuses, and merit-based salary increases, providing opportunities to increase earnings beyond base pay. VHB also offers a differentiating work experience, including a comprehensive benefits package that includes eligibility to participate in the VHB 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, wellness programs, tuition reimbursement, and recognition programs.

Building what’s next, together.

Our people make the difference. We foster a technology-empowered, people‑driven, future‑ready culture where agility, innovation, and collaboration shape how we work every day.

When you join VHB, you’ll find:

  • Meaningful work on complex projects with real community impact

About the role

As a Supply Chain Coordinator, you will manage and streamline shipping, receiving, and warehouse operations at our Zoeterwoude location. In this hands-on role, you will serve as the operational bridge between logistics and internal departments, ensuring materials arrive on time, system transactions are accurate, and warehouse operations run efficiently across our regional network.

Key Responsibilities

This role is based on-site at our Zoeterwoude location with hybrid work opportunities.

  • Arrange, coordinate, and continuously monitor incoming and outgoing freight shipments to guarantee on-time delivery.

  • Review schedules proactively to prepare, stage, and plan stock several days in advance of shipment.

  • Execute all system transactions related to receiving, shipping, and material movements accurately within ERP/WMS systems.

  • Safely operate a forklift to load, unload, stage, and move goods, optimizing storage layouts and maintaining accurate labeling systems across the warehouse.

  • Communicate across cross-functional internal teams, drivers, and carriers to eliminate delays and streamline supply chain workflows.

  • Required: Valid Driving License and an active Forklift Certificate/License.

  • Required: Professional fluency in English; working knowledge of Dutch is a strong advantage.

  • Skills you need to succeed: Proactive planning abilities to look ahead at operational schedules, anticipate bottlenecks, and prepare stock in advance.

  • Skills you need to succeed: Excellent communication and collaboration skills to liaise effectively with drivers, carriers, and internal cross-functional teams.

  • On-Site Perks: Take advantage of free parking and a commuting allowance (80km per day by car) /public transport reimbursement.

We continue our commitment to raise the bar on the quality of behavioral health care provided to those in our community who suffer from mental illness. Finding the best people to join our team is crucial in meeting our goals. If you thrive in a team environment and you want to contribute to the safe and efficient flow of patients, join us as we build an integrated, qualified team dedicated to behavioral health.

Unity Center for Behavioral Health is a 24-hour behavioral and mental health services center located in the greater Portland metropolitan area. We provide immediate psychiatric care and a path to stabilization and recovery for individuals experiencing a mental health crisis. Unity Center offers mental health treatment to adults and adolescents aged 9 to 17. We also have the only emergency department specifically for behavioral health emergencies in Oregon. The Psychiatric Emergency Services (PES) serves adults 18 and older. We believe in a trauma informed approach to assessment and treatment. For more information, please visit our website: www.unityhealthcenter.org

Responsibilities

We will consider candidates with their Clinical Social Work Associate, Professional Counselor Associate (PCA) or Marriage and Family Therapist Associate (MFTA) license for a Clinical Therapist Associate position or candidates with their Licensed Clinical Social Worker(LCSW), Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC), Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) or a state or national certification or license in an expressive arts therapy license for a Clinical Therapist position.

Clinical Therapist Associate

Under the supervision of the Manager of Counseling and Therapy, the Clinical Therapist Lead(s), and Clinical Therapist the Clinical Therapist Associate provides therapeutic treatment interventions to adult and adolescent behavioral health patients using evidence-based practices. Interventions are done through group and individual treatment. Works both independently and collaboratively as part of an interdisciplinary team.

Clinical Therapist

Provides therapeutic treatment interventions to adult and adolescent behavioral health patients using evidence-based practices. Interventions are done through group and individual treatment. Works both independently and collaboratively as part of an interdisciplinary team.

Key services include (but are not limited to) comprehensive evaluation of psychological presentation, mental/behavioral health status, legal and safety considerations, substance use or addiction, chronic illnesses, and crisis management.

Throughout the care continuum, therapists will utilize a strengths-based approach with the aim to enhance the capacity of people to address their own needs.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a behavioral health field required.

Experience:

  • Preferred: 2 year’s relevant experience.

Skills:

  • Broad knowledge of the principles of behavioral health evidence-based treatments and the ability to apply them with individuals, families and/or groups integrating knowledge of normal development and the aging process, changes related to illness, and the needs of patients with acute and chronic illnesses with attention to cultural and literacy implications.
  • Knowledge of medical, mental health and substance use diagnoses, disabilities, and treatment procedures. This includes acute, chronic, and traumatic illnesses/injuries; common medications and their effects/side effects; and medical terminology.
  • Strong organizational, communication and collaboration skills in a multi-disciplinary treatment setting.
  • Understanding and ability to apply principles of diversity/equity/inclusion and culturally responsive practice with populations who have experience historical marginalization.
  • Demonstrates ability to create group and individual treatment interventions using evidence-based practices.
  • Ability to navigate electronic medical records and effectively utilize basic computer programs.
  • Knowledge of legal, regulatory and compliance requirements and an ability to be a resource to all team members regarding such issues and knowledge of current health care environment.

title: Graduate Systems Engineer
description:
About Graphcore

Graphcore is a global leader in artificial intelligence computing systems. We design advanced semiconductors and data center hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to advance AI while improving the efficiency required for broad adoption.

As part of SoftBank Group, Graphcore belongs to a family of companies developing transformative technologies. Our AI Engineering Campus in Austin plays an important role in building the hardware platforms that support the next generation of AI systems.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a recent graduate or early-career engineer to join the Hardware Platform Development team as a Graduate Systems Engineer. You will contribute to the design, integration, validation, and performance analysis of advanced AI compute platforms.

You will work with experienced hardware, firmware, software, mechanical, thermal, and systems engineers throughout the development lifecycle. The role combines subsystem engineering, hands-on laboratory work, test automation, data analysis, troubleshooting, and clear technical documentation.

What You Will Do

  • Contribute to the design, integration, and testing of CPU and high-speed input and output subsystems for advanced compute platforms.
  • Take ownership of defined engineering tasks from requirements and test planning through execution, analysis, and technical review.
  • Develop system-level validation plans, procedures, scripts, and tools that improve test coverage, repeatability, data collection, and analysis.

title: ​ Senior Director of Operations
description:
The Driver Provider is seeking a Senior Director of Operations to lead and strengthen our day-to-day transportation operations, with an immediate and significant focus on Dispatch.

This is not a role for someone who simply maintains an existing operation.

We are looking for an experienced operational leader who can walk into a fast-moving environment, quickly understand what is working and what is not, develop the leaders already in place and build the structure, accountability and operating discipline necessary to support continued growth.

Our operation runs in real time. Vehicles move. Schedules change. Clients have expectations. Chauffeurs need support. Problems do not wait for the next staff meeting.

The right leader knows how to create order in that environment without becoming the person who personally solves every problem.


What You Will Own

The Senior Director of Operations will provide leadership and oversight of core operational functions, with Dispatch as the immediate priority.

You will be responsible for creating an operation that is proactive, measurable and increasingly capable of solving problems at the appropriate level.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the day-to-day performance of Dispatch and provide direct leadership, coaching and accountability to operational managers
  • Establish clear roles, decision rights and escalation protocols so employees understand what they own, what they can resolve and when leadership involvement is required
  • Evaluate current dispatch workflows, staffing models, schedules and coverage to ensure resources align with actual business demand
  • Build strong operating rhythms including daily communication, leadership meetings, performance reviews and follow-through
  • Establish and manage meaningful operational KPIs related to service execution, staffing, scheduling, response times, preventable failures and other critical performance indicators
  • Identify recurring operational problems, determine root causes and implement sustainable solutions rather than temporary fixes
  • Strengthen communication and coordination between Dispatch, Chauffeur Management, Fleet/Maintenance, Safety & Compliance, Client Services and other departments
  • Ensure new accounts, events and operational requirements are effectively integrated into day-to-day service delivery
  • Develop managers into confident, accountable leaders who can independently run their areas of responsibility
  • Evaluate processes, technology and tools and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, visibility and operational control
  • Create appropriate contingency plans for staffing shortages, vehicle issues, service disruptions and other operational risks
  • Maintain a strong understanding of daily operations without unnecessarily inserting yourself into work that should be owned by managers
  • Escalate material risks quickly, clearly and with recommended solutions
  • Partner with executive leadership on operational strategy, organizational design, capacity planning and continued growth


What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a leader who understands that being accountable for an operation does not mean personally doing everyone else’s job.

You should be comfortable walking into complexity, asking difficult questions and making decisions with incomplete information. You should know how to distinguish an isolated mistake from a broken process and how to build controls that prevent the same problems from recurring.

You should also be someone who develops people rather than simply replacing them.

Our ideal candidate brings:

  • Significant progressive leadership experience in transportation, logistics, dispatch, fleet operations or another complex, time-sensitive service environment
  • Demonstrated experience leading managers and multi-layer operational teams
  • Strong understanding of dispatch operations, workforce planning, scheduling and real-time service execution
  • Experience developing and using operational KPIs to drive accountability and improvement
  • Proven ability to identify operational gaps and turn them into practical, sustainable processes
  • Strong judgment and the ability to remain calm and decisive when circumstances change quickly
  • Experience developing emerging leaders and strengthening management capability
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across departments and leadership levels
  • Comfort challenging existing practices when the data or results indicate there is a better way
  • A strong bias toward ownership, urgency and follow-through
  • Experience in chauffeured transportation, passenger transportation, charter operations or another high-touch transportation environment is valuable.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be visible.

Dispatch operates with clear leadership and accountability. Managers know what they own and are capable of owning it. Staffing and schedules reflect actual operational needs. Problems are identified earlier. Recurring failures decrease. Departments communicate instead of operating in silos. Leadership has meaningful visibility into performance.

And when something does go wrong — because in transportation, something eventually will — the organization knows who owns it, responds quickly and learns from it.

Most importantly, the operation becomes less dependent on heroics and more dependent on strong systems, capable leaders and consistent execution.


The Opportunity

The Driver Provider is in a period of growth and organizational evolution. That creates both complexity and opportunity.

This role will have meaningful influence over how our operational organization is built for the future. You will work closely with executive leadership and have the opportunity to strengthen existing leaders, improve systems and help build an operation capable of supporting the next stage of the company.

We are not looking for someone to simply inherit a department.

We are looking for someone to make it better.

title: IT Business Partner
description:
Do you want to influence how one of Europe's leading pharmaceutical companies leverages technology to create competitive advantage? As IT Business Partner for Pharma Trade, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, shaping strategic priorities and using digital innovation to enable greater growth, efficiency, and scalability

About the job

You will work closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders across Pharma Trade to understand business strategy, commercial priorities, operational challenges, and digital opportunities. You will shape demand and identify how technology can improve decision-making, gross margin, operational scalability, process efficiency, and execution across the Pharma Trade value chain.

You will play a central role in developing and maintaining the technology roadmap for Pharma Trade. This includes connecting needs and opportunities across Business Development, Product Supply, Portfolio Management, Hospital and Tender Management, Regulatory, Sales, and other relevant functions.

Working closely with the Head of Pharma Trade Solutions, Product Owner, delivery teams, and shared IT functions, you will ensure that demand is clearly understood, prioritized, qualified, and prepared for successful delivery. You will help move Pharma Trade towards a coherent, scalable, and value-driven digital landscape.

Your focus will not only be on identifying new initiatives, but also on ensuring that technology investments lead to measurable business outcomes and support the long-term transformation of Pharma Trade.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Act as the primary strategic IT partner and point of contact for new technology demand across Pharma Trade
  • Build and maintain a consolidated, value-based technology roadmap for Pharma Trade in close collaboration with business leadership and the Pharma Trade Solutions team
  • Develop a deep understanding of Pharma Trade’s end-to-end value chain, business processes, decision points, data needs, and application landscape
  • Identify, assess, and develop digital opportunities that can improve gross margin, commercial decision-making, scalability, time-to-market, supply visibility, and operational efficiency
  • Ensure that initiatives are prioritized across the entire Pharma Trade domain rather than optimized for individual functions or markets
  • Challenge business demand constructively and distinguish between underlying business problems, requested features, and appropriate technology solutions
  • Secure clear business ownership of business cases, benefits, process decisions, data, adoption, and value realization
  • Coordinate early involvement from Product Owners, Solution Architecture, Data & Analytics, Integration, Cyber Security, Compliance, and other shared IT functions

Who are you?

You are a senior, business-oriented IT professional who combines strong stakeholder management with a structured and analytical approach to technology demand and business value.

You understand both business priorities and IT delivery realities. You are comfortable engaging with senior leaders, but you also have enough technology understanding to challenge, shape, and qualify ideas before they become projects.

You bring:

  • Experience in IT business partnering, IT strategy, digital transformation, technology consulting, product ownership, or a similar cross-functional IT role
  • Experience from life sciences is an advantage, but not a requirement
  • Good understanding of enterprise IT, business applications, architecture, integrations, software delivery, and implementation processes
  • Understanding of commercial and operational processes such as business development, product and portfolio management, sourcing and supply planning, pricing, forecasting, and allocation
  • Experience working with complex, cross-functional business domains where value is created through connected processes, data, and decision-making
  • Experience with product-oriented delivery, demand management, business cases, prioritization, and benefits realization
  • Analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complexity and competing priorities

Who are we?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 45 professionals across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices. The team is solution-oriented and highly engaged in creating value across Orifarm. We have a culture that values collaboration, creativity, and flexibility, where helping each other succeed is a core principle.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

title: Technical Program Manager (TPM) - GCP Cloud Infrastructure
description:
We are searching for a talented Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure and platform initiatives on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

This role involves coordinating cross-functional engineering and operations teams, managing complex technical programs, and ensuring the successful delivery of scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure solutions in a global environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong cloud infrastructure knowledge with proven program management and stakeholder leadership skills.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of GCP cloud infrastructure and platform initiatives
  • Align engineering, DevOps, operations, and other cross-functional groups to ensure program success
  • Manage program schedules, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and resource allocation
  • Drive alignment between technical and business stakeholders while providing regular program status updates
  • Oversee large-scale cloud infrastructure deployments and transformation efforts, ensuring outcomes meet agreed-upon quality, performance, security, and reliability benchmarks
  • Identify delivery risks and operational obstacles early and drive efforts toward mitigation and resolution
  • Coordinate dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams within a complex global environment
  • Collaborate with distributed teams across various time zones, including attending PST-aligned meetings and activities as needed

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud-native technologies
  • Showcase of managing large-scale cloud infrastructure, platform, or cloud transformation programs
  • Understanding of technical delivery processes, covering dependencies, risks, release planning, and operational readiness
  • Skills in program planning, risk management, and stakeholder engagement
  • Background in coordinating distributed, cross-functional teams within a global environment
  • Capability to communicate clearly with both technical teams and senior business stakeholders
  • Strong sense of ownership along with organizational and problem-solving abilities
  • Qualifications in associate-level cloud certification (Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer or equivalent), professional AI credentials, and hands-on enterprise GenAI experience (e.g., Vertex AI / Gemini)
  • GCP Professional Cloud Architect or another relevant GCP certification
  • PMP, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or similar program/project management certification
  • Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Background in large-scale cloud migration or modernization programs
  • Track record of collaborating with teams and stakeholders across US/PST time zones

Nice to have

  • Professional / Expert GCP Certifications: a professional-level credential (e.g., Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, Google Cloud Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, or Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer)

  • Participate in volunteer, charity programs and communities (both technical and interest-based)

We focus on your professional growth:

  • You can plan your individual career path together with your manager
  • Receive regular feedback from colleagues
  • Improve your English for free with certified teachers (Speaking Clubs, client interview preparation courses, etc.)
  • Get the opportunity to undergo free training and certification in AWS, GCP, or Azure Clouds
  • Use the internal E-learn training program (18,200+ specialized training and mentoring programs)
  • Access corporate accounts on LinkedIn Learning, Get Abstract and other partner resources
  • Study at EPAM Solution Architecture School with the instructors who are practicing architects
  • Develop as a leader, join Delivery Management, Resource Management, Leadership Essentials school and more
  • Participate in internal communities (500+ meetups, technical discussions, brainstorming sessions, online events and conferences annually)

What we offer:

  • Vacation and sick leave (including a sick leave without a medical certificate)
  • A wide range of Voluntary Medical Insurance programs providing both medical treatment and various preventive options (including sports activities)
  • Medical insurance for family members at corporate rates
  • Company support during significant life events (childbirth or adoption, marriage, etc.)
  • Support for psychological comfort: discounts on services from mental health specialists or coaches, thematic training
  • E-kids program - a free programming language training program for EPAMers' children

title: Senior Technical Consultant - D365 Power Platform

title: Commercial Counsel
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Commercial Counsel based in Spain.

As Commercial Counsel, you’ll be the first dedicated legal hire supporting a rapidly growing AI business with complex commercial and regulatory needs.
You’ll take ownership of customer, supplier, and partner agreements, handling drafting and negotiations under US law from initial review through signature or resolution.
A key part of the role will be addressing emerging AI-contracting questions around data use, training, output ownership, liability, and warranties.
You’ll also provide practical guidance on data protection, enterprise deals, diligence, and legal readiness across a cross-border organization.
Working closely with Finance, founders, customers, and external advisers, you’ll build reusable templates, negotiation positions, and workflows that make legal work more efficient.
You’ll have significant autonomy in a small, high-trust environment where decisions are made by owners and legal judgment directly influences commercial outcomes.
This is an opportunity to build a legal function from the ground up while staying deeply involved in the business and the deals it signs.

Accountabilities

  • Review, draft, and negotiate customer, supplier, and partner agreements under US law, including SaaS terms, order forms, NDAs, and DPAs.
  • Provide clear, commercially practical legal recommendations and remain involved with matters through signature, resolution, or final escalation.
  • Own AI-specific contracting issues, including data use and training, ownership of outputs, liability allocation, warranties, and related commercial risks.
  • Lead legal readiness for enterprise transactions and due diligence processes.
  • Develop and maintain practical contract templates, negotiation positions, and an organized contract archive covering recurring commercial, AI, and data issues.
  • Own practical data-protection work by translating regulatory and specialist advice into clear actions, owners, deadlines, and follow-up.
  • Manage relationships with external counsel, including preparing briefs, coordinating advice, monitoring budgets, and engaging jurisdiction-specific or specialist advisers when required.
  • Support fundraising and corporate transactions, including maintaining records, approvals, filing deadlines, and authorities across US, Polish, and German entities.
  • Coordinate legal matters across jurisdictions while recognizing the limits of US-law expertise and involving appropriate local or specialist counsel when necessary.
  • Improve legal intake, drafting, obligation tracking, and administrative workflows through approved AI tools combined with appropriate human review.
  • Track legal obligations after contracts are signed and ensure relevant teams understand material commitments and follow-up actions.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized legal-readiness roadmap covering enterprise reviews, data protection, and relevant AI regulatory requirements.
  • Establish practical workflows for external-counsel briefs, budgets, advice, and outstanding corporate-support matters.

    • Requirements

    • Admission to practice in a US state with substantial hands-on experience drafting and negotiating commercial agreements governed by US law.
    • Demonstrable experience personally handling agreements such as SaaS contracts, order forms, NDAs, DPAs, and other B2B commercial agreements.
    • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material business risks from non-critical drafting preferences.
    • Ability to propose practical, workable alternatives that support commercial objectives while appropriately managing legal risk.
    • Proven ability to own matters end to end, including negotiation, resolution, obligation tracking, administrative follow-through, and escalation.
    • Strong understanding of when US-law expertise is sufficient and when local or specialist counsel should be involved, particularly across European jurisdictions.
    • Experience working with cross-border businesses and multiple legal entities is highly valuable.
    • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers, founders, finance teams, and external advisers.
    • Highly organized, discreet, proactive, and comfortable working independently with limited process or supervision.
    • Ability to identify legal issues early and communicate them together with a proposed course of action.
    • Familiarity with GDPR and practical data-protection matters is advantageous.
    • Experience with B2B software, AI products, or AI/data contracting is a strong plus.
    • Experience working with venture-backed companies, fundraising, or financing rounds is beneficial.
    • Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes and security reviews is advantageous.
    • Experience with multi-entity or cross-border corporate management is a plus.
    • Comfortable using approved AI tools to improve legal intake, drafting, tracking, and other workflows while maintaining appropriate human oversight.
    • Willingness to work in a hands-on legal role rather than focusing primarily on corporate governance or delegating drafting and negotiations.

      • Benefits

      • Top-of-the-market salary.
      • Meaningful ownership and responsibility within an early-stage, growing environment.
      • Remote work available within Europe.
      • Warsaw preferred, with remote flexibility across Europe.
      • Opportunity to build the first dedicated legal function and establish its processes, templates, and workflows.
      • Direct involvement in commercial deals, enterprise transactions, AI contracting, and strategic legal matters.
      • High level of autonomy in a small, high-trust team with minimal bureaucracy.
      • Opportunity to shape how the legal function evolves as enterprise and cross-border requirements grow.
      • Close collaboration with founders, Finance, customers, external counsel, and other business stakeholders.
      • Exposure to emerging legal questions around AI, data, SaaS, and cross-border technology operations.
      • Opportunity to introduce practical AI-assisted workflows into legal operations.
      • Meaningful ownership of legal matters rather than a primarily administrative or governance-focused remit.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Engineer, Infra Supply Chain Automation
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you want to be an integral part of the world's transition to the cloud? The AWS Analytics and Data Solutions (ADS) team is seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) with a combination of superior analytical abilities, business acumen, business judgement, curiosity, technical skills, and written and verbal communication skills to join our team.

Data-driven decision-making is at the core of Amazon’s culture and people who are exceptionally talented at analyzing large sets of data to build insights are critical. Your work will directly impact the decisions and strategy of the entire AWS Infrastructure Services org and our customers. You will be gathering customer needs and insights, mining large and diverse data sets from across AWS Infrastructure, building visualizations and tools for our business partners, generating insights to help senior leaders make critical business decisions. Hence, the successful BIE will not only possess the expertise and passion for analyzing data, designing metrics to measure the performance of the business, and building reporting capabilities and tools, but also will interact directly with business leaders and teams that rely on the metrics and analyses that they produce.

The Senior business intelligence engineer must be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big and be creative (while still paying careful attention to detail), and enjoy working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. If you are excited about data, are results-oriented, and want to join a growing analytics team within Amazon - this role is for you!



Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop and maintain scaled, automated, user-friendly systems, reports, dashboards, etc. that will support the needs of the business.
- Apply deep analytic and business intelligence skills to extract meaningful insights and learning from large and complicated data sets.
- Be hands-on with ETL to build data pipeline to support automated reporting.
- Serve as liaison between the business and technical teams to achieve the goal of providing actionable insights into current business performance, and ad hoc analyses to support future improvements or innovations. This will require data gathering and manipulation, problem solving, and communication of insights and recommendations.
- Build various data visualizations to tell the story of business trends, patterns, and outliers through rich visualizations.
- Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation.

About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
About Us
