title: Senior Director of Early Childhood Programs
description:
Overview

The Senior Director of Early Childhood Programs provides strategic leadership and association-wide oversight for all YMCA early childhood programs, including licensed preschool, half-day preschool, and related summer programming. This role ensures high-quality, consistent, and compliant program operations through the supervision of site leaders, alignment of program and operational standards, oversight of licensing and regulatory requirements, and use of performance data to guide continuous improvement. The Senior Director works closely with the Vice President of Youth Development, branch leadership, and other senior leaders to strengthen program quality, enrollment, family experience, financial performance, and operational excellence across all early childhood services.

Responsibilities

  • Recruit, hire, onboard, supervise, coach, and evaluate Preschool Directors, Childcare Directors, and other assigned early childhood leadership staff.
  • Hold Preschool Directors, Childcare Directors, and other assigned leaders accountable for program performance, operational execution, staff development, regulatory compliance, enrollment, financial performance, and family experience within their assigned programs.
  • In collaboration with the Vice President of Youth Development and other senior leaders, establish leadership meeting rhythms, professional development priorities, and accountability structures for early childhood program leaders.
  • Provide strategic leadership and association-wide oversight for all YMCA early childhood programs, including licensed preschool, half-day preschool, and related summer programming.
  • Establish and monitor association-wide systems, standards, and expectations for program quality, curriculum alignment, staffing, compliance, safety, family experience, and operational consistency across all early childhood programs.
  • Provide leadership for the development, alignment, and continuous improvement of the YMCA’s early childhood program model to ensure consistency across branches, counties, and program types.
  • Develop and oversee year-at-a-glance planning tools and timelines for early childhood programming to ensure deadlines are met and planning remains aligned with YMCA priorities.
  • Oversee compliance with NC Child Care Rules and other applicable regulations by ensuring effective systems are in place for licensing readiness, sanitation, documentation, monitoring, corrective action, and continuous quality improvement across all sites.
  • Oversee the administration and monitoring of CACFP systems and requirements, including internal processes, accountability measures, and coordination with support staff to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with compliance, finance, HR, and other association support teams to ensure early childhood programs meet licensing, sanitation, safety, staffing, and operational expectations.
  • Establish, monitor, and analyze key performance indicators across early childhood programs, including enrollment, capacity utilization, staffing alignment, family retention, compliance trends, budget performance, and other operational measures; use data to guide planning, accountability, resource allocation, and strategies that strengthen growth, sustainability, enrollment, retention, and overall program effectiveness.
  • Provide leadership and oversight for the development, maintenance, and administration of early childhood and related summer program budgets across the association; monitor revenue and expenses, support forecasting and planning, ensure responsible stewardship of resources, and make recommendations to strengthen financial performance and long-term sustainability.
  • Provide leadership and oversight for Pre-K and Kindergarten summer camp programs operated within early childhood program areas, including planning expectations, staffing models, readiness timelines, and operational alignment.
  • Establish and monitor expectations for strong family engagement, communication, and service across early childhood programs, ensuring systems are in place to promote responsiveness, consistency, trust, and a high-quality family experience.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with branch leadership, regulatory agencies, community partners, and other stakeholders to support program success, visibility, and sustainability.
  • Provide leadership and accountability for annual campaign performance within assigned program areas, including achievement of assigned campaign goals, active engagement of staff in campaign efforts, participation in donor cultivation and stewardship, and serving as a storyteller and ambassador for the YMCA’s mission and impact.
  • Requires the use of a personal vehicle to travel throughout the YMCA of Catawba Valley Association. Program assignments and support needs are subject to change based on organizational priorities.
  • Ensures all staff understand and volunteers understand and comply with YMCA abuse prevention policies, actively monitors staff interactions with participants, addresses boundary violations, and ensures prompt reporting of concerns in accordance with YMCA policy and state law.
  • Act as Manager on Duty (MOD) as assigned.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Physical Requirements:

The Senior Director of Early Childhood Programs must represent the YMCA in a professional manner. The employee must be able to maneuver the grounds and facilities freely and be capable of speaking clearly, including, but not limited to: walking, stooping, carrying a minimum of 50 lbs., sitting, standing, pushing, climbing, kneeling, lifting a minimum of 50 lbs., and crouching.

Safety Policy:

The Senior Director of Early Childhood Programs will be responsible for observing the following rules:

  • No alcohol or drugs will be used on the job at any time.
  • Report all job accidents the same day the accident happens.
  • Obtain authorization from your supervisor for all non-emergency treatments for accidents.
  • Wear seat belts at all times in company vehicles.
  • Keep the area where you work clean and neat at all times.
  • Do not remove or bypass any guards on any machinery at any time.
  • Ask your supervisor when you need additional equipment or instructions to get the job done safely.
  • Lift with your legs, not your back, and get assistance with loads over 50 pounds.
  • Advise your supervisor of any hazardous conditions.
  • Follow all other written and spoken safety rules.

Qualifications

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Birth-Kindergarten, Early Childhood, or Childhood Education, Human Services, Business Management or related field required.
  • Minimum of five years of experience as a child care director, assistant director, curriculum coordinator, or other administrator in early childhood programs.
  • Experience with administration and/or reporting of Child and Adult Care Food Program.
  • Background must include strong skills in human relations, sound fiscal management, program compliance, program management, and staff supervision and development.

Knowledge:

  • Experience leading teams and building systems for large-scale early childhood programs.
  • Ability to collaborate with leadership across multiple locations and association staff to support program growth and sustainability.
  • Knowledge of early childhood development, developmentally appropriate practice, and state QRIS systems.
  • Understanding of staffing structures, program budgets, and enrollment management in early childhood programs.
  • Mastery of NC DCDEE licensing requirements, CACFP/SFSP, sanitation and safety protocols.

Skills:

  • Strong leadership skills, experience managing teams, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting program and professional growth.
  • Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing, including the ability to clearly document program observations and operational issues.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs and priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and other software programs.
  • Position requires travel throughout Burke, Catawba, and Lincoln Counties using a personal vehicle.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills with the ability to assess challenges and provide effective solutions.
  • Ability to design, support, and evaluate engaging and effective early childhood programs.

Abilities:

  • Ability to lead and support multiple early childhood programs across several locations.
  • Ability to coach and support program directors while maintaining clear expectations and accountability.
  • Strong ability to manage staffing, program operations, and family engagement challenges effectively.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with staff, families, branch leadership, and community partners.
  • Ability to balance operational oversight with strategic program development.

Personal Attributes:

  • High level of energy, creativity, and enthusiasm for working with staff, children, and families.
  • Strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing to the YMCA leadership team.
  • Serves as a member of YMCA leadership and supports the overall objectives of the YMCA.

Benefits

  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Retirement Contributions

USD $65,000.00 - USD $70,000.00 /Yr.

title: Field and Shop Technician - Newark
description:
General Position Summary

The Field and Shop Technician is responsible for the inspection, monitoring, maintenance, repair, and preparation of material and liquid tanks and related equipment. This position works both in the field and at the company shop in various locations, supporting the readiness and reliability of Ice Solutions systems and equipment.

The Field and Shop Technician performs routine tank inspections, installs and repairs valves and related components, checks monitoring systems, troubleshoots equipment, and performs general mechanical repairs and maintenance as needed. The technician will also assist with preparing, repairing, organizing, and maintaining equipment used in field operations.

This is a hands-on position requiring mechanical aptitude, attention to detail, reliability, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. The position operates a company vehicles and equipment, but a CDL is not required for this role. Travel will be required as necessary, especially during peak months of business.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Field Operations

  • Travel throughout the assigned region to inspect and monitor tanks and related equipment.
  • Perform routine inspections of tanks, valves, piping, pumps, hoses, fittings, and related components.
  • Identify leaks, damage, wear, and other maintenance or repair needs.
  • Install, replace, and repair valves, fittings, hoses, piping, and other components.
  • Perform preventative maintenance and basic troubleshooting on brine systems.
  • Check and verify operation of tank monitoring systems.
  • Identify and report monitoring-system issues and other equipment concerns.
  • Respond to field service and repair needs as assigned.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections, repairs, and maintenance activities.

Shop Operations

  • Perform mechanical repairs and maintenance on equipment in the company shop.
  • Inspect, repair, clean, and prepare brine equipment for field deployment.
  • Assist with assembly, disassembly, and repair of tanks, pumps, valves, hoses, fittings, and related equipment.
  • Prepare tools, parts, equipment, and supplies for field service activities.
  • Perform general shop maintenance and keep work areas clean, organized, and safe.
  • Assist with loading and unloading equipment and materials.
  • Maintain inventory of commonly used parts, tools, and supplies and communicate replenishment needs.
  • Assist other team members with equipment repairs and maintenance as needed.

Equipment Monitoring & Maintenance

  • Monitor equipment performance and identify potential problems before they result in equipment failure.
  • Perform routine preventative maintenance according to established schedules.
  • Troubleshoot basic mechanical and monitoring-system issues.
  • Escalate complex repairs or technical issues when additional support is required.
  • Follow established maintenance, safety, and operating procedures.

Vehicle & Travel

  • Operate company vehicles and equipment in a safe and responsible manner.
  • Transport tools, parts, equipment, and supplies between the shop and field locations.
  • Perform routine vehicle inspections and report maintenance needs.
  • Travel throughout the assigned region as required necessary, especially during peak months of business.
  • Occasional overnight travel may be required based on business needs.

title: Producer
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

YOUR ROLE IN A NUTSHELL

Hogarth is looking for a passionate and proactive Content Producer (entry mid wt) to join our dynamic Sydney-based Content Studios department. This is a critical role responsible for the effective scoping and delivery of diverse content projects, guiding them from initial client brief through content creation, making, and optimisation stages.

As a Content Producer, you will manage a wide range of small to medium scale projects, encompassing content, Retail, Stills, Video, OOH, digital, post-production, and VFX – across both studio and location environments. Supporting more senior production experts, you will be the central point of contact for clients, expertly managing expectations, schedules, budgets, assets, and project scopes. A high level of attention to detail is paramount, from creative development and shoots to post-production and financial reporting. You will ensure projects are thoroughly mapped, have clearly defined schedules, are profitable, and always deliver a high standard of quality.

You will collaborate closely with specialists from our Client Delivery and Creative & Strategy Chapters. With a deep interest in all forms of content production, you will bring strong proficiency in marketing content, integrated communications, post, photography, social, and OOH.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Product & Delivery Excellence:

  • Take client briefs and oversee the end-to-end production of content projects, from inception to optimisation.
  • Manage a diverse portfolio of content, including Retail, Stills, Video, OOH, digital, post-production, and VFX, executed in both studio and location settings.
  • Oversee and support moderate to complex productions, ensuring a high standard of documentation and output across editing, colour grading, audio recording/mixing, packaging, and delivery.
  • Ensure client briefs are scoped and estimated accurately and on time, resolving any project clashes efficiently.
  • Interrogate and manage the needs and expectations of internal and external stakeholders regarding all aspects of project delivery (costs, timings, quality of output, change requests, risks).

Project & Financial Management:

  • Be confident in the development and management timing plans, estimates, and budget trackers for individual projects, monitoring progress against key milestones daily/weekly.
  • Ensure timely review and approval of timelines, estimates, and scope of work for new projects by senior production leads.
  • Actively manage and mitigate risks and issues throughout the project lifecycle, escalating to senior production leads when necessary to resolve blockers.
  • Monitor project burn rates and proactively flag any overruns, supporting post-project reconciliations for analysis and reporting of projected vs. actual time/budget/profitability.
  • Ensure projects within your remit are delivered profitably through accurate estimating, timely reconciliation, job closure, and minimising write-offs against set targets.
  • Recognise and flag instances of missed revenue and scope/timing overruns, sharing learnings for continuous improvement..

Collaboration & Leadership:

  • Develop trust-based relationships with relevant client contacts, crew, supplier, and agency partners.
  • Work collaboratively with all content studio members to produce the best possible work within agreed budgets and timeframes.
  • Support and collaborate with colleagues, offering mentoring and guidance to more junior colleagues.
  • Promote a collaborative environment within your studio team and across the broader Content Studios department.
  • Contribute to and participate in onboarding programs for new hires as required.

ABOUT YOU

  • Likely to have at least 2-3 years experience in content production, content marketing, or a related field, with a strong depth of proficiency across various forms of media (marketing content, photography, integrated communications, post, social, OOH).
  • Demonstrated ability to take a client brief through all stages of content creation, making, and optimisation.
  • Exceptional project management skills, including scoping, scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and client expectation management.
  • Developing commercial acumen, with experience in creating estimates and POs, tracking budgets, and understanding of the importance of maintaining project profitability.
  • Proficiency in coordinating the post-production pipeline (edit, colour grading, audio, packaging, delivery).
  • Excellent client engagement and relationship-building skills, with the ability to interrogate needs and manage expectations effectively.
  • Collaborative mindset, with experience working with creative, strategy, client delivery, and post-production teams.
  • A keen eye for detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality output across all projects.
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adhere to tight deadlines.
  • A proactive, positive, and constructive approach to feedback and team collaboration.
  • An interest in staying current with industry trends, insights, and innovations in content production

OUR VALUES

Together, our people give us the edge. Together, they make us brilliant.

Our shared behaviours:

  • Honesty: We communicate openly and honestly
  • Happy Family: We are a diverse and inclusive community
  • Heart & Soul: We are committed to bringing our whole self to work
  • Hunger: We strive for brilliance every time
  • Hands-on: We dig and support one another

WHY HOGARTH?

We are dedicated at creating a truly inclusive culture at all levels of the organisation that encourages different points of view, making Hogarth not only a better company and place to work, but an environment where everyone experiences connection, opportunity and a sense of belonging.

Your growth, development and success are important to us. That's why we have a structured career framework and development program in place, including a clear career plan and access to local and global online learning platforms to support your personal and professional growth.

Balance is important too. Our flexible working arrangements, combining working from home and the office, allow you to balance your professional and personal commitments.

Other benefits include Summer Half Days, Birthday Leave, Loyalty Leave, perkSpace (our internal perks and benefits hub full of resources to support your mental, physical, social and financial wellbeing, including discounts at hundreds of retailers and service-providers), dog-friendly offices with unlimited snacks and drinks, and wellness benefits (including Employee Assistance Program and flu shots, to name a few).

title: Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D based in France.

As a Middle/Senior Unity Developer R&D, you’ll help evolve a live mobile game by building new gameplay systems, LiveOps features, and scalable technical solutions.
You’ll work across the full development lifecycle, from implementing new mechanics to improving architecture, performance, stability, and maintainability.
A strong focus of the role is on modern AI-assisted development, with opportunities to integrate AI agents into real production workflows and automate recurring engineering tasks.
You’ll investigate real-world production issues using telemetry and profiling data, ensuring a smooth experience across a wide range of mobile devices.
The role also offers significant technical ownership, including participation in architectural decisions, code reviews, optimization initiatives, and development practices.
You’ll collaborate closely with other technical and product-focused team members while contributing ideas that can improve both engineering efficiency and the game itself.
This is an R&D-oriented opportunity for a developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, experimenting with new tools, and seeing their work make a measurable product impact.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain gameplay systems and features using Unity and C# within a released mobile game, while evolving architecture and reducing technical debt.
  • Implement and maintain LiveOps functionality, including events, promotions, seasonal content, and A/B testing.
  • Work with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, and Remote Configs to enable content and feature updates without requiring a full application release.
  • Actively use AI agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent tools in day-to-day development on a real production codebase.
  • Create and maintain internal AI skills, rules, and agent instructions that automate recurring team workflows while taking responsibility for the quality of generated results.
  • Investigate and resolve ANRs, crashes, freezes, OOM issues, and other production problems using real telemetry and diagnostic data.
  • Optimize CPU usage, memory consumption, startup time, application size, and downloadable content for different classes of Android devices.
  • Integrate and maintain advertising, analytics, monetization, and third-party SDKs while ensuring tracking and event implementation remain accurate.
  • Conduct code reviews and contribute to important technical and architectural decisions.
  • Share effective AI-assisted development practices and help improve the team's engineering workflows.
  • Profile and optimize Android and iOS applications using tools such as Unity Profiler, Crashlytics, and Android Vitals.
  • Investigate performance regressions and follow complex technical issues from symptoms through root-cause analysis, implementation, and validation of results.
  • Consider product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV when evaluating technical and gameplay decisions.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of commercial experience with Unity and C#, including experience working on released mobile games and supporting projects through LiveOps rather than only developing them prior to launch.
    • Strong understanding of Unity project architecture, including design patterns, dependency injection with tools such as Zenject or VContainer, asynchronous programming with UniTask, Unity lifecycle, memory management, and garbage collection.
    • Practical experience with AI development agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, including the ability to decompose tasks, provide appropriate context from large codebases, and validate generated code.
    • Experience with MCP, including Unity MCP or similar approaches, as well as skills, rules, and agent-instruction workflows.
    • Ability to document team development practices in a way that allows AI agents to reproduce them consistently.
    • Hands-on experience with Addressables, Asset Bundles, CDN delivery, Remote Configs, versioning, caching, and fallback scenarios.
    • Strong profiling and optimization experience across Android and/or iOS, including investigation of ANRs, crashes, OOM issues, and production performance regressions.
    • Understanding of low-end Android devices, device fragmentation, and mobile build-size optimization.
    • Experience integrating third-party SDKs for advertising, analytics, and in-app purchases.
    • Familiarity with Git workflows, code review practices, and CI/CD.
    • Ability to take a complex technical problem from symptom identification through root-cause analysis, solution implementation, and verification of the outcome.
    • Understanding of product metrics such as retention, CPI, and LTV.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to technical challenges.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions, and communicate complex engineering topics clearly.
    • Experience in an R&D-oriented environment is advantageous.
    • Professional Ukrainian language proficiency is expected.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work within Europe, with remote-first flexibility.
      • Personal benefit budget that can be allocated toward insurance, education, fitness, or other areas supporting personal wellbeing.
      • Performance-based bonuses recognizing meaningful results, initiative, and contribution to team success.

description:
Overview

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

LMI is seeking a skilled Network Engineer to design, build, maintain, and sustain classified network infrastructure supporting enterprise IT operations across three geographically dispersed government sites, including two greenfield SCIF facilities serving TS/SCI users. This individual will work with cross-functional teams to ensure reliable, secure connectivity across multiple locations.

Primary duties include:

  • Design, implement, configure, test, maintain, and sustain enterprise network infrastructure and services across all sites.

  • Develop logical and physical network designs based on performance, availability, security, and operational requirements.

  • Engineer resilient connectivity across sites, datacenters, cloud, wide-area networks, and other distributed environments.

  • Apply sound principles for addressing segmentation, routing, switching, traffic management, and access control.

  • Monitor network health, capacity, latency, availability, and utilization.

  • Troubleshoot complex network issues using structured analysis, packet-level inspection, telemetry, logs, and performance data.

  • Establish redundancy, failover, fault isolation, and recovery mechanisms.

  • Integrate network security controls consistent with zero-trust and defense-in-depth principles.

  • Develop repeatable configurations, validation procedures, automation, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

  • Maintain accurate diagrams, configurations, interface definitions, operating procedures, and change records.

  • Participate in change management, incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action planning.

  • Collaborate with systems, network, cybersecurity, and operations teams.

  • Evaluate technologies based on standards compliance, interoperability, lifecycle cost, supportability, and mission suitability.

  • Design and implement network automation that standardizes configuration, testing, deployment, monitoring, and compliance while reducing human error and accelerating the delivery of reliable network services.

  • Support design and integration of video teleconferencing (VTC) and conference room AV capability across all program sites, including classified and unclassified variants.

  • Support network and security operations center (NOC/SOC) functions, including monitoring tools, coverage models, and 24x7 support where required.

FOUNDATIONAL SKILLS

  • Network models, packet flow, encapsulation, and protocol behavior.
  • IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, subnetting, name resolution, and address-management principles.
  • Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, routing, switching, and segmentation.
  • Transport protocols, application traffic patterns, and quality-of-service principles.
  • Network security, encryption, access control, secure remote access, and traffic inspection.
  • Wide-area, datacenter, cloud, and software-defined networking concepts.
  • High availability, redundancy, load distribution, and failure-domain design.
  • Network monitoring, telemetry, logging, packet analysis, and performance engineering.
  • Scripting, automation, version control, and configuration-management fundamentals.
  • Structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

Location: This position is based in the Washington, DC metro area, with travel to program locations.

Travel: This position requires approximately 25-50% travel to support activities across multiple program locations.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of network engineering experience, including in classified environments.

  • Working knowledge of routing, switching, and network security fundamentals.

  • Relevant certification (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, Security+).

  • Familiarity with ICD 705 physical security standards for SCIF design and accreditation.

  • Familiarity with the Risk Management Framework (RMF) per NIST SP 800-37 and NIST SP 800-53 for system security authorization.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting cross-domain or multi-level security network solutions.

  • Experience deploying networks in newly constructed or renovated facilities.

  • Demonstrated experience leading or supporting large, geographically dispersed teams.

  • Experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) facilities, systems, or environments.

TS/SCI clearance and SAP eligibility are required for this position. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. LMI will only consider applicants with current security clearances. Please note that only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Target salary range: $90,000 - $150,000

title: Business Analyst
description:
Salary: $80,000 – $100,000 per year

Business Analyst – ERP / Complex Business Systems

Remote / Work From Home – Australia
SaaSplications

A BA role with depth, variety and long-term customer relationships

SaaSplications is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join a small, established software team working with a broad and deep business platform used across multiple industries.

This is an unusual BA opportunity for someone who enjoys both variety and depth.

We have close, ongoing relationships with our customers and often work much more like an extension of their internal team than a traditional software supplier.

You might be helping one customer improve an employee or training process, another rethink inventory or purchasing, and another design a completely different operational workflow.

Over time, you get to understand not only our software, but how a range of different businesses actually work.

As you develop that knowledge, we want you to become someone our customers trust to help them think through changes to their businesses.

You get the depth that comes from working with the same customers and platform over many years, while still enjoying the variety of working across different businesses and industries.

About us

Our core team has worked together for around 10 years.

We have highly experienced and capable developers and testers, a substantial existing platform and long-standing customer relationships.

Our platform is multi-tenanted and supports customers across different industries. It is both broad and deep, with many interconnected business processes.

We don't believe every customer should be forced into a generic industry workflow.

We work closely with customers to understand how they want their business to operate and extend our platform to support those processes.

At the same time, because we have a multi-tenanted platform, a requirement that begins with one customer often causes us to consider whether the underlying capability could be designed flexibly enough to benefit other customers as well.

That balance is an important part of our solution design:

Meet the customer's real business need without unnecessarily limiting the solution to one customer or one way of working.

Why we're hiring

We want to improve the work that happens before development starts.

Where we currently lose time is when a requirement hasn't been worked through sufficiently end-to-end with the customer before it reaches development.

The initial requirement may appear clear, but questions, exceptions or alternative scenarios can emerge once the customer sees the developed solution. That results in changes and avoidable development rework.

We want an experienced BA to help us move more of that thinking forward.

The objective is to reach a point where the proposed solution has been properly investigated, made tangible through flows and designs, challenged internally, understood by the customer and approved by both the customer and our development team before the build starts.

Understanding context is important

Our relationship with a customer doesn't end when a project is delivered.

Their businesses evolve. Processes change, new services are introduced, personnel change and new requirements emerge.

It is therefore very common for us to extend or modify functionality that we previously designed and built with a customer.

You won't be starting from a blank sheet each time.

Before designing a change, you will need to understand:

  • how the customer currently operates;

  • what we have previously built with them;

  • why the existing process was designed that way;

  • what has now changed;

  • how the customer is actually using the system;

  • what existing functionality can be reused or extended;

  • what other parts of their business or our system may be affected; and

  • whether the requirement has implications or opportunities across our wider customer base.

To help you do this, you will have access to relevant source code, Confluence documentation, existing screens, Figma designs, diagrams, process flows and the knowledge of our experienced team.

You don't need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable investigating an existing complex system and working closely with technical people.

What you will do

You will take requirements that may initially be incomplete and work with the customer and our team to turn them into considered, developer-ready solutions.

Depending on the requirement, your work may include:

  • customer discovery and requirements discussions;

  • understanding existing business processes;

  • investigating current system functionality;

  • reviewing relevant existing code and documentation;

  • identifying missing requirements, assumptions and edge cases;

  • considering system and business impacts;

  • designing process and user flows;

  • creating Figma wireframes and screen designs;

  • defining business rules, validations and permissions;

  • considering how a solution should work across our multi-tenanted platform;

  • documenting exceptions and alternative scenarios;

  • developing acceptance criteria;

  • developing sample end-to-end testing flows as part of the design;

  • taking the design through customer and developer review;

  • refining the solution following that review; and

  • helping maintain the associated help and training documentation.

We don't want documentation for documentation's sake.

The objective is to make the proposed solution sufficiently tangible and considered that the customer can say:

“Yes, this is how we need it to work.”

And our developers can say:

“Yes, this works with the wider system and is ready to build.”

Rigorous review is part of our process

Our developers have worked with the platform for many years and have deep knowledge of its architecture and the ways different parts of the system interact.

We want the BA to take advantage of that knowledge.

Developer review is part of solution design, not simply a handover after the design is finished.

You should expect your proposed solution to be challenged.

A developer may question an assumption, identify existing functionality you weren't aware of, point out an impact elsewhere in the platform or suggest a simpler or more flexible approach.

We consider this valuable.

We are looking for someone who actively welcomes rigorous review, is comfortable explaining their reasoning and is equally comfortable changing a design when the review identifies a better solution.

The goal isn't to defend the first design.

The goal is for experienced people with different perspectives to challenge it until we collectively have confidence in the solution.

Our process is broadly:

Understand → Investigate → Design → Review → Refine → Agree testing flows → Customer & developer approval → Build → Test → Document & train

AI is an important part of how we want to work

We are enthusiastic users of AI and believe it can significantly accelerate good business analysis and solution design.

We would particularly like someone who already uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Codex or similar as part of their work.

You will be encouraged to use AI to help:

  • investigate existing source code and functionality;

  • bring together information from code, documentation, diagrams and screens;

  • identify gaps, questions and edge cases;

  • explore alternative solutions;

  • create and critique workflows;

  • accelerate Figma wireframing and prototyping;

  • develop requirements and acceptance criteria;

  • identify system impacts; and

  • develop comprehensive testing scenarios.

We aren't interested in producing AI-generated documentation simply because it can be produced quickly.

The end result must be considered, accurate and usable.

We see AI as a way to investigate more thoroughly, explore more possibilities and produce better designs in less time.

Help documentation is part of the solution

Our customer and internal help documentation is currently maintained in Atlassian Confluence, and helping us maintain and improve it will be an important part of this role.

Because we build functionality around the particular processes our customers want to operate, good documentation is especially important.

The people involved in designing a feature today may not be the people using it several years from now.

When customer personnel change, knowledge can be lost. Customers can stop using valuable functionality they previously requested simply because new personnel don't know why it exists, what it can do or how it should be used.

Good documentation therefore protects our customer's investment in the solution and our investment in developing it.

As you work with the system, you will help us:

  • identify missing, unclear or outdated documentation;

  • maintain existing Confluence help material as functionality evolves;

  • document new functionality;

  • create useful training material;

  • use screenshots, diagrams and examples where appropriate;

  • explain not only what functionality does, but where appropriate when, why and how to use it; and

  • improve the quality and organisation of our knowledge base over time.

A successful change should leave us with more than working software.

It should leave the customer and our team with a lasting understanding of what was built, why it exists, how it fits into the business process and how to use it effectively.

About you

We expect you will have substantial experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst or Functional Analyst working with complex business software.

Experience extending an existing ERP, SaaS platform or other broad integrated business system would be particularly valuable.

You are likely to enjoy this role if you:

  • genuinely enjoy understanding how different businesses operate;

  • like building long-term relationships with customers;

  • enjoy variety and learning about different industries;

  • can turn an initially incomplete requirement into a considered solution;

  • naturally investigate existing functionality before designing something new;

  • think about the wider business and system impacts of a change;

  • can move comfortably between customer conversations and technical discussions;

  • enjoy making ideas tangible through process flows, diagrams and Figma;

  • think about testing while designing, rather than after development;

  • actively seek constructive feedback on your work;

  • are comfortable having experienced developers challenge your design;

  • are willing to change your approach when someone identifies a better solution;

  • are interested in using AI extensively to improve the quality and speed of your work; and

  • are comfortable working independently from home as part of a small, experienced team.

You don't need to know our system or our customers on day one.

A significant part of the opportunity is building that knowledge over time and becoming a trusted member of the wider team supporting each customer's business.

Applying

Please send us your CV together with a short introduction.

We'd particularly like to hear about:

  1. A complex ERP or business system you have worked with and the kinds of changes you helped design.

  2. How you take an initial customer request through to something ready for development.

  3. An example where feedback from a developer, customer or other specialist significantly changed or improved something you had designed.

  4. An example where understanding the existing system or wider business process changed the solution you initially expected to build.

  5. How you currently use AI in your BA or solution-design work.

  6. Your experience with Figma, process diagrams, wireframes and help or training documentation.

You don't need to write an essay. Specific examples are much more useful to us than formal responses.

Our recruitment process

We don't want applicants spending hours completing unpaid exercises.

We'll initially review your CV and responses above and speak with applicants whose experience appears to fit what we're looking for.

That initial conversation will focus on work you've actually done: the systems you've worked with, how you approach requirements and solution design, how you work with customers and developers, and how you use AI.

A smaller number of candidates will then progress to a more detailed discussion.

Only a few shortlisted candidates will be invited to undertake a paid practical exercise based on the type of work we actually do.

You will be encouraged to use AI and your normal tools.

The exercise won't only be about the first design you produce. We will review it with you, challenge some of the assumptions and provide additional information — just as our developers and customers will in the role.

We will be interested in how you respond to that review and how the solution improves as a result.

It should give us a good understanding of how you work — and give you a realistic view of what it would be like to work with us.

title: Senior Systems Engineer, Charging Systems
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview:

At Lucid, charging is not just a feature - it is a defining product attribute that blends high-voltage technology, system architecture, and customer experience into a seamless, industry-leading vehicle capability.

We are currently seeking Senior Systems Engineer, Charging Systems, to be part of a passionate, highly driven multi-disciplinary engineering team developing next-generation high-voltage(HV) systems and architectures. The successful candidate will exhibit a clear understanding of electric vehicle charging system and development thereof. The candidate will be responsible for definition of Model Based Systems Engineering deliverables of one or more charging features of Lucid products. This role will contribute to world-class charging attributes (e.g., fast charge rates, efficiency, battery health optimization) that directly impact range, cost, and customer experience.

The role will require cross-functional engagement with product management, vehicle engineering teams, software engineers, hardware engineers and verification and validation teams. A thorough understanding of system development lifecycle(s) is required to be successful in this role, gained through prior OEM or Tier 1 industry experience.

Our ideal candidate exhibits a proactive, can-do attitude and approaches their work systematically with vigor, determination and accuracy. Candidates will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, to possess the ability to learn quickly and to strive for perfection within a fast-paced environment.

What you will do:

  • Lead the end-to-end capture and definition of requirements for advancing leading class vehicle charging features, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to shape cutting-edge EV experiences.
  • Shape charging system architectures using Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), driving functional decomposition, signal definition, and cross-domain integration across vehicle systems.
  • Translate high-level feature concepts into robust, implementable subsystem and component-level requirements that enable precise vehicle functionality
  • Partner with Functional Safety Engineers to develop safety concepts, taking ownership of Technical Safety Concepts using proven methodologies such as FMEA and FTA
  • Drive alignment with verification & validation teams to define comprehensive test strategies and ensure successful execution against requirements
  • Collaborate closely with HV domain and software engineering teams to define, refine, and manage performance requirements for high-voltage system controls
  • Contribute to the development and execution of product-level validation plans, ensuring features meet performance, safety, and customer expectations
  • Investigate and resolve real-world vehicle charging issues through data-driven analysis, continuously enhancing system performance and user experience
  • Coordinate systems engineering lifecycle activities with program management to successfully deliver milestones and product releases on schedule
  • Champion continuous improvement of systems engineering practices, driving innovation and excellence across the organization

What you bring:

  • 4+ years of experience delivering systems engineering solutions for automotive controls products in a production environment
  • 4+ years of hands-on application of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) to drive design, analysis, and development workflows
  • Deep working knowledge of vehicle charging standards, including SAE J1772/J3400 and ISO 15118
  • Experience with Automotive embedded electronic product development
  • Solid experience applying ISO 26262 to drive system requirements, architecture, and safety-driven design decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver across multiple vehicle programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong data-driven problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze and debug complex vehicle issues
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Highly detail-oriented with a disciplined approach to documentation, traceability, and reporting
  • Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership, a proactive mindset, and a collaborative approach to problem solving

Ways to Standout:

  • Hands-on expertise with Cameo/Magic Cyber Systems Engineer and strong proficiency in SysML-based modeling
  • Proven experience applying FMEA and structured risk management methodologies in complex engineering environments
  • Solid understanding of electrical, electronic, and programmable systems, with the ability to connect system behavior to component-level design
  • Familiarity with AUTOSAR architecture and its application in modern automotive software platforms
  • INCOSE Systems Engineering certification (ASEP or CSEP), demonstrating a strong foundation in industry best practices

Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechanical engineering or another related technical discipline is required.
  • Master’s degree or higher education is preferred.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

We're looking for product-minded Principal Engineers. This is a hands-on P60 individual-contributor role for engineers who sit at the seam between deep technical craft and sharp product judgment — and can hold both at once. You'll own customer-facing products end to end across the full stack, shape what gets built rather than just how, and build the next generation of AI-native and agentic experiences used by teams all over the planet.

Responsibilities

  • Own customer-facing product features end to end across the full stack — React/TypeScript front ends, backend services, and APIs — taking ambiguous problems all the way to shipped, measured outcomes.

  • Make architecture and technical decisions in service of user and business outcomes; let product goals drive the engineering, not the other way around.

  • Use telemetry and user behavior to shape design — define success metrics (north star and guardrails), instrument, monitor, run root-cause deep dives, and change your mind when the data says so.

  • Design and build AI-enabled and agentic experiences, integrating LLMs and AI workflows into products that reach millions of users.

  • Set technical direction for your team and influence product strategy, partnering closely with product managers, designers, and platform teams.

  • Raise the engineering bar through code, design reviews, coaching, and mentoring — leading by craft as a senior individual contributor.

  • Find the highest-leverage problems in ambiguous spaces, prototype quickly, and drive prototypes to production-grade quality, reliability, and performance at scale.

title: HIL Test Automation Engineer
description:
At Terabase Energy, we believe that digitalization and automation will drive the next wave of innovation and cost reduction in large scale solar. To fully unlock the potential of this opportunity, Terabase is developing an interconnected software and construction automation platform. We work alongside project developers, owners, and engineering & construction firms to support the design, optimization, and construction of huge solar projects around the world. Our team is a blend of solar-industry veterans and newbies, thought-leaders, dreamers, software, electrical and mechanical engineers, coders, product managers, project managers, and sales and marketing professionals. We are based in Northern California, with several other offices in the United States and around the world.

Job description

Test Automation Engineer is responsible to develop, and execute automated test frameworks for environments like SIL(Software-in-the-loop) and HIL(Hardware-in-the-loop), that allow us to test our power plant controller and SCADA system. Your mission is to build the automated frameworks that catch edge cases before they hit the field, ensuring every product we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Automation Framework Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks and scripts for power, control and SCADA systems using Python. You will transition our validation processes from manual intervention to a fully automated, scalable framework.
  • V&V Strategy: Define and execute comprehensive Verification and Validation (V&V) plans, ensuring all software requirements for the site controller and SCADA systems are met under normal and fault conditions
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated HIL/SIL testing into our CI/CD pipelines, providing real-time feedback to the development teams and serving as the final gate for production-ready code
  • Requirements Investigation: Analyze and interpret technical specifications to author comprehensive automated test suites, actively tracking down gaps in system requirements.
  • Multi-Environment Execution: Execute automated test suites across SIL, MIL, and HIL setups.Analyze test captures, isolate system failures, and generate detailed engineering reports.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Work closely with the controls and systems teams to debug complex failures found during validation, using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and telemetry logs to pinpoint issues

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in software validation or test automation for hardware-focused systems.
  • Programming Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, alongside a practical reading knowledge of PLC/RTAC/IEC 61131-3 Control logic.
  • Automation Toolchains: Direct experience architecting or heavily extending modern pythonic test frameworks (such as Pytest or OpenHTF).
  • Systematic Thinking: A dedicated mindset for "breaking" software. You have a track record of finding critical edge cases in complex state machines and control loops
  • Infrastructure: Experience with Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, and containerization tools like Docker for managing consistent test environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of NERC, FERC, ISO/RTO, and utility interconnection requirements is preferred.
  • Experience with utility-scale solar PV, Battery ---Energy Storage Systems (BESS), hybrid renewable energy plants, or inverter-based resources (IBR) is preferred.
  • Version Control: Advance user-level with Git and modern branch management strategies.

Communication protocols (e.g., IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3)

title: Senior Capacity Delivery Reliability Planner , AWS Infra Supply Chain
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you ready to architect the digital backbone of tomorrow? We're seeking a Senior Supply Capacity Delivery Reliability Planner to lead end-to-end capacity and planning orchestration across strategic, enterprise, operational, and tactical levels in our global cloud infrastructure organization. This isn't just a job – it's your chance to directly influence how we scale and deliver the infrastructure powering the digital world.

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of driving step-change capabilities and business process transformations in SIOP environments. They should have experience delivering tangible improvements in speed, accuracy, visibility, and cross-functional alignment. In this role, you will be a key architect in transforming critical aspects of our operations. Specifically, you will lead efforts to revolutionize how demand is captured, capacity is allocated, and infrastructure is built at a hyperscale level.


Key job responsibilities
Strategic Level: You will define and evolve multi-year cloud infrastructure strategies aligned with business growth, sustainability, and global risk trends. Leading cross-functional strategic capacity modeling to support emerging workloads (such as AI/ML and HPC) and future region expansions will be a crucial part of your role. Additionally, you'll drive long-term innovation in planning frameworks and digital planning tools to support dynamic business shifts.

Enterprise Level: Your responsibilities include delivering enterprise-wide SIOP transformations that break down silos between engineering, supply chain, finance, manufacturing, and infrastructure delivery. You'll design and implement scenario-based capacity planning, integrating hardware, power, land, and construction considerations. Establishing a resilient planning governance model with visibility from executive reviews to regional deployment readiness will also fall under your purview.

Operational Level: You'll be tasked with translating strategic demand into executable regional build and fulfillment plans, managing infrastructure readiness across supply constraints. Leading cross-regional planning standardization and continuous improvement efforts to reduce cycle time and increase delivery velocity will be essential. You'll also drive alignment between planning, sourcing, and manufacturing teams to ensure predictable outcomes.

Tactical Level: Your day-to-day responsibilities will include orchestrating the execution of plans and handling exceptions across global regions. You'll monitor fulfillment signals, adjust plans in real-time, and escalate barriers to delivery to ensure near-zero disruption. Deploying automation and advanced analytics to proactively identify and solve risks and bottlenecks will be a key aspect of your tactical duties.


About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Software Engineer, Data Access
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

We're looking for an outstanding engineer to join our Data Access team within Infra / Storage where we build EaaS (Entities-as-a-Service), Roblox’s large-scale managed OLTP access and management platform powering tens of millions of QPS across thousands of services. EaaS abstracts the complexity of distributed databases and caching systems behind a consistent and productive developer experience, enabling teams across Roblox to safely build and operate stateful systems at massive scale without requiring deep database expertise.

The team operates at the intersection of distributed systems engineering, reliability engineering, and platform architecture — solving hard infrastructure problems that directly impact Roblox-wide scale and stability.

  • Analyze real production traffic patterns and failure modes to improve platform reliability, operational predictability, and scalability under rapidly growing workloads.
  • Improve platform safety, observability, deployment reliability, and operational excellence across the stack.
  • Partner with teams across Roblox to solve real scalability and reliability challenges for critical production workloads.

You Have:

  • 1+ years of experience building large-scale backend or infrastructure systems. An understanding of building systems that operate at high QPS with low-latency requirements is a plus. Experience working on infrastructure or performance-critical backend systems is a plus.
  • Knowledge: You are proficient in one or more programming languages (C#, C++, Go, Python or similar programming language).
  • Curiosity: You are curious and passionate about solving open-ended problems. You can identify challenges, develop a deep understanding of the systems involved, and drive solutions in collaboration with your team.

title: Applied ML Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in Italy.

As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering.
You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products.
The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences.
You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate.
You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users.
The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack.
It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust.

Accountabilities

  • Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models.
  • Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses.
  • Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required.
  • Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility.
  • Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows.
  • Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion.
  • Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations.
  • Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses.
  • Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve.
  • During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface.
  • Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
    • Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility.
    • Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages.
    • Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation.
    • Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate.
    • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users.
    • Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests.
    • High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently.
    • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions.
    • Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus.
    • Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial.
    • Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus.
    • Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable.
    • Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage.
    • A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on applied machine learning at the intersection of research, experimentation, engineering, and product.
      • End-to-end ownership across model evaluation, model internals, infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing experiences.
      • Exposure to modern open-weight models, LLM inference systems, and emerging ML verification techniques.
      • A role with significant technical autonomy and the opportunity to shape both experiments and production systems.
      • Fast-moving startup environment with evolving priorities and cross-functional collaboration.
      • Opportunity to translate cutting-edge research into practical, measurable, and user-accessible products.
      • The opportunity to build systems and evaluation methodologies designed to produce evidence that users can understand and trust.
      • Location: Romania.
      • Additional compensation, flexibility, healthcare, and other benefits may be provided according to the partner company's employment package and local arrangements.

title: Senior Director - Casino Content Strategy
description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What's the position?

The Senior Director – Content Strategy is the single, full-time owner of casino content strategy for Hard Rock Digital, across every state/territory we operate in.

The role sits at the centre of the casino content ecosystem — game portfolio strategy, supplier and IP sourcing, and the increasingly important link between digital casino content and land-based (property) gaming. It reports directly to the VP, Casino Commercial, and works day to day alongside the Supplier Relations, Slots & Jackpots, and Live Dealer & Table Games functions without managing them.

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Single Source of Truth

  • Own the single source of truth for casino content strategy across Florida (PMR), New Jersey, Michigan, Ontario and Mexico — one roadmap, one prioritisation view.

  • Build and maintain a rolling content roadmap across slots, live casino, table games, jackpots, and branded/exclusive content, sequenced against certification and launch timelines in each market.

  • Present a quarterly content strategy review to the business— findings, roadmap performance, and updated priorities.

Content Sourcing & IP

  • Lead content-release tasks end to end: securing IP, briefing suppliers on branded and exclusive games, and managing multiple concurrent content sources against a single delivery calendar.

  • Identify and prioritise exclusivity opportunities, timed-exclusive windows, and bespoke content deals across our supplier base (including Playtech, Games Global, Section 8, AGS, Bragg Studios, and direct-integration partners).

  • Bring order to the PMR Florida content strategy specifically — track a shifting supplier landscape, apply one consistent evaluation and prioritisation framework, and be the named point of accountability.

Property Gaming & Omni Content Relationship

  • Close the content-to-property gaming gap: build and hold an ongoing working relationship with property-side gaming leadership — the VPs and leads for slots and table games at key Hard Rock properties — and with the supplier management function inside Hard Rock International that governs land-based game content.

  • This is distinct from the existing Hard Rock Properties Omni team, which is focused on activation (staffing, sign-up drives, digital events, signage) rather than games. This role is the games-side counterpart that team does not have today.

  • Align key digital content releases to land-based release moments so that both sides of a launch are coordinated and monetised together — this is a particular priority in Florida, where many of the titles already secured from key partners are Omni titles by design.

Supplier & Portfolio Performance

  • Monitor player engagement and portfolio mix across all markets, working closely with Supplier Relations, Slots & Jackpots, and Live Dealer & Table Games.

  • Track costs and implement a cost efficient content framework.

  • Maintain a mandatory input right on content decisions made by the Supplier Relations, Slots & Jackpots, and Live Dealer & Table Games functions, ensuring every decision is made against the same strategic roadmap.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years' experience in online casino or iGaming, with a strong track record in content strategy, game portfolio management, or supplier/IP sourcing.

  • Deep knowledge of the casino content supply landscape — suppliers, aggregators, certification processes across US regulated states and international markets.

  • Comfort operating as an individual contributor with high strategic ownership — this role drives outcomes through process, relationships and a mandatory input right, not through direct management authority.

  • Experience or strong interest in Omni-channel / land-based-to-digital content coordination; ability to build credibility quickly with property-side gaming leadership.

  • Strong analytical grounding — comfortable owning a roadmap, tracking KPIs, and presenting findings to senior stakeholders on a quarterly cadence.

What's in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

Operates and maintains the fresh food production areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza), prepares the areas for sales, fries food, operates the rotisserie oven, prepares ready-to-bake/baked pizzas, etc. Receives inventory, verifies receipt of ordered product, and stocks in designated areas. Consistently provides friendly, courteous service to internal and external customers. Performs other related work. Generally works 6-8 hour shifts between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Seeks opportunities to welcome, engage, serve, and thank customers. Maintains an atmosphere of friendly, enthusiastic customer service with an emphasis of taking care of the customer.
  • Takes orders, answers questions, and performs suggestive selling.
  • Prepares, stocks, displays, straightens, and rotates product in fresh food areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza).
  • Prepare production items according to recipes, food safety procedures, and/or specified cooking times
  • Handles frozen product.
  • Inspects all product for quality and freshness
  • Prepares case by putting the product in fresh pans, rotating product, putting product back, filling, etc.
  • Places proper signage on all products which includes pricing, description, code dating, and COOL information on all required products.
  • Cleans and maintains department equipment such as fryers, slicers, etc. by breaking down and reassembling equipment, operating dish washer and hand washing dishes, cleaning all appropriate parts with sanitizing solution.
