  • Receives inventory, stocks, verifies receipt of ordered product and orders.
  • Follows strict sanitary guidelines and completes associated records.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or needed.
  • Understands and follows all food safety procedures and requirements.

Requirements

Ability to:

  • Work varied shifts in a 24/7 operation; including night, weekends and holidays.
  • Communicate (hearing & speech) effectively with customers to receive orders and perform customer relation skills.
  • Conduct visual inspections, read and follow production guides, recipes and product labels, log production quantities, temperature readings, etc. on proper forms.
  • Perform basic math (add, subtract, divide and multiply) and compute weights and measures.
  • Perform duties with mental alertness involving potential hazards with respect to related procedures, equipment (e.g., knives) and work aides.
  • Complete training course and meet minimum time standards of productivity and accuracy.
  • Wear hair net, beard net and gloves and other personal protective equipment as required.
  • Use cleaning chemicals and handle related food products.
  • Stand, walk and move rapidly for extended periods of time.
  • Bend, stoop, twist, turn and reach over the counter and in tight areas frequently.
  • Lift up to 50 lbs. occasionally and reach, push and pull racks.
  • Handle refrigerated goods (-20°F to 28°F)
  • Work around machinery emitting heat (400°F rotisserie and 325°F hot shortening).
  • Must be 16 years of age or older.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately.

  • Food Handlers Certification (Per State Laws)

title: Speech Pathologist - Full Time
description:
Overview

Our team members are the heart of what makes us better. At Hackensack Meridian Health we help our patients live better, healthier lives — and we help one another to succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, our employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. Together, we keep getting better - advancing our mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.

The Speech Language Pathologist is responsible for the evaluation and treatment of individuals with communication and swallowing disorders within the scope of practice as defined by the State Department of New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs. The speech language pathologist is engaged in the processes of coordination, education,communication and documentation to ensure that the patient/client receives comprehensive, individualized and evidence based services. Settings may include inpatient (acute & rehab) and/or outpatient. The position may rotate to other services as per the program guidelines. The incumbent also performs other professional duties and participates in department/facility/network initiatives based on needs and opportunity.

Responsibilities

A day in the life of a Speech Pathologist at Hackensack Meridian Health includes:

  • Prepares for the evaluation of the patient/client in accordance with departmental policies/procedures and standards of practice including obtaining patient history, administering appropriate tests and measurements accurately and efficiently. Exhibits knowledge and understanding of patient/client's diagnoses. Integrates and synthesizes evaluation results, behavioral observations and information obtained from history to develop diagnostic impressions, goals and makes recommendations based on findings.
  • Establishes a plan of care with the client/patient/family based on functional, measurable, and realistic long and short term goals.
  • Performs all functions associated with the execution of therapeutic treatment for all age groups within the department's responsibility. Treatment reflects age and developmentally appropriate activities determined through analysis of data. Uses a systematic approach to clinical decision making.
  • Utilizes reassessment to modify goals, progress treatment, or recommend discontinuation of therapy.
  • Identifies the needs of the patient population served and modifies and delivers care that is specific to those needs (i.e., age, culture, language, hearing and/or visually impaired, etc.). This process includes communicating with the patient, parent and/or primary caregiver(s) at their level (developmental/age, educational, literacy, etc.) including referral of the patient/client to another health care professional or healthcare services.
  • Documentation is in accordance with policies and procedures. Collects and records accurate data/information in a manner that reflects an understanding of reimbursement systems and their impact on patient care. Records charges based on services provided.
  • Lifts a minimum of 50 lbs., pushes and pulls a minimum of 50 lbs. and stands a minimum of 1 hour a day.
  • Other duties and/or projects as assigned.
  • Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies, standards of behavior, and departmental policies and procedures.

Qualifications

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Master's Degree in speech-language pathology from an accredited institution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient computer skills that may include but are not limited to Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite platforms.

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Preferred:

  • Doctoral Degree in speech-language pathology from an accredited institution.
  • Experience preferred, CF/entry level acceptable.

Licenses and Certifications Required:

  • BLS AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification.
  • Must possess or be eligible for Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology issued by the American Speech-Language and Hearing Association.
  • Eligible for temporary or possesses permanent license in the State of New Jersey as a Speech-Language Pathologist.

Licenses and Certifications Preferred:

  • Specialty certifications.

The Scrum Master will lead Agile ceremonies, support the setup and maturation of Agile processes, and guide teams transitioning from traditional Waterfall methodologies to Agile frameworks. This role requires strong communication skills, hands‑on experience with multiple version control tools, and the ability to work effectively with cross‑functional engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, implement, and refine Agile practices across the team and program
  • Lead Agile ceremonies (daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog grooming)
  • Coach teams transitioning from Waterfall to Agile, ensuring smooth adoption of new workflows
  • Partner with product owners and stakeholders to maintain well‑prioritized backlogs

  • Track and report progress using industry-standard Agile metrics
  • Collaborate with engineering teams using diverse software languages and toolchains

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience setting up Agile frameworks and leading transitions from Waterfall
  • Professional experience as a Scrum Master or Agile facilitator
  • Experience with version control systems: Git, GitHub, Subversion

The role also provides exposure to emerging capabilities involving analytics, artificial intelligence, intelligent agents, and relationship intelligence.

  • Act as the technical data reference for a large-scale relational intelligence and fraud analytics platform.
  • Lead the evolution of data ingestion and update pipelines, ensuring reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Establish and strengthen standards for Data Quality, Data Lineage, Data Governance, Observability, and monitoring.
  • Evolve graph-oriented data models and manage complex entities and relationships at high volume.

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to define technical solutions and priorities.
  • Optimize data pipelines, platform performance, and cloud infrastructure costs within AWS environments.
  • Contribute to the development of analytical capabilities, APIs, and services focused on relational intelligence.
  • Participate in defining the future architecture of the data platform and support integrations with AI models, analytics solutions, and intelligent agents.

    • Proven experience working with high-volume data environments and cloud-based data architectures, preferably AWS.
    • Advanced Python and SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and optimizing data pipelines.
    • Experience with Apache Airflow, Git, REST APIs, ETL/ELT processes, and data orchestration.
    • Strong knowledge of Data Quality, Data Lineage, Data Governance, data modeling, data observability, and pipeline optimization.
    • Advanced AWS knowledge, particularly with services such as S3, IAM, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, Athena, or equivalent analytics services.

description:

This is a senior technical leadership role focused on shaping the frontend architecture and customer-facing digital experiences of a large-scale online platform. You will define technical direction, build high-performance web applications, and influence how frontend systems evolve over the long term. The role combines hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, cross-team leadership, and strategic decision-making. You will work closely with product, design, backend engineering, and senior leadership to turn ambitious ideas into reliable products. The environment is fast-moving and increasingly focused on AI-enabled development, modern architectural patterns, and engineering excellence. This is a fully remote opportunity with significant scope to influence technical standards, developer productivity, and the quality of experiences delivered to millions of users.

Accountabilities:

  • Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and long-term roadmap for frontend systems across the platform.
  • Lead the design and development of scalable, high-performance web applications serving millions of users.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical deep dives while maintaining high engineering standards.
  • Own critical production systems and drive operational excellence across observability, security, performance, and reliability.
  • Mentor senior engineers and help raise the engineering bar through coaching, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and senior leadership to align technical strategy with business objectives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, product quality, and engineering workflows.

    • 12+ years of hands-on frontend or full-stack development experience, including at least 2 years in a Principal, Staff, or equivalent technical leadership position.
    • Expert-level proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with deep expertise in React, including Hooks, Context API, component lifecycle, state management, routing, Server Components, and reusable component architecture.

RCH is a cornerstone member of the Melbourne Children’s Campus, partnering with Murdoch Children’s Research Institute, The University of Melbourne Department of Paediatrics and The Royal Children’s Hospital Foundation.

RCH has cared for the children and young people of Victoria for more than 150 years since it was founded in 1870. The Hospital has more than 6,000 staff, a budget of $850M, 12 wards and 350 beds. Annually, the RCH has 300,000+ Specialist Clinic appointments, 90,000+ Emergency Department presentations and 20,000 elective surgeries.

The RCH is committed to the Child Safe Standards.

RCH enjoys high employee engagement and is committed to staff safety and a positive culture through enactment of our Compact.

  • Review and document current business processes associated with rostering, time and attendance across all impacted departments
  • Work with operational teams to refine and improve processes to better meet RCH business needs and leverage Optima’s functional capabilities

Your skills and experience:

  • Demonstrated ability to document processes, user manuals, and standard operating procedures to a high standard
  • Proven experience working in a project environment, including the ability to work to tight timelines and meet deliverables

title: Food Services Supervisor (SDSU Children's Center)
description:
ASSOCIATED STUDENTS OF SAN DIEGO STATE UNIVERSITY

Department: Children's Center

Position Title: Food Services Supervisor

GENERAL PURPOSE: Under the general supervision of the Children's Center Director, the Food Services Supervisor is responsible for the implementation of the nutritional program meeting the needs of all children enrolled in the program. This includes meal planning that meet established guidelines; ordering lunch, supplies and equipment from outside vendors; preparing breakfast and snacks; overseeing all meal delivery to classrooms; and ensuring appropriate maintenance, sanitation and safety standards within the work area. The SDSU Children's Center is NAEYC accredited and adheres to the NAEYC Code of Conduct.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Primary Functions

  • Maintains knowledge of USDA Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) requirements and ensures the Center is compliant with the regulations
  • Creates menus, places orders, receives and prepares all foods in accordance with USDA Child and Adult Care Food Program guidelines
  • Creates menus to meet USDA CACFP guidelines and individual dietary needs of children with allergies or specific medical requests from the child's physician
  • Ensures accuracy of weights and measures for all food components served in accordance with USDA Child and Adult Care Food Program guidelines, including those produced by outside vendors
  • Arranges substitute coverage for staff when necessary, including cooking as needed
  • Conducts regular analysis of food costs and other CACFP costs to ensure maximum utilization of CACFP funding
  • Prepares documents for reimbursement, provides to accounting for review, and enters meal data in CNIPS by the tenth of each month
  • Maintains documentation of meal count data reimbursements in a secure location
  • Reviews Menu Production Sheets monthly to ensure nutrition requirements are being met
  • Makes recommendations for needed changes to supervisor to meet established guidelines as stipulated
  • Conducts regular walk through of the kitchen area, inspecting all equipment and materials to ensure proper maintenance, appearance and sanitation according to established guidelines and procedures
  • Ensures preparation of needed work orders or repair reports on proper forms with all pertinent information completed. Monitors the progress of requested work and priorities for work as required and reports to Children's Center Director all updated work priorities
  • Makes recommendations to supervisor for improvements to facilities and equipment
  • Works with staff to maintain a safe environment for children, staff and to report known safety problems to supervisor
  • Assists in the development and implementation of a comprehensive package of promotional efforts for the Children's Center
  • Assists in defining target markets
  • Monitors and updates web page content relating to the food program to ensure it is compelling and accurate
  • Makes suggestions for improvements to the overall Children's Center web page to ensure it is compelling and accurate
  • Prepares written reports, as necessary
  • Assists others in department with special tasks as assigned

Administration

  • Meets all corporate and departmental deadlines and follows procedures
  • Completes daily office tasks in a timely manner according to established guidelines
  • Orders supplies and equipment as needed
  • Maintains inventory system ensuring supplies are available to provide meal service to children enrolled in program
  • Produces daily menu production record documenting each meal component for all meals served in accordance with USDA CACFP guidelines
  • Reviews meal counts for accuracy as submitted by classroom staff
  • Ensures timely completion of dishwashing to meet established sanitary standards
  • Reviews and certifies all paperwork submitted by families as part of the Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP)
  • Ensures complete files are maintained for all children, families and staff according to CACFP guidelines
  • Maintains tracking and follow up system to ensure all paperwork is received to meet requirements
  • Conducts annual survey of food program and menu cycle and makes improvements as needed
  • Reviews menu changes with service provider
  • Ensures maintenance of accurate records for all transactions

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum and Preferred Requirements

Education:

  • High School Diploma required. Bachelor's degree and/or AA or AS (or equivalent) (preferably in Child Development, Nutrition, Health Education, or Health Science) preferred

Experience:

  • One year working in Child and Family Development required
  • Two years supervisory experience required. Experience supervising and working directly with college students preferred
  • Two years of experience in menu planning and food preparation required
  • One year working with the Child and Adult Care Food program (CACFP) preferred
  • Proficient with Excel and Word software
  • Must have experience in supporting families with nutrition needs

License & Certifications:

  • Current certification for Food Service Manager Training required (within 30 days of hire and then renewed every 5 years)
  • Food Handler Training certification required (within 7 days of hire and renewed annually)
  • Valid CA driver's license with a clear driving record upon hire

Trainings (within first 30 days):

  • Universal Health Precautions, Blood-borne Pathogens and infectious waste disposal
  • Site safety and emergency procedures including fire and earthquake drills
  • Anti-Harassment Training for Supervisors
  • Workplace Violence Prevention
  • Data Security & Privacy
  • Gender Awareness Training

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Must professionally represent the Associated Students and San Diego State University at all times
  • Must be able to successfully fulfill the Essential Duties of this job description and meet performance expectations
  • Highly organized, confidential and reliable individual with keen written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work in a diverse, frequently changing population of students, faculty and staff
  • Capable of maintaining positive working relationships with staff, University, customers and vendors
  • Thorough knowledge of the most up-to-date nutritional standards for children, including portion sizes
  • Keeps current of new issues and research in the field of early childhood nutrition
  • Works in an independent manner without undue supervision
  • Establishes mutual respect by showing an accepting attitude toward children, families, and co-workers
  • Shares new ideas with supervisor

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Excellent interpersonal skills; ability to relate and communicate effectively with a diverse population of students, staff, faculty, colleagues and guests
  • Must have strong communication skills (verbally and written) to communicate at a level appropriate to the duties of the position
  • Ability to operate a computer, proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google (i.e. slides, sheets, docs) with the ability to learn and utilize new software programs
  • Knowledge of USDA Guidelines for nutrition and meal service provided to children 6 months to 5 years of age
  • Knowledge of NAEYC best practices, licensing requirements, child abuse reporting, universal precautions, safety practices
  • Knowledge of the unique needs of student parent families outlined in the NAEYC Code of Ethics
  • Knowledge of adult learning styles and child development
  • Must have knowledge of child and family health care including preventative, early intervention, nutrition, and health maintenance practices
  • Proven necessary supervisory skills including, but are not limited to: hiring, inspecting, analyzing, planning, prioritizing, scheduling, assigning, receiving, controlling, training, instructing, documenting, recommending and reporting
  • Must have knowledge of community resources that offer services to low income families
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of young children, parents and staff
  • Must have the ability to communicate and coordinate with various professional and community services programs
  • Maintains professionalism at all times while providing positive customer service to children, students, families, staff, vendors and community
  • Provides effective and appropriate verbal and written communication
  • Demonstrates effective communication skills in conflict resolution
  • Works cooperatively with others and values working as part of a team
  • Demonstrates effective time management skills
  • Works in the high-stress environment that is unique to campus childcare settings
  • Record-keeping and administrative skills
  • Must be committed to a high standard of safety and be willing and able to comply with employer safety policies
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, verbal, diagram, or schedule form
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence

SCHEDULE & WORKING CONDITIONS

This is a regular, full-time position with the expected hours of Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

About the Children's Center: Year-round, campus-based, indoor-outdoor childcare center serving 200 children on a daily basis between the ages of 6 months to 5 years and their parents. Staff-child ratios: Infants (1:3), Toddlers (1:4), 2-Year olds (1:4), Preschooler (1:8) Classroom group size: Infants (9), Toddlers (12/16), 2 year olds (16/20), Preschooler (24). Children's Center operational hours are 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.

WORK ENVIRONMENT The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee is in a work environment that is frequently busy and has a tight workspace. The work environment also involves exposure to various elements including but not limited to: chemicals, dust, bloodborne pathogens and other environmental risks.

Working with project managers, technical specialists, business stakeholders and vendors, you will help ensure projects remain aligned, informed and on track to deliver outcomes that enhance Airservices Australia's future capability.

The Organisation

Airservices Australia is a government-owned organisation responsible for the safe and efficient management of 11% of the world’s airspace and provision of aviation rescue fire fighting services at Australia’s busiest airports.

Our people are our greatest asset with a dynamic and diverse team operating from locations across the country - from bustling cities to regional and remote locations, including an island. title: Kennel Assistant - Companion Animal Clinic- VA
description:
Join the Team at Companion Animal Clinic as a Full-Time Kennel Assistant!

Companion Animal Clinic in Fairfax Station, Virginia is looking for a compassionate, dependable, and hardworking Full-Time Kennel Assistant to join our team! If you love animals, enjoy being part of a team, and are looking for an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a veterinary hospital, this could be a great fit for you. Our Kennel Assistants play an incredibly important role in the day-to-day care of our patients and the overall operation of our hospital. From making sure pets are comfortable, clean, fed, and cared for to supporting our veterinary team and helping maintain a clean and organized hospital, this position is an essential part of the Companion team.

Schedule: Approximately 30–35 hours per week
Weekend availability is required
Compensation: $14–$16/hour, based on experience

About Companion Animal Clinic

Companion Animal Clinic is a full-service companion animal hospital located in Fairfax Station, Virginia. Our hospital is committed to providing high-quality veterinary medicine while creating a compassionate and welcoming experience for the pets and families we serve.

Our five-doctor veterinary team is supported by an experienced and dedicated group of veterinary professionals who work together to provide an exceptional standard of patient care. We value teamwork, communication, continued learning, and creating an environment where team members can grow their skills and feel like an important part of the hospital.

For someone interested in animal care or exploring a future career in veterinary medicine, the Kennel Assistant position is a wonderful opportunity to gain experience inside a veterinary hospital while working alongside veterinarians, technicians, assistants, and other experienced veterinary professionals.

What You'll Do

Provide Compassionate Animal Care

  • Help ensure the comfort, safety, and well-being of animals staying in our care.

  • Walk dogs and provide appropriate exercise and enrichment.

  • Feed and provide fresh water to patients according to their individual instructions.

  • Assist with basic patient care as directed by the veterinary team.

  • Observe patients for changes in behavior, appetite, comfort, or overall well-being and communicate any concerns to the appropriate medical team member.

  • Provide patience, kindness, and compassionate care to every animal.

Maintain a Clean & Comfortable Environment

Keeping our patients and hospital clean is a very important part of this position.

  • Clean and disinfect kennels, cages, runs, and animal care areas.

  • Maintain clean food and water bowls.

  • Wash, dry, fold, and organize hospital laundry and bedding.

  • Clean up after animals and properly dispose of waste.

  • Help maintain clean exam rooms, treatment areas, and common spaces.

  • Follow hospital cleaning and sanitation protocols to help provide a safe environment for patients and team members.

Safely Handle Dogs & Cats

  • Safely and compassionately handle dogs and cats of different sizes, breeds, personalities, and energy levels.

  • Follow established animal-handling and safety protocols.

  • Assist veterinary technicians, assistants, and veterinarians with patient handling when appropriate.

  • Recognize when an animal may be fearful, stressed, or uncomfortable and communicate concerns to the medical team.

Support the Veterinary Team

  • Help keep patient care areas organized and stocked.

  • Restock commonly used supplies as needed.

  • Assist with maintaining an organized hospital environment.

  • Communicate effectively with veterinarians, technicians, assistants, CSRs, and fellow kennel team members.

  • Jump in and help the team wherever needed throughout the day.

What We're Looking For

You don't necessarily need years of veterinary experience to be successful in this role. We are looking for someone who is dependable, willing to learn, comfortable working hard, and genuinely cares about animals.

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • A genuine love of animals and commitment to their care and well-being.
  • Dependable and consistent attendance.
  • Availability to work approximately 30–35 hours per week, including weekends.
  • A positive attitude and willingness to work as part of a team.
  • Strong communication and listening skills.
  • Ability to follow instructions and hospital protocols carefully.
  • Attention to detail, particularly when following feeding, cleaning, and patient care instructions.
  • Comfort working in a busy veterinary hospital environment.
  • Ability to safely lift, carry, walk, and assist with animals of varying sizes.
  • Willingness to perform the cleaning, laundry, sanitation, and physical responsibilities that are an important part of kennel and patient care.
  • Previous veterinary, kennel, boarding, shelter, rescue, pet care, or other animal-related experience is a plus, but not required for the right person.

Compensation & Benefits

$14–$16 per hour, based on experience

Full-time team members are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

  • Retirement Plan

  • Life Insurance

  • Paid Time Off

  • Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

  • Training & Development

  • Tuition Assistance

  • Uniform Allowance

  • Discounted Veterinary Care for Personal Pets

Come Grow With Us!

At Companion Animal Clinic, our Kennel Assistants are more than just the people who keep our kennels clean. They are caregivers, teammates, and an important part of making sure the animals entrusted to us feel safe and comfortable while they are in our care.

This can also be a wonderful entry point into veterinary medicine for someone who wants to learn more about the field and gain experience working alongside a veterinary team.

If you are dependable, hardworking, passionate about animals, and excited about becoming part of a supportive veterinary hospital team, we would love to meet you!

I especially like not requiring prior veterinary experience here. With the pay range and Katherine needing coverage fairly quickly, I’d rather let the knockout questions filter for weekends, 30–35 hours, pay alignment, animal comfort, and willingness to clean and keep the door open for a great, reliable person who can be trained.

Veterinary Innovative Partners (VIP) is a network of veterinarian-owned-and-operated hospitals across twelve states. VIP is guided by a mission to provide veterinarians and their teams with all the resources, mentorship, and autonomy they need to thrive personally and professionally while giving pets the best possible care.

Join the VIP family, where our team members are our top priority to ensure best-in-class personalized care, ownership and accountability, trust, and an exceptional work environment

Stay connected with VIP!
Follow Veterinary Innovative Partners on LinkedIn for the latest career opportunities, team stories, and behind-the-scenes looks at life in our hospitals.

title: Configuration Management Site Lead
location: Fort Walton Beach, Florida, United States
description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in unmanned aircraft systems. Our team of engineers and innovators is developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions that push the boundaries of UAS technology - solving complex challenges that matter.

We're building the future of UAS capabilities, and we're looking for exceptional talent to join us. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on next-generation flight systems, you belong here.

Position Overview

The Configuration Management Site Lead/Supervisor reports to the Senior Configuration Manager and serves as the local extension of enterprise CM leadership at an assigned operating site. This position leads and governs Configuration Management activities throughout the product lifecycle, supervises CM personnel, coordinates site workload, and ensures site execution aligns with enterprise policies, program objectives, contractual requirements, and industry standards.

Operating with minimal supervision, the Site Lead/Supervisor partners with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Operations, Software, and Program Management to maintain configuration integrity from concept and development through production, delivery, and sustainment. This position also represents the CDM function to leadership, customers, government representatives, suppliers, and auditors.

The Day-to-Day

  • Supervise site CM personnel by assigning work, setting priorities, monitoring performance, providing technical direction, and supporting employee development.
  • Serve as the primary site authority for hardware, software, firmware, documentation, and product-data configuration management while representing enterprise CM direction at the local level.
  • Provide recurring site and program status to the Senior Configuration Manager, including baseline health, change activity, implementation progress, audit readiness, data integrity, staffing and workload, performance metrics, risks, and decisions requiring escalation.
  • Lead configuration identification, baseline management, change control, configuration status accounting, data management, implementation verification, product release, and configuration audits.
  • Participate in enterprise CM reviews, planning, process standardization, and continuous-improvement activities; implement enterprise direction at the site and elevate local issues for resolution.
  • Coordinate site CM staffing, schedules, resources, and deliverables while escalating risks, constraints, and compliance concerns to leadership.
  • Lead CM support for proposals and program planning by reviewing Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Statements of Work (SOWs), contracts, specifications, and technical requirements.
  • Define CM scope, deliverables, staffing, schedules, risks, and defensible Bases of Estimate (BOEs) for hardware, software, firmware, and data-management activities.
  • Evaluate prime and subcontract documentation to identify CM responsibilities, risks, dependencies, and required flow-downs-even when CM is not explicitly identified.
  • Ensure alignment and traceability among requirements, drawings, specifications, engineering and manufacturing bills of material, software baselines, work instructions, manufacturing records, and delivered configurations.
  • Lead or support Configuration Control Boards (CCBs) and Software Configuration Control Boards (SCCBs), ensuring changes are evaluated, approved, implemented, verified, and incorporated into affected baselines and records.
  • Oversee the effective use of PLM, PDM, ERP, MES, QMS, requirements-management, and software-development systems to strengthen data governance and digital-thread continuity.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, systems engineering, business, information management, or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum of seven years of progressive experience in configuration management, engineering, product data management, or manufacturing within aerospace, defense, or another regulated industry.
  • Minimum of two years of leadership or supervisory experience, including assigning work, establishing priorities, mentoring personnel, and managing performance.
  • Experience applying configuration management principles across hardware, software, firmware, documentation, and integrated systems.
  • Ability to interpret contracts, RFPs, SOWs, specifications, technical requirements, and supplier flow-down requirements.
  • Working knowledge of applicable standards and regulations, including EIA-649, AS9100, ISO 9001, MIL-HDBK-61, ITAR, and EAR.
  • Strong leadership, communication, organization, decision-making, and cross-functional problem-solving skills.
  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supervising CM personnel in a multi-program or multi-site organization.
  • Systems-thinking skills and experience supporting integrated hardware, software, firmware, requirements, and manufacturing data.
  • Knowledge of systems engineering processes, technical reviews, product-development lifecycles, production readiness, and sustainment.
  • Experience developing proposal inputs, staffing plans, schedules, work breakdown structures, and BOEs.
  • Experience supporting government contracts, customer audits, and contractual data deliveries.
  • Experience with SolidWorks PDM or comparable PLM/PDM platforms.
  • Experience implementing CM metrics, process automation, or digital-thread improvements.
  • Professional certification or formal training in Configuration Management, Systems Engineering, quality management, or project management is preferred.
Pay range for this role
$118,000—$141,000 USD

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.
  • 401k with company-match
  • 3 weeks of paid time off each year
  • 40 hours of sick time
  • 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

  • Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Strategic Digital Native Segment, AWS Industries, Strategic Customers
description:
Digital Native companies are redefining their industries, and they need a trusted technical partner who can keep pace. As a Senior Solutions Architect on the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Strategic Digital Native team, you will work directly with these high-growth customers — companies building products used by millions of end users — as they adopt generative AI and emerging technologies to drive transformational business outcomes. You will design production-grade architectures, guide technology strategy, and help customers benchmark and evaluate solutions for use cases that deliver real ROI. The team is focused right now on transforming how customers apply generative AI to reduce costs, accelerate product development, and unlock new revenue streams, making this a high-impact moment to shape how Digital Natives build on AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Design end-to-end cloud architectures for strategic Digital Native customers, incorporating generative AI capabilities, modern data patterns, and AWS managed services to solve complex business problems.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading in-depth architecture discussions and influencing their longer-term technology strategy with pragmatic, well-considered recommendations.
- Collaborate with AWS engineering and product teams to channel customer feedback into future service improvements, and co-design features that address real-world customer needs.
- Develop and deliver technical thought leadership content such as reference architectures, workshops, proof-of-concept builds, blog posts, and open-source contributions that accelerate customer adoption of AWS services.
- Research emerging technologies across domains like generative AI, data, developer productivity, and ML frameworks, then translate findings into actionable guidance that helps customers adopt the right services for measurable business value.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing an architecture proposal for a customer migrating their recommendation engine to a generative AI-powered pipeline, then jump into a design session with the customer's engineering leads to walk through trade-offs around latency, cost, and scalability. After lunch you could pair with an AWS service team to prototype a new integration pattern a customer requested, followed by drafting a reference architecture that other Solutions Architects can reuse. Throughout, you stay connected to your account team — syncing with sales and support partners to keep delivery on track and ensure the customer's priorities stay front and center.

About the team
Our team sits within the AWS Industries organization and is dedicated to supporting Digital Native customers — strategic, fast-moving companies that lead and define the trends in their industries. We partner closely with AWS engineering and product teams, channeling customer feedback directly into future service releases and co-designing features alongside customers. We also work with our Support organization to ensure production workloads are resilient and that new deployments meet the operational bar for reliable, scalable systems.

Growth here is self-directed. Solutions Architects on this team turn their hands-on research into industry thought leadership — speaking at conferences like re:Invent, leading community groups, publishing AWS blogs, and contributing code to aws-samples on GitHub. You choose the emerging domains you want to go deep in, and you chart your own path whether that means deepening your technical expertise or expanding your impact across AWS and the broader industry.

AWS values inclusive experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Here at AWS, our employee-led affinity groups create a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

You'll find knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Director, Transmission + Interconnection
description:
As the Director of Transmission and Interconnection at Exus, you will lead the technical execution and strategic portfolio management of utility-scale renewable energy projects across North America. This dual-focus role combines hands-on oversight of interconnection studies, single-line diagrams, and grid requests with high-level advisory support for senior leadership on development risks, acquisitions, and capital allocation.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Transmission Strategy & Pipeline Support: Develop transmission strategies, evaluate market access and economics, and lead due diligence (congestion, curtailment, deliverability, reliability) for greenfield projects, acquisitions, and development pipelines.
  • ISO/RTO & Stakeholder Relations: Serve as primary interface with ISOs, RTOs, utilities, transmission owners, and consultants to manage relationships and drive project outcomes.
  • Interconnection Management: Direct full interconnection study processes (feasibility, system impact, facility, restudy) and manage milestone trackers, reporting items, and financial security status.
  • Applications & Technical Submissions: Prepare, review, and submit interconnection requests, single-line diagrams, modeling data, technical exhibits, and supporting engineering documentation.
  • Risk & Cost Resolution: Lead the resolution of complex interconnection challenges, network upgrade requirements, and cost allocation matters.
  • Power Flow & System Modeling: Prepare and provide technical oversight for power flow analyses, system modeling, generator interconnection studies, and transmission evaluations.
  • QA/QC & Engineering Oversight: Review engineering deliverables, equipment specifications, and technical reports; perform rigorous QA/QC on studies, modeling assumptions, and consultant work products to catch risks and errors.
  • Consultant & Vendor Management: Manage transmission planning consultants, engineering firms, and technical service providers.
  • Regulatory Monitoring & Advocacy: Stay current on FERC, NERC, RTO, and state regulatory developments while providing support on transmission planning reforms and interconnection policies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Development, Finance, Commercial, EPC, and Asset Management teams to optimize project outcomes and streamline handoffs from development to operations.
  • Investment & M&A Support: Contribute technical expertise, due diligence, and insights to M&A evaluations, project acquisitions, and Investment Committee materials to drive executive decision-making.


Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related field required; Master's degree preferred
  • 10+ years of experience in transmission planning, interconnection, power system engineering, or related power industry roles required
  • Extensive experience working with major ISOs and RTOs, including PJM, MISO, SPP, WECC, and ISO-NE required
  • Direct experience managing utility-scale generation projects through the interconnection process from application submission through interconnection agreement execution and commercial operation required
  • Experience with transmission planning, power system modeling, and interconnection studies required
  • Experience supporting project development, acquisitions, investment decisions, or portfolio strategy required
  • Experience in and desire to work as a player/coach required

title: Software Architect / Space Communications Program
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Senior Software Architect SME to support the Space Exploration Networks Services and Evolution (SENSE) contract at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC), in Greenbelt, MD. This role will lead the architecture review, documentation, and modernization of a large-scale legacy ground system codebase supporting NASA Space Relay network operations. The right candidate brings deep experience with legacy systems, a track record of leading technical teams through complex software recoveries and the ability to operate effectively in a structured government program environment.

Peraton is the prime contractor for NASA at the White Sands Complex (WSC) near Las Cruces, New Mexico. Operating here are two functionally identical satellite ground terminals: The White Sands Ground Terminal, and the Second TDRSS Ground Terminal. These ground terminals ensure uninterrupted communications between various ground stations, NASA’s orbiting fleet of Tracking and Data Relay Satellites (TDRS), customer spacecraft (satellites), and the computer systems that support such spacecraft. WSC serves as an interface for distributing satellite data to control centers and scientists who then use the daily influx of data to expand our ever-growing knowledge of the Earth and the universe.

Responsibilities / What you’ll do…

  • Co-lead the Architecture Definition Review of legacy codebase which is a 35-year-old ground system written in Fortran, Ada, C, and C++
  • Develop and update technical architecture documentation for a legacy system to close knowledge gaps and support long-term sustainment
  • Mentor a team of software engineers through a structured modernization and platform rehost effort, especially using AI tools and methods to gain efficiency.
  • Define and implement software development processes, toolchain standards, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Drive adoption of agile methodologies including sprint planning, peer estimation, and Definition of Done enforcement
  • Direct AI-assisted code comprehension workflows using NASA-approved tools
  • Support the development of backend effort estimates grounded in architecture analysis
  • Coordinate with NASA task monitors and program leadership on technical progress and formal review gates
  • Maintain and evolve technical documentation as a living knowledge base in support of long-term program sustainment

Qualifications

REQUIRED

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field and 10 years of experience; Master's degree and 7 years of experience.
  • Security clearance - this position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a DoD Secret security clearance and to maintain the clearance thereafter. You must be a US Citizen and show proof of citizenship.
  • Demonstrated experience reading, analyzing, and reverse-engineering legacy codebases in one or more of the following languages: C, C++, Fortran, Ada.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI to assist in code comprehension and documentation is a plus
  • Experience leading formal architecture reviews of systems the candidate did not originally build, including undocumented or minimally documented systems
  • Hands-on experience with Linux/Unix-based development environments
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, or equivalent)
  • Proficiency with version control systems (GitLab, GitHub, or equivalent)
  • Experience establishing or operating within CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent)
  • Experience with agile/iterative development methodologies including sprint planning, backlog management, and Definition of Done
  • Experience with JIRA or equivalent agile project tracking tools
  • Demonstrated experience leading software development or architecture teams of 5 or more engineers
  • Experience In programs with formal configuration management, change request processes, and review gates in a government or DoD/NASA environment
  • Ability to develop and maintain technical documentation for legacy systems with little or no existing documentation

PREFERRED

  • Experience with NASA ground systems, space relay systems, or mission-critical ground software
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted code comprehension tools (e.g., AskSage or equivalent approved government AI platforms)
  • Experience building or directing API-driven or RAG-based code analysis workflows using Python
  • Experience with Oracle, MSSQL; Postgres preferred
  • Experience migrating legacy codebases from end-of-life platforms (hardware or OS) to modern environments
  • Familiarity with MBSE tools (e.g., MagicDraw/Cameo)
  • Experience with Confluence for technical knowledge management

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. title: Analista de Testes Senior
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Analista de Testes Senior based in Brazil.

This role is responsible for driving software quality across complex products and technology initiatives within the insurance sector. You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from requirements refinement and testability analysis to automation, validation, and production support. The position combines advanced test engineering, automation architecture, CI/CD, non-functional testing, and risk-based quality practices. You will help evolve scalable testing frameworks and infrastructure while promoting quality standards across development teams. The role also offers the opportunity to apply AI responsibly to test generation, regression prioritization, failure analysis, and defect investigation. Working closely with developers, Product, Architecture, Operations, and clients, you will help make quality a shared responsibility across the organization.

Accountabilities:

  • Participate actively in the software development lifecycle, contributing to refinement activities, challenging business rules, evaluating testability, and transforming acceptance criteria into verifiable test scenarios.
  • Plan and execute comprehensive testing activities, ensuring test scripts and execution meet agreed deadlines and acceptance criteria.
  • Apply risk-based testing approaches, prioritizing effort according to business criticality, technical complexity, and historical defect patterns.
  • Define and guide testing strategies across products and modules, covering unit, integration, contract, interface, end-to-end, and non-functional testing levels.
  • Architect, evolve, and scale automation frameworks and infrastructure, promoting reuse across products, parallel execution, and reproducible environments through containers and ephemeral environments.
  • Establish and promote effective version-control practices for automated test repositories using recognized industry models such as Git Flow.
  • Implement quality gates within CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, test coverage, and performance thresholds.
  • Define, document, and continuously improve software quality standards, templates, policies, and responsible AI practices for testing.
  • Apply AI in a controlled and advanced manner to support test-suite generation, risk- and change-based regression prioritization, failure triage, and defect analysis, always maintaining human validation and protecting sensitive data.
  • Evaluate and recommend testing tools and technologies through proof-of-concept initiatives based on technical, cost, and sustainability criteria.
  • Define test data management and test environment strategies according to project and business requirements.
  • Lead process optimization initiatives with measurable outcomes, including reduced lead time, fewer flaky tests, and lower rework.
  • Mentor Junior and Mid-Level Test Analysts through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and internal training.
  • Guide developers on testability, unit testing, and integration testing while promoting shared ownership of software quality.
  • Support leadership in communicating quality risks to Product, Architecture, Operations, and customers, including during critical acceptance and validation activities.
  • When required, prepare solution packages for customers, support customer configuration, and provide training on delivered solutions.

    • Requirements

    • Advanced practical knowledge of software testing approaches and techniques within complex projects and technology environments.

    • Advanced CI/CD experience, including building and optimizing pipelines with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI, with quality gates and parallel execution.
    • Practical experience with Docker, familiarity with Kubernetes orchestration, and exposure to cloud-based test infrastructure on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
    • Hands-on experience with performance and load testing using tools such as k6 or JMeter, as well as resilience testing and application security fundamentals.
    • Experience testing distributed architectures, APIs, messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and integrations with legacy systems.
    • Advanced SQL and data analysis skills for defect investigation, test data generation, and validation of calculations through database queries.
    • Practical experience applying AI to testing, including prompt engineering, LLM integration into testing workflows, and critical evaluation of AI-generated results.
    • Experience working within Agile frameworks is a plus.
    • CTFL or higher software testing certification is desirable.
    • Experience in regulated environments and insurance systems, including policies, claims, coinsurance, reinsurance, and integrations with regulatory bodies, is an advantage.

title: 2026-2027 Enrollment Specialist (Seasonal)
description:
Enrollment Specialist (Seasonal)

Join a dedicated team that fosters autonomy and creativity, while receiving a competitive salary, opportunities for career and personal growth, and the gratification that comes from creating positive multi-generational change.

Ednovate Background

Ednovate launched its first school in 2012. Since then, we’ve grown to eight schools and are on a trajectory to reach 11 schools in just the next few years (you can read more about our schools here). Ednovate is committed to serving areas where students traditionally lack access to a quality college-prep education by building tuition-free, safe, high-performing public schools driven to create positive multi-generational change.

We are made up of world travelers, nacho connoisseurs, KPOP business owners, and Beyonce fans. We love LA and OC, and we're our students' biggest cheerleaders. We are looking to hire innovative changemakers who aim to continue our goal of becoming the high school experts across Southern California. Sound like you? Keep reading.

Position Overview

As an Enrollment Specialist at Ednovate, you will support student enrollment and recruitment work at our schools during the busiest time of year for this work. Working closely with one of our school leaders and the network student enrollment team, you will execute on a robust student enrollment strategy and process to meet our goal of 100% enrollment. As the primary point of contact for students and families in processing enrollment and registration, you will provide excellent customer service and ensure airtight follow up and follow through. This is a part-time, non-exempt role that reports to the Chief of Schools. Please note: This seasonal position is available from January to June for six hours per day, four days per week.

What You'll Do

  • Support the execution of a multi pronged student recruitment strategy. Provide support with the planning and execution of strategic and cultivating student recruitment events at our schools and in the community. Distribute communications and marketing materials including flyers and presentations to drive applications. Attend community events and fairs to inform eligible families and promote Ednovate schools.

  • Provide excellent support to families. Communicate with families to provide proactive support and answer questions throughout the lottery and enrollment process, which includes answering enrollment and registration questions via phone, online, mail and/or in person and assisting families with completing enrollment applications (paper and online) in a timely and thorough manner. Follow up with families after the lottery to offer spots and secure acceptance until achieving the school's enrollment target goals. Manage the registration process by distributing communications, following up with families, and supporting the collection and input of registration documents until 100% registration is complete.

  • Support enrollment operations. Support the management of SchoolMint, our online enrollment and lottery system. Input and organize data gathered from canvassing, outreach, phone-banking, and other recruitment and enrollment activities. Monitor progress towards goals and make meaningful and timely adjustments.

Who You'll Be

  • Mission-driven professional passionate about increasing college attainment for historically under-represented students

  • Social justice champion committed to promoting educational opportunity for all students and families

  • Entrepreneurial spirit who thrives in a workplace characterized by autonomy, flexibility, transparency and accountability

  • Collaborative team player who works well with others from diverse backgrounds, uplifts and celebrates our teammates and engages in healthy debate and feedback to get the best results for students and families

  • Resourceful, persistent learner with a growth mindset, constantly seeking to “find a way or make one” to master your craft and improve results.

We're Looking For

  • High school diploma or equivalent, required

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish, required

  • Working knowledge of word processing, database and spreadsheet applications, required

  • Canvassing, phone-banking, or event management experience, preferred

  • Knowledge and cultural competence regarding the communities served by Ednovate, preferred

  • Knowledge of public education and charter schools, preferred

We're Committed To Giving You

  • A full-time hourly wage ($22 to $30 per hour, commensurate with experience)

  • A place to grow, learn and be a part of the Ednovate family

We Believe in Inclusion

We aim to intentionally develop a schoolwide culture in which every student and teammate feels a sense of belonging. Ednovate does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, handicap, age, religion, sexual orientation, or national or ethnic origin. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship.

We know applying for a new job can be daunting, and studies have shown that individuals from historically underrepresented communities may only apply to roles when they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage all interested candidates to apply. You may be just the person we need! If you have any questions about your application or interview process, do not hesitate to email hiring@ednovate.org. We are here to help.

title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
description:
This is a remote position.

Position Overview

Seeking a hands-on Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer to support the design, development, implementation, administration, integration, and ongoing enhancement of an internal enterprise document-processing product for PBGC.

The role combines IBM Datacap development, platform administration, integration engineering, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. The consultant will work within an Agile product engineering team to build a secure, reliable, and scalable document-processing solution.

This is not purely a Datacap administration role. The candidate must have strong hands-on Datacap development experience and be able to move from requirements and technical design through development, integration, deployment, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

1. IBM Datacap Development

  • Design, develop, configure, and enhance IBM Datacap applications.
  • Develop and maintain:
    • Datacap rulesets
    • Tasks
    • Actions
    • Document hierarchies
    • Workflows
    • Validation rules
    • Verification processes
  • Configure and optimize:
    • OCR
    • Document recognition
    • Document classification
    • Data extraction
    • Field validation
    • Image processing
    • Batch processing
  • Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions/extensions.
  • Implement business rules for document processing, routing, validation, and exception handling.

  • Support:
    • Datacap Server
    • Rulerunner

  • Develop and support custom Datacap components using:
    • C#
    • .NET
    • Java
    • JavaScript
    • SQL
    • XML
    • REST

  • Strong C#/.NET experience is especially valuable for custom Datacap actions and extensions.

Required Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Strong IBM Datacap 9.x / 9.1.x
  • Strong Datacap Studio development
  • Strong Rulerunner administration and development
  • Experience developing:

  • Strong understanding of document capture/intelligent document processing
  • Experience with:

title: Databricks Data Engineer
description:

title: Renewable Energy Solar Technician - Multiple Levels [On-Site]
description:
Scope of Position

About Us:

EDF power solutions North America has been providing clean energy solutions throughout the U.S., Canada, and Mexico since 1987. We are a market-leading independent power producer and service provider, serving utilities, corporations, industries, communities, institutions, and investors with reliable, low-carbon energy solutions that help meet growing demand.

From developing and building scalable wind (onshore and offshore), solar, storage (battery and pumped storage hydro), smart EV charging, microgrids, green hydrogen, and transmission projects, to maximizing performance and profitability through skilled operations and maintenance and innovative asset optimization, our teams deliver expert solutions along the entire value chain—from origination to commercial operation.

Be a part of an innovative and collaborative team environment that fosters our goal of delivering renewable solutions to lead the transition to a sustainable energy future.

Benefits & Perks:

EDF power solutions offers best-in-class employee benefits, including the following:

  • Competitive bonus incentives. This position is eligible for our annual bonus program.
  • Comprehensive health coverage. We provide low-cost health & wellness coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
  • Rewarding 401k. We provide a generous matching contribution.

We are also proud to offer:

  • Favorable paid time off programs, including paid parental leave after one year of service.
  • Rewarding learning & career development and advancement opportunities.
  • Supportive mentorship & buddy programs.

Salary Range: The full pay range for this role is $22.69 to $47.74 per hour, and the good faith estimated starting pay for this position upon hire is $27.00 - $33.00 per hour. We generally base our salary decisions on factors including but not limited to, relevant work and leadership experience, education, demonstrated performance, internal equity, and in some cases, geographic location.

Scope of Job: We are seeking dedicated and talented individuals for roles ranging from entry-level Technician 1 to expert Technician 5 to perform maintenance, repair, and operational activities on utility-scale renewable energy assets, including wind turbines, Photovoltaic (PV) power systems, and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

Candidates will be placed at the level commensurate with their experience, qualifications, and successful completion of internal competency standards.

Required Training: Each Renewable Energy Technician will attend a mandatory 3-4 week training and certification course at the start of their employment. The exact duration will be determined based on experience and qualifications. The training is in Albert Lea, MN, and travel, accommodation, and expenses will be provided.

This position will be supporting our Willow Springs and Cuyama solar sites.

Willow Springs is located near Rosamond/Lancaster, CA

Cuyama Solar is located near Bakersfeild/Taft, CA

Responsibilities

The level of autonomy, technical complexity, and leadership responsibility distinctly separates the three technician roles.

Role

Primary Focus

On-the-Job Autonomy & Leadership

Technician 1 (Entry-Level)

Assists experienced technicians with maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs. Focuses on learning and applying safety protocols.

Works under specific direction and direct supervision.

title: Senior & Lead Software Engineers - C++/C# - Autonomous Mining
description:
Senior & Lead Software Engineers – C++/C# - Autonomous Mining

Build software that moves the world's mines Here's the challenge: a real-time platform that's been running mine sites for decades — coordinating trucks, shovels, drills and other equipment — now also has to operate autonomous trucks alongside human-driven vehicles.

It's running live at mine sites around the world, under high-availability contracts where downtime has real operational and financial consequences.
You can't simply take it offline to fix it. You can't experiment carelessly. These are safety-critical systems with physical consequences.
That's where you come in.

We're looking for Senior Software Engineers and Technical Leads who enjoy working on complex, real-world systems and want to have a meaningful impact on how they are engineered, supported and evolved.
This is a hands-on engineering environment. You'll be close to the code, the systems and the problems — not simply directing from a distance.

What you'll be doing:

 Depending on your experience and level, you'll have the opportunity to:
  • Diagnose and resolve complex, customer-impacting issues in a large, mature C++/C# codebase
  • Lead technical investigations into difficult production problems, from initial diagnosis through containment, root cause and systemic resolution
  • Design and implement robust solutions for highly available, real-time systems
  • Participate in and lead Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) and Failure Modes and Effects Analyses (FMEAs)
  • Help evolve engineering and support practices from reactive problem-solving toward proactive identification and prevention
  • Build tooling, instrumentation and processes that give teams better visibility into system health and performance
  • Work across a broad technical stack, including C++ and C#, with increasing use of Python and Kubernetes
  • Contribute to the integration of AI into engineering and support workflows where it can deliver genuine value
  • For Lead-level engineers, provide technical leadership, mentor other engineers and influence engineering practices and technical direction
What we're looking for:

 We're interested in engineers at different stages of seniority, so you don't need to tick every box.

You might be a Senior Software Engineer who:
  • Has strong commercial experience developing complex software systems
  • Is comfortable working in C++ and/or C#
  • Enjoys getting to the bottom of difficult technical problems
  • Has experience with production systems where reliability and availability matter
  • Wants to broaden their technical leadership and take on greater ownership
Or you might be a Technical Lead who:
  • Has a strong software engineering background and remains hands-on
  • Can take ownership of complex technical problems from investigation through to resolution
  • Has experience leading engineers or influencing technical direction
  • Is comfortable making decisions in complex, high-pressure environments
  • Enjoys improving engineering practices, not just solving the immediate problem
Experience with Python, Kubernetes, distributed systems, real-time systems, mining technology or autonomous systems is valuable, but we're primarily interested in strong engineers who enjoy tackling genuinely difficult problems.

Why This Opportunity?
You'll be working with experienced engineers on systems where your technical decisions can have a tangible impact.

If you're a Senior Software Engineer looking for your next technical challenge, or an experienced engineer ready to take on a Technical Lead role, we'd like to hear from you.
